news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 75th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-09-02 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 75th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Wander Gear T
Accessory Avatar
Wander Cape T
Accessory Avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Wander Mask Q
Accessory Avatar
Wander Brooch Q
Accessory Avatar
Wander Shield Q
Shield Avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 75 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the September 2, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 9, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the September 9, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 16, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 75 Boss Monster
Wonder Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes its elemental weakness to Wind.

Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Stun", "Scorch", and "Bloodshed"
Debuffs "Decrease Attack" and "Seal Item"
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
The "GoG Season 75 Ticket" can be used until before the September 16, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9). After this point, they will be removed (hidden).
The "Wander Gear T" and "Wander Cape T" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after the maintenance following the end of Season 75.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 74 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 74 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Wonder Fatal Scythe" after maintenance on September 16 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Wander Shield P", "Wander Mask P", "Wander Brooch P", "Wander Gear S", and "Wander Cape S".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 75 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 75 reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Wonder Fatal Scythe" at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 75 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

The drop rate for Lava Integral Series evolution materials is highest in Labyrinth - Interior.
Boss Monster
The Spore Reaper
Details
Since this is a Crystal-disabled field, some items cannot be used.
There are multiple attackable parts: the head, body, and tail, each dealing separate damage.
Skill Breaks can be performed with "Dagger", "1H Sword", or skills that are both Slash Element and Dark Element.
The Skill Break Gauge can only be reduced by attacking the head.
With each Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
Some attacks will remove player buffs.
In the Character Quest and Labyrinth, at the beginning of battle, it grants a "Critical resistance" buff.
It uses the "Critical resistance" buff.
It uses the "Decrease Non-Elemental Damage" and "Seal item" debuffs.

How to Participate
Talk to the "Underground Labyrinth Guide" NPC at the "Blackiron Palace" to challenge it.
In order to participate, you must clear the 100F Main Quest through the end.
About Underground Labyrinth
The Underground Labyrinth is a special location where you can fight enemies on the same field with players outside of your party and guild members.
Other players can attack monsters currently being fought.
All monsters will attack players near them.
You can obtain Skill Releasers in all floors of the Underground Labyrinth.
Skill Releasers are items that increase the damage of certain sword skills.
A very valuable shield can be produced using Protection Stones that drop from the bosses from the Underground Labyrinth B2F.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 74!
EVENT
2026-08-19 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 74 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the August 19, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 27, 2026 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 74, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 74 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 74 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from August 28 (Fri) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
※Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 74 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes its elemental weakness to Earth.
It is breakable with Thrust Element skills.
Also, it will unleash Skill Breakable attacks, and the Skill Break Gauge can only be reduced by Sword Skills that are the Thrust Element and Earth Element.
When a break or skill break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
Additionally, it adds a stack debuff that increases damage.

Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Sleep", "Bloodshed", and "Fatal Poison"
Debuffs "Decrease Non-Elemental Damage" and "Decrease Switch Gauge Fill Rate"
* Break: By completely lowering the Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 74 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 74 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 74 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 74 dungeons.
"GoG Season 74 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 74 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 74 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 74 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* The item you can earn in this tournament is the "GoG Season 74 Badge".
GoG Season Badges can be traded for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Notices
The 74th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-08-13 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 74th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility

Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 74 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.

- Special Bonus
The new function "Special Bonus" is now available.
If you equip Special Bonus compatible Skill Records and clear certain Dungeons, a bonus will be added to your score.
Special Bonus effects can be used when equipped to either Set 1 or Set 2.
If you equip the same skill on Set 1 and Set 2 the effect will not be duplicated.
The more times you Limit Break a Skill Record, the higher the bonus you receive.
* Special Bonuss are not usable in all Dungeons.
* Special Bonuss compatible Skill Records, point bonuses, and conditions will be different for each Dungeon.
* Special Bonuss do not work with Skill Records equipped by your Partner.
- Record
You can get different Records by clearing specific conditions.
You can view the Record list screen from the Status screen. Here you can see the Records you have acquired, and select which ones you would like to use.
The Records you select will appear in your Status screen and above the head of your character, so you can show off to other players.
- Quick Party
The new function "Quick Party" is now available.
It automatically puts you in a party with other players who are attempting the same dungeon, making is easier to enjoy Party gameplay.
When you challenge a dungeon, select "Challenge with Quick Party" and the Quick Party function will automatically put you in a party that's challenging the same dungeon.
If there are no Quick Parties recruiting members, you will be automatically designated leader of a new party and recruit members for a set time.
* You will still be able to challenge dungeons using the pre-existing method of Party formation.
* Currently the "Quick Party" function is only available in Dungeons.
- Other Adjustments
Some status ailments damage has been adjusted.
Some Effects have been adjusted.
We've introduced some adjustments to reduce data usage while loading.

Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."

news_list.full_details:
Notices
About the Next Update
NOTICES
2018-07-23 11:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
We are planning to release an update that will add the ninth floor.
The following are some of the new features to be implemented in the update.
[Ninth Floor Added]
The elf campaign that started on the third floor will finally come to its conclusion!
Sinon will also be making her debut in the main story.
[New Weapon Type: Bow]
The bow is a long-range weapon.
It has many special skills such as charge attacks and damage fluctuation according to attack distance.
[Guild Room]
This is an exclusive area where members of the same guild can meet.
It can be used as an area for resting, party formation, strategizing, and more.
Additionally, the guild room is guild-specific Guild Daily Quests can be accepted here as well.
*The guild room can be used once a guild has been created.
[Skill Adjustments]
The balancing for the following Skill Records will be adjusted.
Additionally, an issue will be addressed where the player is affected by the bonus effect of certain Skill Records used by one's partner.
Although we understand that this skill has been widely used among players, the amount of damage it deals exceeded our estimations, causing a great impact on the overall game balance and processing load. As a result of the management team's careful consideration, this issue will be corrected.
As an apology for this inconvenience, we are considering compensation.
The details of the compensation will be announced at a later time.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Policies and Penalties for Misconduct
IMPORTANT
2018-07-11 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online: Integral Factor".
We are currently investigating reports we have received regarding in-game misconduct.
As soon as investigations are complete, we will implement the following measures against users engaging in unfair play (i.e. tampering with app data).
Measures Against Unfair Play:
- Termination of account
Regarding the event in session, "Wander Fatal Scythe Hunt",
we will be taking the following measures.
Measures Against Unfair Play in "Wander Fatal Scythe Hunt":
- Penalties will be applied to the scores of Raid Boss Dungeons completed with a user that engaged in unfair play
* Application of penalties will be carried out when rankings are totaled at the end of the event.
* The ranking rewards will be distributed according to the ranking after the penalties have been applied.
Final scores may change due to the above measures, resulting in possible delays in the ranking announcements and distribution of rewards.
The Management Team will further strive to provide games that everyone can play in a fun and fair environment.
We appreciate your support of Sword Art Online: Integral Factor and thank you for playing within the terms of service.
For inquiries and reports regarding misconduct and account termination, please contact us via "Support" in the title screen menu.
* You will need your User ID in order to make inquiries or reports.
Tap "User ID" on the title screen to copy it, then paste it into the form.

Boss Tickets are guild items and thus will not be displayed in your character's Item list.

《Achievement: Set up Transfer ID》
Receive 250 Arcana Gems by setting up a Transfer ID that can be used to transfer your game data.
Create a Transfer ID to prevent loss of game data when transferring devices or in case the app is deleted.
《How to Transfer Data》
1. On your old device, select Create Transfer ID from the title menu.
2. Make a note of your Transfer ID and set up your password.
3. Install the app on your new device.
4. On your new device, select Enter Transfer ID from the title menu.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
"Burst Skills" Implementation Notice
UPDATE
2018-11-30 16:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
New "Burst Skills" Feature Added!
* Images show features in development, and these may differ from their final form in the game.
-Burst Skills
There are now certain Skill Records that can use powerful Burst Skills.
Burst Skills are powerful Sword Skills that can be unlocked for specific Skill Records once they've been enhanced up to a certain level.
To trigger an unlocked Burst Skill, players need to chain together weapon (slash, thrust, and blunt) or elemental (fire, water, wind, earth, holy, and dark) Skills in a designated order within each Skill's execution time limit (approximately 10 seconds).
If these Skills are correctly chained together in time all the way to the end of the stated sequence, players can then trigger their Burst Skill.
Once a Burst Skill has been activated, you'll be invincible for a set period of time.
The sequence of elements that need to be chained together to trigger a Burst Skill varies with each individual Skill Record.
The exact sequence of elements required to trigger a Burst Skill can be checked by going to Menu→Items→Skill Records.
From there, select the Sword Skill you wish to view, then tap the Burst Skill icon under "Skill" in the bottom-right part of the screen to see its Burst Skill activation requirements.
Once you've equipped a Skill Record that has a Burst Skill, you can start the activation sequence simply by landing a Sword Skill that meets the first requirement on an enemy.
If it connects, the next required element will be displayed in the bottom part of the screen, along with a bar indicating the time that you have left to trigger it.
Sword Skills used during switching also count towards the activation sequence.
Example: Suppose that a Burst Skill has the following activation sequence: 1. Slash Element. 2. Fire Element. 3. Fire Element. When you first land a Slash Element attack, the game will notify you that a Fire Element attack is the next requirement.
If you then use a Sword Skill that's a different element than the one specified or don't land a Sword Skill that meets the specified element within the time limit, the activation sequence will fail.
Sword Skills that are triggered after changing equipment using Quick Change can also be used to meet the required element as long as the Skill is activated within the time limit.
If you equip multiple Skill Records with Burst Skills, and successfully meet the requirements to activate them consecutively, you can activate these Burst Skills with the shortest sequence possible.
"E.g.: With [Black Pioneer] Kirito (Slash→Fire→Fire) and [Mighty Warrior] Yuuki (Fire→Slash→Wind) equipped, both Burst Skills can be activated as:
Slash→Fire→Fire→([Black Pioneer] Kirito's Burst Skill: Slash/Fire)→Wind→([Mighty Warrior] Yuuki's Burst Skill: Slash/Wind)."
When multiple Burst Skills have the same activation sequences, only one of them can be activated.
E.g.: If you equip 2 Sword Skills both with the Burst Skill activation sequence Blunt→Fire→Fire, then either Blunt→Fire→Fire (Burst Skill 1) or Blunt→Fire→Fire (Burst Skill 2) will be activated.
However, Sword Skills that are used either by your partner or other party members do not count towards the activation sequence.
Burst Skills will not be activated by switching.
Additionally, partners and other characters cannot activate Burst Skills.
-Holiday Campaign! Login Bonus
We are planning to hold a "Holiday Campaign! Login Bonus" starting at 4:00 am on December 1 (Sat) (JST/UTC+9).
Don't miss this chance to get a total of 2,500 Arcana Gems by logging in for 7 days during the event!

Notices
Holiday Campaign! Daily Dungeons +1
EVENT
2018-11-21 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
-Period
Starts after the November 21, 2018 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 30, 2018 (Fri) maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
* Daily Dungeons are updated daily at 4:00am. After this, the previous day's dungeons cannot be attempted.(JST/UTC+9)
* Daily Dungeons that have been cleared prior to the November 21 (Wed) maintenance can be attempted and cleared again once maintenance is complete.(JST/UTC+9)
* Daily Dungeons can be cleared twice during the period starting at 4:00am on November 30 (Fri) and lasting until maintenance begins on November 30 (Fri).
Please note that Daily Dungeons cleared for the first time following the November 30 (Fri) maintenance can only be attempted once per day.(JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
- Starting Location
Blackiron Palace
Daily Dungeon
- Event Details
Daily Dungeons that can usually only be cleared once per day can be cleared twice per day for the duration of the event!
Daily Dungeons are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are seven varieties of Daily Dungeons to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP and equipment enhancement items.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets the next day at 4 AM (JST/UTC+9).
-Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
–See here for more details on "Daily Dungeons"!

You can challenge a Daily Dungeon by talking to the NPC "Daily Dungeons" in the Blackiron Palace.

Notices
EXP Requirement Balance Adjustment Details
UPDATE
2018-10-03 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The game balance adjustments we announced previously have been implemented as of the October 3, 2018 (Wed) maintenance.
- Changes
・EXP requirements for leveling up to Lv 51 and onwards relaxed.
・EXP amounts earned for completing main quests from floor 5 and onwards adjusted.
The lower amount of EXP required for Lv 51 and above makes it easier to level up.
We have also adjusted the amount of EXP you can earn in the Main Quest on Floor 5 and up to coincide with the above change.
Quest EXP has been set in line with the amount of EXP that was required before the change.
These changes have been made with game's balance in mind.
Due to mitigating and adjusting EXP after Lv51, the user level will increase by "Lv 1" for users with levels above 50 and below 100.
To coincide with the balance adjustments we will be holding a "Level Up Support Campaign" and giving out the following Items.

After receiving everyone's feedback and conducting our own examination, the following adjustments to game balance will be made related to EXP requirements for leveling up.  First, the amount of EXP needed to level up to Lv 51 ...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
Game Balance Adjustments
IMPORTANT
2018-09-27 15:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
After receiving everyone's feedback and conducting our own examination, the following adjustments to game balance will be made related to EXP requirements for leveling up.
First, the amount of EXP needed to level up to Lv 51 and onwards will be reduced. Subsequent levels will see a more gradual increase in the amount of EXP needed.
As a result of this change, the sharp increase in EXP needed to level up each time from Lv 51 and onward will be relaxed. We expect that more players will therefore be able to take part in clearing each floor.
Additionally, as part of this adjustment to EXP requirements, the EXP earned from main quests will also be adjusted starting from floor 5.
Currently, main quest EXP is balanced in accordance to level up requirements determined prior to this adjustment. Earned EXP amounts will be adjusted in consideration of the new overall game balance.
Planned Adjustments Details:
･EXP requirements for leveling up to Lv 51 and onwards will be relaxed.
･EXP amounts earned for completing main quests from floor 5 and onwards will be adjusted.
After these balance adjustments have been applied, we plan to continue to monitor the situation and make further changes as needed.
Should you have any feedback that you wish to provide, please feel free to reach us at any time through the contact form.
We hope that you continue to enjoy Sword Art Online: Integral Factor.
Go to Notice List

news_list.snippet: Earlier this year, the Belgian Gaming Commission issued a report stating that certain forms of “loot boxes” will be considered as a form of gambling. While we do not share the views of the Belgian Gaming Commission on this point, we have decided to take steps to comply with their interpretation of B...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
Important Notice for Belgian Users
IMPORTANT
2018-09-20 14:25:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Earlier this year, the Belgian Gaming Commission issued a report stating that certain forms of “loot boxes” will be considered as a form of gambling. While we do not share the views of the Belgian Gaming Commission on this point, we have decided to take steps to comply with their interpretation of Belgian gambling laws.
Starting today, players in Belgium are no longer entitled, and will be unable, to purchase Arcana Gem or any item pack that contains those items. Belgian players will still however be able to use the Order feature using Arcana Gem that is earned through gameplay or that is given out as part of in-game events.
We understand that this will have an impact on the enjoyment of our players in Belgium, but we feel that we have no choice but to make these changes so that our fans can continue to play Sword Art Online Integral Factor.
We apologize for the inconvenience. If there is any change in the situation or an update to the Belgian Gaming Commission’s interpretation, we will let you know.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Silica appears as an Assisting Character !
UPDATE
2019-02-27 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The New Assisting Character Silica !
* Images show features in development, and these may differ from their final form in game.
The New Assisting Character Silica
Silica is now here as an Assisting Character.
* The Assisting Character Silica will be unlocked after completing the 8F Main Quest "Shadow of the Witch."
Create Assist Party Available on Normal Maps
You can now form Assist Parties on normal maps!
While Assist Parties could only be formed for certain dungeons in the past,
they can now be formed on normal maps as of this update.
Furthermore, once one of your Assisting Characters reaches Friendship Rank 15, you can form an Assist Party with a maximum of 2 Assisting Characters on normal maps and dungeons!
Dungeon
Assisting Characters within an Assist Party will automatically attack monsters that are within their range.
Normal Map
Assisting Characters within an Assist Party will only attack monsters that the player has attacked.
Creating Assist Parties
Form parties with Assisting Characters by going to Menu → Community → Party → Create Assist Party → Select a character to accompany → Form.
* Assist Parties cannot be formed on floors that the player has not cleared.
Damage to Assisting Characters reduces their HP, and after a certain point they will be temporarily immobilized.
* Assisting Characters' HP can be healed by various means, such as with party member HP restoration items like Emergency Crystals.
Immobilized Assisting Characters will automatically be revived after a certain time, but you can also help them up.
* Assisting Characters will not be visible to other players.
* When forming parties with Assisting Characters, they will be indicated with a "?" when on the same map as an identical character.
・
See here for more details on the Assist Function
Equipment Set Feature
You can save up to 8 currently equipped Weapons and Skill Records for yourself or your partners.
Save your favorite equipment sets!
You can also name your equipment sets.
Saving Equipment Sets
Save the Weapons and Skill Records you currently have equipped by going to Menu → Status → Player/Partner Equipment → Equipment Sets → Apply Set.
If the Player Equipment screen is on SET 1, it will be saved to SET 1. If it is on SET 2, it will be saved as SET 2's equipment.
Abilities set on the Armor screen will also be saved.
Favorite Stamps Feature
The feature to save your favorite Stamps has been added.
Saving Your Favorite Stamps
Save your favorite stamps by going to the Stamp screen, tapping Favorites, then holding down on the stamp you want to save.
Save your favorite stamps!
Your 16 most recently used stamps can also be found by going to the Stamp screen, then History.

- Starting Location
Blackiron Palace
Daily Dungeon
- Event Details
Daily Dungeons that can usually only be cleared once per day can be cleared twice per day for the duration of the event!
Daily Dungeons are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are seven varieties of Daily Dungeons to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP and equipment enhancement items.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets the next day at 4 AM (JST/UTC+9).
-Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]

-Event details
Talk to Event Guide in the Teleport Gate Plaza to go to the Event Map "New Year Town." From there, talk to Argo to accept the Event Dungeon.
[Event Part 1]
Event Dungeon "Defeat Horary Wolf!"
Defeat Horary Wolves in dungeon, and get many useful items like trading items, Hamaya Arrows and Arcana Gems!
*You can clear this dungeon up to 10 times per day.
*"Defeat Horary Wolf!" can be challenged with an Assist Party.
[Event Part 2]
Story quest and event dungeon "New Year's Wish"
Collect Hamaya Arrows and trade with various items!
The 4 Dungeons (Entry, Interior, Depth, and DANGER) that are unlocked after clearing the Story Quest can be challenged using Assist Parties.
Monsters in the dungeon Rowdy Boar, and Dark Fallen Boar, are strong monsters that have resistance towards multiple elements.
Challenge with weapons and Skill Records of their weak element!
Defeat Dark Fallen Boar and collect the trade item: Hamaya Arrows!
Trade in to useful items like ★4 Kirito's Skill Records and accessory avatars with collected Hamaya Arrows!
The 4 Dungeons (Entry, Interior, Depth, and DANGER) that are unlocked after clearing the Story Quest can be challenged using Assist Parties.
* Story quest cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
[High Level Dungeon]
High Level Dungeon will be added in the event dungeon "New Year's Wish" after the maintenance on January 9 (Wed).
You can clear the High Level Dungeon up to 3 times per day.
In addition, item use is restricted while inside the dungeon and Revive Crystals can only be used up to 3 times.
* Once you clear the dungeon 3 times, you can't challenge it again until the system resets the next day at 4:00 am (JST/UTC +9).
* The High Level Dungeon cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
"Assist Function" Implementation Notice
UPDATE
2018-12-06 16:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
New Assist Function Implemented!
* Images show features in development, and these may differ from their final form in game.
- Assist Function
Players can now interact with Kirito, Asuna, and their friends and challenge select dungeons alongside them.
Additionally, Kirito and his friends can equip Avatar Costumes and Skill Records.
*You can share Skill Records and Avatar Costumes between the player and your partner.
The Assist Function is unlocked once players clear the first floor of Aincrad.
You can check Assist Function from Menu→Community→Assisting Character.
- Assisting Character
Players can now interact with Assisting Characters and also give them gifts.
Additionally, you can trigger a special mechanic by tapping on the Assisting Character when they use a specific avatar!
"Interaction" is a mechanic you can perform with any of these characters up to 3 times per day that allows you to accrue Friendship EXP.
* Using the item "Golden Bells" will reset the number of remaining interactions.
When Friendship EXP is gained through "Interaction", the Assisting Character's Friendship Rank will increase and unlock character level caps, Skill Record slots, and usable Skill Record level limits.
When a character's Friendship Rank is 1, even if you equip a Level 70 Skill Record, its abilities will perform at the equivalent to a level 40.

Plus you will be able to get different items, and teach special skills to each character dependent on the type of "Interaction".
Learnable skills include "Proficiency Skills" and "Special Skills".
True to their name, Special Skills are a special type of Skill that Assisting Characters possess.
Equipping specific characters' Skill Records bestows them with a wide array of benefits such as increased attack power based on the number of Skill Records equipped.
From the "Gifts" option, players can give special items acquired from events and character interactions to Assisting Characters, earning Friendship EXP.
There are no limits to the number of gifts that can be given to Assisting Characters.
Each character also has different preferences when it comes to the types of gifts that they like to receive.
- Assist Party
With Assist Parties, players can form parties with Assisting Characters to challenge select dungeons.
Forming a party and clearing dungeons with Assisting Characters will also increase their level.
The equipment Assisting Characters have equipped will evolve into advanced equipment as their level increases.
Note that players cannot join a party with other players should they choose to challenge a dungeon with an Assist Party.
Assisting Characters within an Assist Party will automatically attack monsters that are within their range.
Damage to Assisting Characters reduces their HP, and after a certain point they will be temporarily immobilized.
* Assisting Characters' HP can be healed by various means, such as party member HP restoration items like Emergency Crystals.
Immobilized Assisting Characters will automatically revive after a certain time, but you will also be able to help them up.
Once players clear or escape from a dungeon, an Assist Party will be automatically disbanded.
If a player chooses to challenge a dungeon with an Assisting Character, that character's stamina will decrease by 1 point.
Their stamina will continue to decrease by 1 point per minute while the party is active.
Additionally, you can get the Assisting Character's Friendship EXP by using stamina.
If an Assisting Character runs out of stamina, they will no longer be able to be summoned to an Assist Party.
Running out of stamina in a dungeon greatly reduces your Assisting Character's attack.
* The item "Energy Fruit" can be used to restore an Assisting Character's stamina.
When an Assisting Character isn't part of an Assist Party, their stamina is restored at a rate of 1 point every two minutes.
* Assisting Characters' stamina will continue to be restored automatically even when logged out of the game.

How to Take On the Medusa Hunt
To try the Medusa Hunt, you will need Raid Boss Tickets acquired as challenge rewards in the first half Guild Event, the Ticket Collecting Dungeon.
Once you gather Raid Boss Tickets, use the Guild Room Guide NPC found in the Teleport Gate of the Town of Beginnings to move to your Guild Room, then try the event via the Raid Boss Dungeon NPC.
・

-Implemented new status ailment: Petrify
The nasty Petrify status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items and doubles the amount of damage received has been added in the Medusa Hunt.
Petrify is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
Be careful of attacks that can petrify you. Dodge them as you make your way through the event!
-Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the Guild Counter NPC.
During the Guild Event, the Guild Counter NPC will appear in both the Merchant District and the Teleport Gate Plaza in the Town of Beginnings!
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Ranking Battles.
Raise your Guild Level and gather Guild Points in preparation for the Guild Ranking Battles.
Please see below for more details on guilds.

-Important
* You cannot attempt the Medusa Hunt if you are not a member of a Guild.
* Your partner will not participate in the Medusa Hunt.
* This cannot be joined with an Assist Party.
* Raid Boss Tickets are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
* The amount of Raid Boss Tickets held can be checked via the main guild screen.
* Up to 9,999 Raid Boss Tickets can be held.
* Each guild can only attempt one difficulty of Medusa Hunt dungeon at a time. The difficulty of the player who first enters the dungeon can be attempted.
* The total score is a number of points shared between Guild members. It is added to after each battle. It is not the total score of all the members added up.
* If the Ranking Battle comes to an end during the Medusa Hunt, any post-completion score will not be added.
* Please note that Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still count down during maintenance.
* If you join a guild on or after May 2, 2019 (Thu) 0:00 (JST/UTC+9) after the Ranking Battle ends, you will not be able to receive Ranking Rewards.
* If you leave a guild between May 2, 2019 (Thu) 0:00 (JST/UTC+9) after the Ranking Battle ends and when ranking rewards are distributed, you will not be able to receive Ranking Rewards. Please be careful.
* Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
*

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Limited-Time Event "Crimson Sword and Silver Witch" is here!　 High Level Dungeon Added
EVENT
2019-05-08 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
"Crimson Sword and Silver Witch" begins after the maintenance on April 24, 2019 (Wed)!
-Event Period
Starts after the April 24, 2019 (Wed) Maintenance and ends before the May 29, 2019 (Wed) Maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
The High Level Dungeon was added after the maintenance on May 8, 2019 (Wed).
* Items may be traded up until the June 5, 2019 (Wed) maintenance begins (JST/UTC+9).
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
-Event details
Sanya, the character selected in the "SAO Game Series 5th Anniversary Original Avatar Recruitment," will appear in the main story of "Crimson Sword and Silver Witch."
Sanya was selected from an entry by an individual going by the name of "さんち&ルル".
Gather "Crimson Jewels," tradable items acquired as event rewards and Drop Items, and get a ★3 Sanya Skill Record!
You can also get Arcana Gems and more by completing the event story and through Score Rewards.
5 Dungeons (Entry, Interior, Depth, DANGER, and Special) become available to challenge after you clear the Story Quest!
* Sanya will be your partner in these 5 dungeons.
* This event will be a solo dungeon.
The High Level Dungeon was added after the maintenance on May 8, 2019 (Wed).
You can clear the High Level Dungeon three times per day.
In addition, item use is restricted while inside the dungeon and Revive Crystals can only be used up to 3 times.
* Once you clear the dungeon, you can't challenge it again until the system resets at 4:00 am (JST/UTC+9).

（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
The new Petrification status ailment was added as of the April 24, 2019 (Wed) maintenance.
New status ailment: Petrify
Petrify, the nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items and doubles the amount of damage received, has been implemented.
Petrify is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
Be careful of monster attacks that can petrify you!
Set invincibility time when coming back from the verge of death
Adjustments have been made so that players and Assisting Characters do not receive damage for a few seconds after recovering from the verge of death.
Times when invincibility is applied
* When players use a Revive Crystal while on the verge of death
* When a party member helps you and brings you back
* When an Assisting Character recovers from the verge of death

-Event details
The Ticket Collecting Dungeon is an event in which players will gather Raid Boss Tickets required for the second half of the Guild Ranking Event, "Medusa Hunt", scheduled to be held after the maintenance on April 24, 2019 (Wed).
Raid Boss Tickets can be earned as challenge rewards from the Ticket Collecting Dungeon.
The higher the Dungeon's difficulty, the more Raid Boss Tickets you can get as a reward!
You can complete challenges that give you Raid Boss Tickets multiple times.
Go gather Raid Boss Tickets so that you'll be ready for the later Medusa Hunt Guild Ranking Event!
Guilds who make it to the top of the Medusa Hunt rankings will receive the "Snake Queen's Hair" accessory Avatar themed on the boss monster Medusa!
Snake Queen's Hair is an Avatar with hair that dangles back and forth when you move!
You can also create accessory Avatars and shield Avatars using items that drop from boss monster Medusa!
Accessory Avatars will be stamped with your guild icon.

Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with the Ranking Battles scheduled for the second half of the Guild Event.
Raise your Guild Level and gather Guild Points in preparation for the second half of the Guild Event.

Notices
Important Notice Concerning the End of pre-iOS 9.0 Support
IMPORTANT
2019-03-13 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
As of the update on March 13 ,2019 (Wed), pre-iOS version 9.0 support has now ended.
Following the update, any iOS versions below 9.0 will no longer be supported.
The development team of "SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor" will continue to work hard in providing better service to all of our users. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your patience and understanding.
--------------------
We are planning to end pre-iOS version 9.0 support with an update that will be released on March 13, 2019 (Wed).
After this update, your current iOS version will no longer be supported. We recommend that you either update your device to a later iOS version or transfer your account to an iOS device running iOS 9 or higher.
--------------------
Notice for those users logging on to "SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor."
In order to provide new features and improved usability for the iOS version of "SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor," we will soon be ceasing support for all versions of iOS below version 9.0 in an upcoming update.
The date for this update will be announced at a later time once it has been decided.
After this update, your current iOS version will no longer be supported. If your device is running iOS 8.4.1 or below, please either update your device to a later iOS version or transfer your account to an iOS device running iOS 9 or higher.
- How to Check Your Device's iOS Version
Settings → General → About → Version
* Some steps may differ based on the device that you are using.
- Transferring Your Account to Another Device
Preparing Your Account for Transfer
On your current device, tap the "Menu" button in the upper-left corner of the title screen. Then, tap the "Create Transfer ID" button.
After tapping the "Create Transfer ID" button, you'll be taken to the Transfer ID creation page, where your Transfer ID will be generated. You will also be asked to set a password for the transfer process.
Once you've completed these steps, be sure to record both your generated Transfer ID and password and save it for later.
Transferring Your Account
On your new device, tap the "Menu" button in the upper-left corner of the title of the screen. Then, tap the "Enter Transfer ID" button.
After tapping the "Enter Transfer ID" button, you'll be taken to the Transfer ID input page, where you'll be asked to enter your Transfer ID, as well as the password that you previously set.
If there are no problems with the information that you've entered, the transfer will be complete.
*Before entering a Transfer ID,please close the app on the first device.Transfers may not be executed correctly.
The development team of "SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor" will continue to work hard in providing better service to all of our users. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your patience and understanding.

Daily Dungeons that can usually only be cleared once per day can be cleared twice per day for the duration of the event!
Daily Dungeons are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are seven varieties of Daily Dungeons to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP and equipment enhancement items.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets the next day at 4 AM (JST/UTC+9).

Dungeon where you can either earn items that increase the drop rate or EXP earned can only be cleared once a day. Only one of the two item types can be selected per day.

Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
Fishing rod effects are being increased overall to make it easier to distinguish between each type's strengths and weaknesses.
ｰPlanned Adjustment Date
During the August 7, 2019 (Wed) maintenance.
ｰPlanned Adjustments Details
Fishing Rod Status Adjustments
Adjusted to have the fish's strength deplete with "Good" timing based on the Power and Control values.
Adjusted to have the fish's strength greatly deplete with "Perfect" timing based on Technic values.
For this round of adjustments, we have clarified and strengthened the differences between rod types.
ｰControl, High Control, and Royal Control Rods
The timing gauge slows down to make getting a "Perfect" easier.
These fishing rods are perfect for catching fish with fast timing gauges.
ｰTechnical, High Technical, and Royal Technical Rods
Although the timing gauge speeds up, these rods decrease the fish's strength the most with "Perfect" timing.
These fishing rods give you an advantage against fish with lots of strength when you have "Perfect" timing.
ｰPowerful, High Powerful, and Royal Powerful Rods
Both "Perfect" and "Good" timings will reduce a moderate amount of the fish's strength.
These fishing rods are easy to use and have no special quirks.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Fishing season opens with the new Fishing Ver. 1.0!
UPDATE
2019-07-17 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Fishing season opens with the new Fishing Ver. 1.0!
The Limited-Time Event "Will of Steel to Catch the King" featuring the new fishing mechanic is now available.
See here for more details on the Limited-Time Event "Will of Steel to Catch the King".
Fishing Area
Fishing is available on the shores near either a fish sign or where a fish icon is displayed on the mini-map.
* The map you fish on and the bait you use will affect your catch.
* Fishing will only be available in the event field as of the July 17, 2019 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC +9).
* You must complete the Main Quest "The Indomitable Fang" to take part in this event.
* You can travel to the special map via the NPC Nishida.
We plan to add further features and fishing areas in future updates.
We hope you're looking forward to them!
Fishing Preparation
When players enter a fishing area, the normal attack button in the lower right of the screen will become a start fishing button.
Tapping the start fishing button will take you to the fishing preparation screen.
Tap the icons in the upper left of the screen to equip a fishing rod and bait.
You can purchase fishing rods and bait from the Merchant.
You can also make fishing rods at the workshop if you have the right production materials.
You can trade for fishing rod production materials at the Fish Trader.
* Players start with the "Fishing Rod borrowed from Nishida" equipped.
Players can use the Fishing Rod borrowed from Nishida up until they equip a new fishing rod.
* Using different types and rarities of baits will make certain fish easier or harder to catch.
After you've equipped a fishing rod and bait, tap the cast button in the lower right of the screen to start fishing.
How to Fish
When the fish bites your bait, a blue exclamation mark and hook gauge will appear.
Tap the hook button in the lower right of the screen while the hook gauge is visible to hook the fish.
The orange exclamation marks that display when you hook the fish indicate the fish's rarity.
More exclamation marks indicate a higher rarity.
After hooking the fish, a timing gauge, HP gauge, hook icons (hook points), and Escape will appear.
Timing Gauge
There are three timing categories: Perfect (Lime Green), Good (Pale Green), and Miss (Purple).
Perfect
: Greatly decreases the fish's HP.
Good
: Decreases the fish's HP, but also increases Escape.
Miss
: Increases Escape.
Time-Out
: After the timing gauge increases and decreases 3 times, it will time out and the fish's Escape will increase.
HP Gauge
Tapping the timing button in the bottom right of the screen with good timing will decrease the fish's HP. Once it reaches 0, you can catch the fish.
Escape
The higher the Escape, the higher the chance your hook points will decrease.
Hook Points
The fish will escape once you have lost all three hook points.
* You can lose hook points even with Perfect timing, depending on how high Escape is.
Your Catch
When you successfully catch a fish, you will also earn FExp (Fishing Experience).
You can trade the fish you've caught for fishing rod production materials and other items at the Trader.
Gaining FExp will raise your fishing level.
Check the Status screen for more details, accessible from the preparation screen that displays after you tap the start fishing button in fishing areas.
Fishing Rods
Raising your fishing level will allow you to equip different rods that match your level.
* You are able to produce or purchase any rod, even if you aren't leveled enough to equip them.
Tap the fish icon in the Merchant screen to view the purchasable rods.
Tap the item icon in the workshop to view rods that can be produced.
* For more details on the stats and required levels of individual rods, tap and hold each fishing rod icon on the fishing preparation screen (viewable after you select start fishing in a fishing area).

* Cleared dungeons will be reset the following day at 4:00am (JST/UTC+9) and can be re-attempted after that.
* Cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
Challenge the dungeon alongside characters that appear in the Event Story.
The characters you can complete the dungeon together with depend on the difficulty you choose.
If you clear the Event Story and talk to NPC Asuna, you'll be able to go to the Night Beach.
Fireworks light the sky at the Night Beach from 19:00 to 24:00.

Notices
Hunting Event "Pirate with a demon sword" is here!
EVENT
2019-06-26 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Following the maintenance on June 26, 2019 (Wed), the Pirate with a demon sword will begin.
-Event Period
Starts after the June 26, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the July 10, 2019 Maintenance(JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
-Event details
Gather the Pirate Medal as dungeon score rewards or Special Area drops and get your hands on Medal of Combat Arts early from achievement rewards to use at the upcoming Trader! There are also Records you can pick up!
You can earn lots of weapon proficiency items such as Martial Arts Texts and Release Crystals!
You can also get some Medal of Combat Arts from an upcoming event.
A special Trader will be available at a later date.
Past event rewards, such as Skill Records, Avatar Costumes, and Weapon Avatars will be featured in the lineup.
Plus, Integral Series transformation and production materials are also planned to be in the lineup!
Participate in the events and gather Medal of Combat Arts.
The guide NPCs will be heating summer up in their swimsuits too!

Skill Records that can activate Burst or appear in the Descent of the Four Guardians Order are eligible for the Pirate with a demon sword Special Bonus.
The Boss Monster will launch a massively wide-ranged attack...?!
Smart use of the invincibility period provided during Burst is your key to success.
Make good use of Burst!
You can clear the High Level Dungeon three times per day.
In addition, item use is restricted while inside the dungeon and Revive Crystals can only be used up to 3 times.
* Cleared dungeons will be reset the following day at 4:00am (JST/UTC+9) and can be re-attempted after that.

The rare, high-level Integral Series transformation and production materials are now available!
Collect the material items "Half Beast Armament Stone" and "Core Metal" from extremely rare boss drops on 14F to transform or produce Integral Series equipment!
Transform and fill the Integral Series with a golden aura!
Transforming Integral Series Equipment
STEP1
Produce "Stone++" transformation materials at the workshop.
In order to produce a "Stone++" you will need "Stone+", and "Core Metal" from 14F boss drops.
* The production recipe for "Stone++" will be available after completing 13F.
* Each "Stone++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: Transforming 1H Swords or Daggers will require a "Slicing Stone++" made from "Slicing Stone+" and "Core Metal".
STEP2
Transform Integral Series equipment at a blacksmith using "Stone++" and the 14F boss drop "Half Beast Armament Stone".
STEP3
Transformation materials from a future floor update will allow you to transform Integral Series equipment even further!
We hope you look forward to it!
Producing Integral Series Equipment
The materials "Half Beast Armament Stone" and the 14F boss drop "Half Beast's Horn" can be used to produce Integral Series equipment.
* The base statuses will not be different to Integral Series equipment that can be produced on 13F.
* Production recipes that use "Half Beast Armament Stone" and "Half Beast's Horn" will be available upon completing 13F.

- Participation Requirements
Complete 1F Main Quest "Labyrinth Strategy"
-Event details
Use the "My Favorite Ticket" earned as dungeon Score Rewards to vote for your favorite character!
You can vote for Kirito, Asuna, Silica, or Yuuki, who all appear as Assisting Characters.
*You can get a maximum of 90 "My Favorite Tickets".
The character with the most votes will later be turned into a Skill Record given to all players!

- How to Vote
Vote by going to the Trader NPC, tapping the "Best Friend Poll Booth" banner, then exchanging "My Favorite Ticket" with a gift for your favorite character.
You can also exchange items for "My Favorite Ticket" to vote for your favorite character by going to Menu → Item → Enhance/Trade → Trade Limited Items, then tapping the "Best Friend Poll Booth" banner.
The gifts you receive when voting are items that can be given as presents to characters to raise your affinity with them.
You can also receive special Records by acquiring 50 gifts for each character!
You can also receive "Friend Medal" as event rewards and drops that can be exchanged for Friendship Badges, Equipment Transformation materials, and more.
*Friendship Badge will be a Limit Break item used only for the Skill Record distributed at a later date.
A Special Bonus will be valid during the "Best Friend Poll Event" dungeon.
If you clear the dungeon with compatible Skill Records equipped, you'll receive a large additional score bonus!
The Skill Records that appear in Yuuki's Birthday Order and the June Bride Order are eligible as Special Bonuses in "Best Friend Poll Event."
* June Bride Order will be available from June 1 (Sat) 0:00 (JST/UTC+9).

Notices
The Limited-Time "Bride's dress is with a Smile" Event is Here!
EVENT
2019-06-19 14:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Following the maintenance on June 5, 2019 (Wed), the Bride's dress is with a Smile will begin.
This event will be split into three parts.
-Event Period
Part 1: Starts after the June 5, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the June 26, 2019 Maintenance.
Part 2: Starts after the June 12, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the June 26, 2019 Maintenance.
Part 3: Starts after the June 19, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the June 26, 2019 Maintenance.
Items may be traded up until the July 3, 2019 Maintenance begins.

This event will be split into three parts.

High-Level Integral Series 3rd Level Transformation Unveiled!

How to Transform to the 3rd Level
STEP1
Get the Integral Series to ★4 (2nd Level Transformation)!
・
Transform Integral Series to ★4 here.

Produce the transformation material "Stone++" necessary for the ★5 Integral Series!

Transform Integral Series equipment at a Blacksmith using "Stone++" and the 20F boss drop "One-Eyed Beast Armament Stone".
Producing Integral Series Equipment
Produce the Integral Series equipment with the material item "One-Eyed Beast Armament Stone" and the "One-Eyed Beast Fang" dropped by the 20F boss.
* The base statuses will not be different to Integral Series equipment that can be produced on 13F & 14F.
* Production recipes that use "One-Eyed Beast Armament Stone" and "One-Eyed Beast Fang" will be available upon completing 14F.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
About the iOS 13 Update
IMPORTANT
2019-09-18 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Thank you very much for playing SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor.
We expect that Apple Inc. will release the new iOS 13 soon.
There is a possibility that parts of the game will not function normally right after the new update.
We ask that players use caution when updating.
We recommend doing the following as a safeguard for potential game data loss or other issues.
Create a Data Transfer ID & Password
On your current device, tap the "Menu" button in the upper-left corner of the title screen. Then, tap the "Create Transfer ID" button.
After tapping the "Create Transfer ID" button, you'll be taken to the Transfer ID creation page, where your Transfer ID will be generated. You will also be asked to set a password for the transfer process.
Once you've completed these steps, be sure to record both your generated Transfer ID and password and save it for later.
Many players have lost screenshots of this information as a result of lost or broken phones.
We recommend recording your Transfer ID and password somewhere aside from your smartphone.
As always, thank you for playing. We hope that you continue to enjoy Sword Art Online: Integral Factor.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Notice for maintenance (9/12)
MAINT.
2019-09-18 12:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
[9/12 16:30 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]
Maintenance we have implemented from September 12, 2019, 15:30, was completed on September 12, 2019,16:30(JST/UTC+9).
- Content to be Fixed 1
・We will be fixing an issue where the item that was supposed to drop from the "Chaos Boss Dungeon・Black False Statue" was the "Black Colossal's stones from abyss" instead of the intended item "Black False Statue Stone".
Problem Occurrence Period
Starts after the September 11, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the September 12, 2019 Maintenance
Details of the Compensation
Affected Players
Players who could not obtain the item "Black False Statue Stone" during the period of occurrence.
Present Items
We will distribute the same number of "Black False Statue Stone" as the number of "Black Colossal's stones from abyss" that were obtained from "Colossus Chaos" during the period of occurrence.
Scheduled Distribution Period
Starts after the September 18, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the October 16, 2019 Maintenance
- Content to be Fixed 2
We will be fixing an issue where players were unable to achieve the challenge "Defeat all enemies (Able to achieve repeatedly)", from the [Returning] Another World event on difficulty "Special", once being defeated once.
Problem Occurrence Period
Starts after the September 11, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the September 12, 2019 Maintenance
Details of the Compensation
Affected Players
Players who challenged the [Returning] Another World event on difficulty "Special"
Present Items
300 Blue Rose Fragment
Scheduled Distribution Period
Starts after the September 18, 2019 Maintenance and ends before the October 16, 2019 Maintenance
Additionally, 50 Arcana Gems will be rewarded to players as compensation until the start of maintenance on Sept 18, 2019 (Weds).
Once again, we apologize for any inconvenience and trouble that this issue has caused.
We hope that you continue to enjoy SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor.
-----------------------------
We will be implementing maintenance to correspond to defects in effect within the scheduled dates down below.
We will be fixing an issue where the item that was supposed to drop from the "Chaos Boss Dungeon・Black False Statue" was the "Black Colossal's stones from abyss" instead of the intended item "Black False Statue Stone".
We will be fixing an issue where players were unable to achieve the challenge "Defeat all enemies (Able to achieve repeatedly)", from the [Returning] Another World event on difficulty "Special", once being defeated once.
Scheduled Maintenance dates
September 12, 2019 15:30 to 16:30 (Tentative)(JST/UTC+9)
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
Go to Notice List

Daily Dungeons +2 on now!
EVENT
2019-12-25 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
-Period
Starts after the December 25, 2019 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 8, 2020 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
* Daily Dungeons are updated daily at 4:00am. After this, the previous day's dungeons cannot be attempted.(JST/UTC+9)
* Daily Dungeons that have been cleared prior to the December 25 (Wed) maintenance can be attempted and cleared a second time once maintenance is complete.
* Daily Dungeons can be cleared three times during the period starting at 4:00am on January 8(Wed) and lasting until maintenance begins on January 8 (Wed).(JST/UTC+9)
Please note that Daily Dungeons cleared for the first time following the January 8(Wed) maintenance can only be attempted once per day.(JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
- Starting Location
Blackiron Palace
Daily Dungeon
Event details
Two attempts have been added to Daily Dungeons, so now players can clear them three times per day!
Daily Dungeons are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of Daily Dungeons to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP, equipment enhancement materials, and transformation materials.
* The Daily Dungeon "Skill Transformation Version" will become the "Skill Transform & Awaken Version" as of the maintenance on December 25 (Wed).
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets at 4 AM (JST/UTC+9).
-Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
–See here for more details on "Daily Dungeons"!
- Changes to Daily Dungeon "EXP Version" Challenge Rewards

2019-12-21 12:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Season's greetings. This is the management team for SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor.

[Duration]
December 28, 2019 (Sat) - January 5, 2020 (Sun)

Any inquiries received during this period that require substantial attention from the management and/or development teams will be processed starting on January 6, 2020 (Mon) in the order that they were received.
Please note that we expect to receive a high volume of support inquiries during this period.

news_list.snippet: New features Skill Record Awakening and Rush Recollection will be added to the game as of November 29.  You will be able to awaken and upgrade the Awakening Level using the Awakening materials Awakening Star and Jewels. Awakening skill records will be able to use a powerful temporary boost called "R...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
Skill Record Awakening and Rush Recollection implemented!
UPDATE
2019-11-29 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
New features Skill Record Awakening and Rush Recollection will be added to the game as of November 29.
You will be able to awaken and upgrade the Awakening Level using the Awakening materials Awakening Star and Jewels.
Awakening skill records will be able to use a powerful temporary boost called "Rush Recollection", granting you "Recollection Skill" that give you an advantage in combat.
■Rush Recollection
Activating Rush Recollection will grant you baseline effects that temporarily increase your speed, max HP, and damage dealt.
Equipping multiple Awakening skill records will enhance their max HP and damage boosting effects in correlation to the set's total Awakening Level.
■Recollection Skill
Recollection Skill are bonus effects that activate at the same time as Rush Recollection and differ depending on the Skill Record you Awakening.
Recollection Skill effectiveness will be bolstered with each Awakening Level.
Plus, all Recollection Skill will activate when you equip multiple Awakening skill records.
* Awakening skill records will activate even if their equipment type differs.
* Partners and Assisting Characters can't use Rush Recollection even if they equip Awakening skill records.
■Counter Your Enemy's Formidable Chaos Recollection Damage-Reduction Buff
You'll find this useful in fights against Boss Monsters with Chaos Recollection, a powerful buff that reduces incoming damage.
Damage boosted by Rush Recollection will pierce your opponent's defenses by nullifying the Chaos Recollection damage reduction effect.
Use it strategically to turn the battle in your favor.

■Enhancing Rush Recollection Max HP and Damage Boosts
Effectiveness increases in accordance to the number of Awakening skill records and Awakening Level.
Equipping 1 Awakening skill records gives you a 20% boost, plus 2% for each Awakening Level.
Enhancement Example:
Equipping 1 Skill Record at Awakening Level 1 gives you a 22% boost to max HP and damage during Rush Recollection
Equipping 1 Skill Record at Awakening Level 2 gives you a 24% boost to max HP and damage during Rush Recollection
Equipping 2 Skill Records at Awakening Level 2 gives you a 28% boost to max HP and damage during Rush Recollection
■Rush Gauge
The Rush gauge automatically fills up over time and recovers completely when you enter a safe area such as a town.
The more the gauge fills, the longer you will be able to activate Rush Recollection.
*Gauge will continue to be restored automatically even when logged out of the game.

■How to Perform Awakening
Speak to the blacksmith NPC and select a Skill Record.
You can use materials from the Awakening tab on the left to perform Awakening.
* The type and amount of materials required will differ depending on each Skill Record.
* Awakening  have a certain chance to succeed and some may produce a "Fail" result.
■Aura Size and Color
Players will gain an Aura when Rush Recollection activates, and traces of the Aura will remain while the skill is active.
The Aura will increase in size for each Awakening skill records in the same set.
The color of the Aura also corresponds to the set's total Skill Record Awakening Level.

・Please be aware that deleting the app does not cancel this subscription.
-Cancellation
・Cancellation may be completed through the following procedure.
1. Open Google Play Store
2. You can manage your subscriptions by tapping Menu = > Subscriptions
3. Press "Cancel Subscription" in "SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor" to cancel the subscription.
