news_list.full_details:
Notices
Daily Dungeons +2 is here! Clear it up to 3 times a day!
EVENT
2020-06-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Two attempts have been added to Daily Dungeons, so now players can clear them three times per day!
Daily Dungeons are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of Daily Dungeons to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP, equipment enhancement materials, and transformation materials.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets the next day at 4 AM (JST/UTC+9).
Event Start
Blackiron Palace
Daily Dungeon
Period
Starts after the June 10, 2020 Maintenance - June 17, 2020 Maintenance（JST/UTC+9)
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
List of Daily Dungeons
Weapon Proficiency Enhancement Version(Weapon Proficiency items attainable)
Attainable Items:
Martial Arts Text, Release Crystals (S), Release Crystals (M), Release Crystals (L),Revive Crystals
EXP Version (Recovery items and EXP attainable)
Attainable Items:
EXP, Exp Crystals S, Restorative Potion, Revive Crystals
Col Version (Col attainable)
Attainable Items:
Col,Revive Crystals
Skill Enhancement Version(Skill Record enhancement materials attainable)
Attainable Items:
Record Frame S, Record Frame M, Record Frame L, Col, Revive Crystals
Equipment Enhancement Version (Equipment enhancement materials attainable)
Attainable Items:
Glare Stones, Glare Rigid Stones, Glare Dragon Stones, Col, Revive Crystals
Equipment Transformation Version (Equipment transformation materials attainable)
Attainable Items:
Slicing Stones, Piercing Stones, Striking Stones, Blocking Stones, Refining Hammers
Slicing Stones+, Piercing Stones+, Striking Stones+, Blocking Stones+, Refining Hammers+, Revive Crystals
Skill Transform & Awaken Version.
- Skill Transform & Awaken Ver./R (Get Skill Record awakening material and Red Jewel transformation material)
Attainable Items:
Awakening Stars, Star Fragments, Red Jewels, High Red Jewels, Great Red Jewels, Record Kit S, Record Kit M, Revive Crystals
- Skill Transform & Awaken Ver./G (Get Skill Record awakening material and Green Jewel transformation material)
Attainable Items:
Awakening Stars, Star Fragments, Green Jewels, High Green Jewels, Great Green Jewels, Record Kit S, Record Kit M, Revive Crystals
- Skill Transform & Awaken Ver./Y (Get Skill Record awakening material and Yellow Jewel transformation material)
Attainable Items:
Awakening Stars, Star Fragments, Yellow Jewels, High Yellow Jewels, Great Yellow Jewels, Record Kit S, Record Kit M, Revive Crystals
- Skill Transform & Awaken Ver./B (Get Skill Record awakening material and Blue Jewel transformation material)
Attainable Items:
Awakening Stars, Star Fragments, Blue Jewels, High Blue Jewels, Great Blue Jewels, Record Kit S, Record Kit M, Revive Crystals
* Daily Dungeons are updated daily at 4:00am. After this, the previous day's dungeons cannot be attempted.(JST/UTC+9)
* Daily Dungeons that have been cleared prior to the June 10 (Wed) maintenance can be attempted and cleared a second time once maintenance is complete.
* Daily Dungeons can be cleared three times during the period starting at 4:00am on June 17(Wed) and lasting until maintenance begins on June 17 (Wed).(JST/UTC+9)
Please note that Daily Dungeons cleared for the first time following the June 17(Wed) maintenance can only be attempted once per day.(JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Event details
The 2nd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is a ranking Event where guilds compete for ranks based on their total point score.
Create a guild of up to 30 members and aim for the top of the ranking charts.
To challenge the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon, you'll need to gather 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket from the Ticket Collecting Dungeon.
You can get the tickets as challenge rewards by clearing any difficulty of the Ticket Collecting Dungeon.
* The 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket you receive from the Ticket Collecting Dungeon will be deleted during maintenance on May 27 (Wed).
* 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
* The amount of 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket held can be checked via the main guild screen.

The higher the Dungeon's difficulty, the more you can score!
You can get 5 each of all kinds of Great Jewels as Ranking Total Score Rewards.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 2nd GoG Ranking banner.
Guild members who make it to the top of the rankings will get the
"Devil Helm B" and "Devil Cape B" accessory avatars themed on the boss monster Masquerade Demon, Arcana Gems, 2nd GoG Medal and Records, Medal of Unity
, and more!
Devil Helm B comes with your guild emblem.
Plus, you can open and close the visor on this avatar using emotes.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the Guild Counter NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Ranking Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild

Important
Each guild will be able to increase their total score during the 2nd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
In exchange, Raid Boss Dungeon score rewards will become unavailable.
Scores earned before the ranking period will be carried over to Raid Boss Dungeons after the ranking period.
* The total score in the 2nd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members and is added to after each battle. It is not the total score of all the members added up.
* When the total score reaches a certain amount in the 2nd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event, a reward will be sent to all current guild members at that time.
* To check the total score rewards for the 2nd "Guild of Guilds"Ranking Event, go to the top-left Menu > Community > Ranking > 2nd GoG Ranking banner.
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the [Ticket Collecting Dungeon].
Your partner will not participate in the solo Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon.
This event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
Each guild can only attempt one difficulty of the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon at a time. The difficulty level attempted will be that of the player who first enters the dungeon.
If the Ranking Event comes to an end during the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon, any post-completion score will not be added.
If you join a guild during or after the May 27, 2020 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive Ranking Rewards.
* Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.

Rare Nox Integral Series transformation and production materials are now available!
Collect the material item "Crossgigas Armament Stone" as an extremely rare drop from the 27F boss, Dallos the Crossgigas, and
"Core Metals" as extremely rare drops from 14F and higher floor bosses to transform or produce the Nox Integral Series!
Transform

Transforming Nox Integral Series Equipment
STEP1
Produce "Stone++" transformation materials at the workshop.
In order to produce "Stone++", you will need "Stone+" and "Core Metal".
* Each "Stone++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: Transforming 1H Swords or Daggers will require a "Slicing Stone++" made from "Slicing Stone+" and "Core Metal".
STEP2
Transform Nox Integral Series equipment at the blacksmith using "Stone++" and "Crossgigas Armament Stone".
STEP3
Transformation materials from a future floor update will allow you to transform Nox Integral Series equipment even further!
We hope you look forward to it!
Producing Nox Integral Series Equipment
The materials "Crossgigas Armament Stone" and "Crossgigas Iron Chain" can be used to produce Nox Integral Series equipment.

You can earn the new Medal of Unity by winning a spot in the monthly Guild Rankings. Use the item at the exclusive Trader.
You can exchange for avatars and awakening materials exclusive to the Guild Ranking Event.
Differences from the 1st Guild of Guilds
Because the 2nd "Guild of Guilds" is a ranking event, it differs from the first on three points.
·The 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket used to take on Raid Bosses are only necessary during the ranking period.
*The ranking event is scheduled to start after the maintenance on the 20th, but you will be able to collect 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket and prepare from after the maintenance on the 13th.
Gathering tickets will give you an edge in the rankings.
·The NPC Ticket Collecting Dungeon will be available following the maintenance on May 13 and will become unavailable after maintenance on May 27.
*The Ticket Collecting Dungeon will not be available after the ranking event ends since 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket are not needed when the event is finished.
*The Ticket Collecting Dungeon is only available for a limited amount of time.
·During the ranking period, the Raid Boss will drop Record Kit M, Record Frame M, and all kinds of Jewels/High Jewels instead of production materials and Restorative Potions.
There's a chance that Star Fragments will drop at DANGER or Special difficulties.
Healing items and Record Frames will replace production material as challenge rewards.
Use the drop items or challenge rewards to enhance your skills and take on the rankings.
Important
Each guild will be able to increase their total score during the 2nd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
In exchange, Raid Boss Dungeon score rewards will become unavailable.
Scores earned before the ranking period will be carried over to Raid Boss Dungeons after the ranking period.
* The total score in the 2nd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members and is added to after each battle. It is not the total score of all the members added up.
* When the total score reaches a certain amount in the 2nd "Guild of Guilds"Ranking Event, a reward will be sent to all current guild members at that time.
* To check the total score rewards for the 2nd "Guild of Guilds"Ranking Event, go to the top-left Menu > Community > Ranking > 2nd GoG Ranking banner.
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
*You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the [Ticket Collecting Dungeon].
The 2nd GoG Raid Boss Ticket you receive from the Ticket Collecting Dungeon will be deleted during maintenance on May 27 (Wed).
2nd GoG Raid Boss Tickets are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of 2nd GoG Raid Boss Tickets held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Your partner will not participate in the solo Raid Boss Dungeon.
This event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.

Starting October 1, 2020, those using unsupported devices will be unable to download or update SWORD ART ONLI...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
End of Pre-iOS 11 Support
IMPORTANT
2020-08-05 12:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Thank you very much for playing SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor.
Because of the new features in the upcoming update, the support for pre-iOS 11 devices will end as of September 30, 2020.
Starting October 1, 2020, those using unsupported devices will be unable to download or update SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor from the store, and will be unable to play.
We sincerely apologize to those affected. Please consider upgrading your iOS version or switching to a device compatible with iOS 11 or above. Thank you for your understanding.
[How to Check Your Device's iOS Version]
Settings > General > About > Software Version
* Some steps may differ based on the device that you are using.
If you change your device, you can continue to enjoy the game by logging in with the account you registered for transfer.
* Please be sure to register for transfer in advance, as we will not be able to handle accounts lost during data transfer or after support has ended.
[Data Transfer]
- Transfer Registration -
On your current device, tap the "Menu" button in the upper-left corner of the title screen. Then, tap "Transfer" > "Transfer Registration".
After tapping the "Transfer Registration" button, you can register your Google Account/Apple ID, or set a password for your Transfer ID.
* If you use the latter method, please write down or take a screenshot of your Transfer ID and password.
- Transfer -
On your current device, tap the "Menu" button in the upper-left corner of the title screen. Then, tap "Transfer" > "Transfer".
After tapping the second "Transfer" button, select the Google Account/Apple ID you registered for transfer, or input your Transfer ID and password.
If there are no problems with the information that you've entered, the data transfer will be complete.
* Before transferring, please close the app on the original device. Otherwise, the transfer may not be executed correctly.
Thank you for your patience and understanding as we continue to work hard in providing better service to all of our users.
We hope that you continue to enjoy SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor.
Go to Notice List

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Protect the Crystals from the attacking mushrooms! Defense Battle ver.2"Attack of the Mush Golem!" Returning now!
EVENT
2020-07-30 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Protect the Crystals from the onslaught of monsters in this Returning now Defense Battle event!
For this event, you can challenge the dungeon with multiple parties in a group. The player with the highest score in the group will be named the MVP on the results screen after clearing the dungeon.
There are Crystals in three locations on the map. The less damage done to them, and the faster the monsters are driven back, the higher your score.
Work with your allies to protect the Crystals and try for a high score to get nice rewards.
Rewards
Get the "M Golem Medal" from the event and exchange it for
"Mush Head" and "Mush Hood" avatars
.
Plus, this Trader features "Medals of Combat Arts", the awakening material "Awakening Star", and "Release Crystals" used for learning proficiency skills!
"Memoria Niter S" was added to the score rewards for the Returning now event.
Get up to
250 Arcana Gems
from the entire event!
- There's a chance that the monsters that appear will drop "Release Crystals (S)".
There's a chance that "Star Fragments" will drop at Maniac and Expert difficulties.
Get rare items and lots of EXP by using Boost Mode to increase the Drop Rate and EXP obtained!
See here for more details on Boost Mode.
How to Participate
Talk to the "Defense Battle" NPC at the Teleport Gate Plaza to challenge it.
Groups
- Talk to the "Defense Battle" NPC, select the difficulty, and choose "Challenge with group" to create or join a group.
- When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
- Once the group is formed, you will be able to move from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
- If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
- Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
- For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.
Participation Requirements
- Normal:Complete Main quest [To Keep Moving Forward][5F]
- Advanced:Complete Main quest [Settlement for destiny][9F]
- Maniac:Complete Main quest [Unbreakable Bond][20F]
- Expert:Complete Main quest [Unbreakable Bond][20F]

We would like to inform you of our corrections and compensation concerning the following issue that occurred on July 15, 2020 (Wed).

Rewards for the 4th Guild of Guilds Ranking Event may be sent during the event.

All participants in the 4th Guild of Guilds Ranking Event will receive rewards equivalent to that of 1st place, excluding Records (Achievements) and GoG Medals.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the Guild Counter NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Ranking Battles.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
- Important
Each guild will be able to increase their total score during the 4th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
In exchange, Raid Boss Dungeon score rewards will become unavailable.
Scores earned before the ranking period will be carried over to Raid Boss Dungeons after the ranking period.
* The total score in the 4th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members and is added to after each battle. It is not the total score of all the members added up.
* When the total score reaches a certain amount in the 4th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event, a reward will be sent to all current guild members at that time.
* To check the total score rewards for the 4th "Guild of Guilds"Ranking Event, go to the top-left Menu > Community > Ranking > 4th GoG Ranking banner.
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the [Ticket Collecting Dungeon].
Your partner will not participate in the solo Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon.
This event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
Each guild can only attempt one difficulty of the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon at a time. The difficulty level attempted will be that of the player who first enters the dungeon.
If the Ranking Event comes to an end during the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon, any post-completion score will not be added.
If you join a guild during or after the July 22, 2020 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive Ranking Rewards.
* Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
View Mode is here! Enjoy even more freedom when taking screenshots!
UPDATE
2020-07-22 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
View Mode
was added as of the July 22, 2020 (Wed) maintenance.
With View Mode, you can move the camera away from your character and freely take screenshots.
Use View Mode to take a wide variety of pictures throughout the game.
How to Use
Activate View Mode by going to Menu > System > Settings > Functions, and selecting ON.
You can move, rotate, and zoom the camera in View Mode as you would with player controls.
While View Mode is on, your character will stay in place,
but they can still perform emotes, normal attacks, skills (Burst Skills), Switch, Rush Recollection, Quick Changes, etc. You can then take pictures of these actions.
You can also use shortcut items and chat.
Tap Menu to end View Mode and return the camera to its original position.
View Mode Pictures
You can use View Mode to take pictures like these.
Important
·The camera can only move within the player's normal control range.
·If your character moves while using skills or emotes, and the field switches, View Mode will automatically end.
Please feel free to contact form under "Support" us if you have any feedback in regards to the View Mode.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
[7/15 13:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] High Level Dungeon Added! Get summer-themed stamps and swimsuit avatars! The story event "Watermelon Panic!" returns!
EVENT
2020-07-15 13:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A beautiful beach by the pier with Kirito and Asuna, and...watermelon splitting?!
Fight alongside the SAOIF characters on the beach in the return of the summertime story event "Watermelon Panic!"
Rewards
Gather "Marvelous Watermelon" available as event rewards and drop items, and exchange them at the Trader for previously-appearing swimsuit avatars and exclusive Memory Stamps.
"Coco Drink" is a useful item you can receive from score rewards or as drop items, and recovers party members' HP in the same field by 2000.
You can also get up to 10 Medals of Combat Arts, up to 50 Awakening Stars, up to 10 each of all kinds of Great Jewels, and up to 300 Arcana Gems from all the events.
* "Coco Drinks" will be deleted on September 9, 2020 (Wed) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
How to Participate
- First, talk to the "Event Guide" NPC at the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to head to the day beach.
Once you're at the day beach, talk to "Asuna" to start the scenario quest.
Clear the
"[Returning] Enormous Shadow  Partner" scenario quest
to unlock the "Enormous Shadow" dungeon.
* Those who cleared "Watermelon Panic!" previously will still be able to challenge this quest.
* Cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
* We have changed the titles of the quest names of the 2019 event "[Returning] Watermelon Panic!" from [Returning] to ['19 Rewind].
High difficuly "Special"
High difficuly "Special" will be added as of the July 15, 2020 (Wed) maintenance.
You can clear the difficult "Special" three times per day.
In addition, item use is restricted while inside the dungeon and Revive Crystals can only be used up to 3 times.
* Once you clear the dungeon, you can't challenge it again until the system resets at 4:00 am (JST/UTC+9).
- You'll be able to go to the night beach and set off the "Fireworks" items after the July 22, 2020 (Wed) maintenance.
Event Period
Starts after the July 8, 2020 Maintenance - September 2, 2020 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
Trader Period
Starts after the July 8, 2020 Maintenance - September 9, 2020 Maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
* "Marvelous Watermelons" will be deleted on September 9, 2020 (Wed) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).

4th Guild of Guilds "VS Terror Gaze" is here!
EVENT
2020-07-08 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Challenge the Raid Boss with up to 30 guild members!
Major Event 4th Guild of Guilds "VS Terror Gaze", is now on!
Rewards
You can get special materials from Raid Boss Dungeon challenge rewards and as drops from the Raid Boss.
Use these to create the
"Guild Shoulder Guard (Yellow)"
accessory avatar that comes with a guild emblem, and the
"Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Yellow)"
accessory avatar that replicates the Terror Gaze's eyeball, which shifts with any movement!
4th GoG Raid Boss Ticket, Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and Release Crystals are available as rewards in the Ticket Collecting Dungeon.
How to Participate
Accept it from the "Raid Boss Dungeon" NPC in the Guild Room to take on the challenge.
Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to go to the Guild Room.
4th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
The
4th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
will start after maintenance on July 15 and end before maintenance on  July 22.
In the 4th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event, guilds compete for ranks based on their total point score.
Create a guild of up to 30 members and aim for the top of the ranking charts.
The higher the Dungeon's difficulty, the more you can score!
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 4th GoG Ranking banner.
The 4th GoG Raid Boss Ticket used to take on Raid Bosses are only necessary during the ranking period.
* The ranking event is scheduled to start after the maintenance on the July 15, but you will be able to collect 4th GoG Raid Boss Ticket and prepare from after the maintenance on the July 8.
Gathering tickets will give you an edge in the ranking event.
The "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" NPC will be available following the maintenance on July 8 and will become unavailable after maintenance on July 22.
* The Ticket Collecting Dungeon will not be available after the ranking event ends since 4th GoG Raid Boss Ticket are not needed when the event is finished.
* The Ticket Collecting Dungeon is only available for a limited amount of time.
During the ranking period, the Raid Boss will drop Record Kit M, Record Frame M, and all kinds of Jewels/High Jewels instead of production materials and Restorative Potions.
There's a chance that Star Fragments will drop at DANGER or Special difficulties.
Healing items and Record Frames will replace production material as challenge rewards.
Use the drop items or challenge rewards to enhance your skills and take on the rankings.
Event Period
Starts after the July 8, 2020 Maintenance - August 12, 2020 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

After that occurs, it increases its attack with stacked buffs.
It can no longer inflict Petrify, but it will make use of its even wider-reaching super wide range attack.

EVENT

（JST/GMT+9）
Protect the Crystals from the onslaught of monsters in this Defense Battle event.
Enjoy the new group in Defense Battle ver.2! It allows you to challenge dungeons with multiple parties at the same time.
When you're in a group, the player with the highest score will be named the MVP on the results screen after clearing the dungeon.
The Crystals in need of protection are in three locations. A strategic and thrilling battle awaits!
In Defense Battles, the less damage done to the Crystals, and the faster the monsters are driven back, the higher your score.
Work with your allies to protect the Crystals and try for a high score to get nice rewards.
Rewards
Get the "M Golem Medal" from the event and exchange it for
"Mush Head" and "Mush Hood" avatars
.
Plus, this Trader features Medals of Combat Arts, the awakening material "Awakening Star", and Release Crystals used for learning proficiency skills!
Get
up to 500 Arcana Gems
from the entire event!
- There's a chance that the monsters that appear will drop Release Crystals (S).
There's a chance that Star Fragments will drop at Maniac and Expert difficulties.
Get rare items and lots of EXP by using Boost Mode to increase the Drop Rate and EXP obtained!
See here for more details on Boost Mode.
How to Participate
Talk to the Defense Battle NPC at the Teleport Gate Plaza to challenge it.
Groups
- Talk to the Defense Battle NPC, select the difficulty, and choose "Challenge with group" to create or join a group.
- When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
- Once the group is formed, you will be able to move from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
- If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
- Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
- For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.
Participation Requirements
- Normal:Complete Main quest [To Keep Moving Forward][5F]
- Advanced:Complete Main quest [Settlement for destiny][9F]
- Maniac:Complete Main quest [Unbreakable Bond][20F]
- Expert:Complete Main quest [Unbreakable Bond][20F]

Notices
Daily Dungeons +2 is here! Clear it up to 3 times a day!
EVENT
2020-06-30 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Two attempts have been added to Daily Dungeons, so now players can clear them three times per day!
Daily Dungeons are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of Daily Dungeons to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP, equipment enhancement materials, and transformation materials.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets the next day at 4 AM (JST/UTC+9).
Event Start
Blackiron Palace
Daily Dungeon
Period
Starts after the June 30, 2020 Maintenance - July 8, 2020 Maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]

- Skill Transform & Awaken Ver./Y (Get Skill Record awakening material and Yellow Jewel transformation material)

Awakening Stars, Star Fragments, Yellow Jewels, High Yellow Jewels, Great Yellow Jewels, Record Kit S, Record Kit M, Revive Crystals

* Daily Dungeons that have been cleared prior to the June 30 (Tue) maintenance can be attempted and cleared a second time once maintenance is complete.
* Daily Dungeons can be cleared three times during the period starting at 4:00am on July 8 (Wed) and lasting until maintenance begins on July 8 (Wed). (JST/UTC+9)
Please note that Daily Dungeons cleared for the first time following the July 8 (Wed) maintenance can only be attempted once per day. (JST/UTC+9)

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the Guild Counter NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Ranking Battles.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
- Important
Each guild will be able to increase their total score during the 3rd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
In exchange, Raid Boss Dungeon score rewards will become unavailable.
Scores earned before the ranking period will be carried over to Raid Boss Dungeons after the ranking period.
* The total score in the 3rd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members and is added to after each battle. It is not the total score of all the members added up.
* When the total score reaches a certain amount in the 3rd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event, a reward will be sent to all current guild members at that time.
* To check the total score rewards for the 3rd "Guild of Guilds"Ranking Event, go to the top-left Menu > Community > Ranking > 3rd GoG Ranking banner.
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the [Ticket Collecting Dungeon].
Your partner will not participate in the solo Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon.
This event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
Each guild can only attempt one difficulty of the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon at a time. The difficulty level attempted will be that of the player who first enters the dungeon.
If the Ranking Event comes to an end during the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon, any post-completion score will not be added.
If you join a guild during or after the June 24, 2020 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive Ranking Rewards.
* Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.

New Feature: The Guild Bulletin Board!
UPDATE
2020-06-24 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
To help liven up Guild communities, we implemented Guild Bulletin Boards as of the maintenance on June 24, 2020 (Wed).
Guild Bulletin Board
The bulletin board is where guild members can interact with one another.
To access the bulletin board, go to Menu > Community > Guild and select the Bulletin Board tab.
How to Use the Bulletin Board
- The guild leader or sub-leader can tap the Create Topic button to set up a topic.
Up to three topics can be created.
If the maximum number of topics has been created, an existing topic can be deleted so a new one can be made.
- Guild members can read the topics and write comments.
Each member is allowed to write up to one comment on each topic.
- When a topic or comment is edited, it will be updated.
- Updated topics and comments will have a "NEW!!" icon appear next to them.
- The date and time the topic was updated will be displayed.
- Guild leaders can pin important topics on the board to keep them at the top.
Important
- Comments from members who leave the guild will be erased, but topics they created will remain.
- The only ones who can delete topics are the guild leader or the creator of the topic.
Please feel free to contact us if you have any feedback in regards to the Guild Bulletin Board.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

The Hunting Event "[Returning] Memorial Colossus Hunt" is here to celebrate 2.5 years since the Japanese release of SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor!
The menacing monster, Memorial Colossus, is rearing its head once again in the 1st Memorial Dungeon that celebrated the first anniversary of the Japanese release.

3rd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
The
3rd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
will start after maintenance on June 17 and end before maintenance on June 24.
In the 3rd "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event, guilds compete for ranks based on their total point score.
Create a guild of up to 30 members and aim for the top of the ranking charts.
The higher the Dungeon's difficulty, the more you can score!
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 3rd GoG Ranking banner.
·The 3rd GoG Raid Boss Ticket used to take on Raid Bosses are only necessary during the ranking period.
*The ranking event is scheduled to start after the maintenance on the June 17, but you will be able to collect 3rd GoG Raid Boss Ticket and prepare from after the maintenance on the June 10.
Gathering tickets will give you an edge in the rankings.
·The NPC Ticket Collecting Dungeon will be available following the maintenance on June 10 and will become unavailable after maintenance on June 24.
*The Ticket Collecting Dungeon will not be available after the ranking event ends since 3rd GoG Raid Boss Ticket are not needed when the event is finished.
*The Ticket Collecting Dungeon is only available for a limited amount of time.
·During the ranking period, the Raid Boss will drop Record Kit M, Record Frame M, and all kinds of Jewels/High Jewels instead of production materials and Restorative Potions.
There's a chance that Star Fragments will drop at DANGER or Special difficulties.
Healing items and Record Frames will replace production material as challenge rewards.
Use the drop items or challenge rewards to enhance your skills and take on the rankings.
Differences from the 2nd Guild of Guilds
·Adjusted the values of the time bonus and clear bonus.
·Adjusted the amount of points needed to earn score rewards and total score rewards during ranking.

A super challenging dungeon is now available.
This is your chance to push your abilities to their limit!
A never before seen honor awaits upon completion.
There are three types of dungeons in total, and each has a different weakness.
As proof of hunting down a dungeon's boss,

Every player will receive their own score and challenge rewards if they clear it.

Notices

EVENT
2020-09-24 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The 6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is on now.
The 6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is an event where guilds compete for ranks based on their highest score in the High Score Ranking "Raid Boss Dungeon".
These bosses are stronger than those that appear in the "Raid Boss Dungeon" Special, so team up with your guild members to challenge them.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 6th GoG Ranking banner.
Rewards
Guild members who make it into the top rankings will get the
"Devil Shield A" shield avatar marked with their guild's emblem, "Devil Helm C" and "Devil Cape C" accessory avatars themed on the boss monster Masquerade Demon
, "Arcana Gems", "6th GoG Medals" and Records, "Medals of Unity", and more!
You can open and close the visor on "Devil Helm C" using emotes.
Plus, "Devil Helm C" comes with your guild emblem, just like "Devil Shield A".
Trade the "High Score Dungeon Badges" you get as challenge rewards for all kinds of Great Jewels and "Release Crystals" at the exclusive Trader.
Participation Requirements
‧Must be a member of a guild.
‧Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Event Period
Starts after the September 24, 2020 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the September 29, 2020 (Tue) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* Please note, the 6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will only be open for 5 days, as opposed to the usual 1 week.
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
It strikes the player with a lightning focus attack that inflicts Paralysis or a dark attack that inflicts Poison.
It gives itself stacked buffs that reduce the damage it takes from the player.
Break its powerful wide-reaching energy attack with 1H Rapier Sword Skills!
More damage is dealt to this monster during skill break than other monsters, so take advantage of it.
Challenge its formidable Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff by equipping an Awakening Skill and using Rush Recollection!

* Image is for visualization purposes only.
The super rare Nox Integral Series 3rd level transformation has been unlocked!
Collect the material item "Sticky Thing Armament Stone" from
extremely rare
boss drops on "35F" to transform Nox Integral Series equipment!
Transform to raise the weapon's stats and give it special light effects.
How to Transform to the 3rd Level
STEP1
Get the Nox Integral Series to ★4 (2nd Level Transformation)!
Transform Nox Integral Series to ★4 here.
STEP2
Produce the transformation material "Stone++" necessary for the ★5 Nox Integral Series!
In order to produce "Stone++" you will need "Stone+" and "Core Metal".
* The production recipe for "Stone++" will be available after completing "13F".
* Each "Stone++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: Transforming 1H Swords or Daggers will require a "Slicing Stone++" made from "Slicing Stone+" and "Core Metal".
STEP3
Transform Nox Integral Series equipment at a Blacksmith using "Stone++" and the "35F" boss drop "Sticky Thing Armament Stone".
Producing Nox Integral Series Equipment
"Sticky Thing Armament Stones" and "Sticky Thing Fluid" dropped by the "35F" boss can be used to produce Nox Integral Series equipment.
* The base statuses will not be different to Nox Integral Series equipment that can be produced on "25F" & "27F".
* Production recipes that use "Sticky Thing Armament Stones" and "Sticky Thing Fluid" will be available upon completing the "27F" Main Quest 《Red Riding Hood》into Tomorrow.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Get up to 500 "Arcana Gems" in the Tower Quest "Flaming Tower" on now!
EVENT
2020-09-16 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Tower Quest "Flaming Tower" begins.
When you defeat all of the monsters on a floor, you'll complete the quest for that floor.
From there, you can collect your reward and challenge the next floor!
Fire is the only effective elemental attack against the monsters that appear in the Flaming Tower.
They are resistant to all other elements (Water, Wind, Earth, Holy, and Dark).
* There is no resistance to weapon elements.
In the Tower Quest, the difficulty gradually increases with each floor.
Try to clear all 10 floors and conquer the tower!
Rewards
Receive up to "500" Arcana Gems in rewards from "Flaming Tower"!
* Monsters inside the Flaming Tower do not drop items.
EXP, Weapon EXP, and Col can still be earned from them.
How to Participate
Talk to the Tower Quest NPC in the Blackiron Palace to challenge the Tower Quest "Flaming Tower."
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Event Period
Starts after the September 16, 2020 Maintenance - September 29, 2020 Maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
* All floors in this event will close when maintenance begins on September 29, 2020 (Tue).
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Notices
6th Guild of Guilds "VS Masquerade Demon" is here!
EVENT
2020-09-09 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Challenge the Raid Boss with up to 30 guild members!
Major Event
The 6th Guild of Guilds "VS Masquerade Demon" is now on!
Rewards
Try making the accessory avatars
"Devil Mask C"
and
"Devil Tail C"
using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the Raid Boss Dungeon!
"6th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon".
How to Participate
Accept it from the "Raid Boss Dungeon" NPC in the "Guild Room" to take on the challenge.
Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to go to the "Guild Room".
6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
The
6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
will start after maintenance on September 24 and end before maintenance on September 29.
The 6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is a ranking event where guilds compete for ranks based on their high score in the special "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
·A boss even more powerful than those from the "Raid Boss Dungeon" Special appears.
·There are slated to be 15 of the "6th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you'll need to challenge the Ranking Event dungeon.
·Unlike in previous events, rankings will be based on high scores achieved during this event period, instead of total scores.
·The event will only be open for 5 days as opposed to the usual 1 week.
·To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 6th GoG Ranking banner.
·The "6th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" used to take on Raid Bosses are only necessary during the ranking period.
*The ranking event is scheduled to start after the maintenance on the September 24th, but you will be able to collect "6th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" and prepare from after the maintenance on the September 10th.
Gathering tickets will give you an edge in the rankings.
·The NPC "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will be available following the maintenance on September 9 and will become unavailable after maintenance on September 29.
*The "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will not be available after the ranking event ends since "6th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not needed when the event is finished.
*The "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" is only available for a limited amount of time.
·During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
·"Star Fragments", "Record Kit M", "Record Frame M", and all kinds of Jewels/High Jewels drop in the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Period
Starts after the September 9, 2020 Maintenance - October 6, 2020 Maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]

Important
·The Boss, Masquerade Demon, has different elemental weaknesses, attack timing, buffs, and status ailments than the one from the 2nd "Guild of Guilds".
·The 2nd through 5th Guild of Guilds Production Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list, but you will be able to exchange Medals of Unity for them at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* Production of "Devil Mask B" and "Devil Tail B" and "Wander Gear C" and "Wander Cape C" will no longer be available as of maintenance on September 16 (Wed).
·The 2nd through 5th Guild of Guilds Production Avatar material will be removed.
* The materials "Demon Wing" and "Demon Horn"  and "Shinigami Cloth" and "Shingami Blade" will be removed as of maintenance on September 16 (Wed).
·The 6th Guild of Guilds production material will be removed as of maintenance on October 14 (Wed).
The Production Avatars will also no longer be displayed on the production list.
·The Avatar rewards for the 6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader four months after ranking ends.
·There is no guild ranking for total score in the 6th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
·Each time you clear the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon", you'll get "High Score Dungeon Badges", which can be exchanged for items at the Trader.
* "High Score Dungeon Badges" are not shared among guild members. Instead, each player acquires the items upon clearing the dungeon.
·All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
·You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a "guild Room".
·Please note that dungeon expiry time and guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
·Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
·You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon".
·The "6th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" you receive from the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will be deleted during maintenance on September 29 (Tue).
· "6th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
·The amount of "6th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
·Your partner will not participate in the solo "Raid Boss Dungeon".
·This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
·There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
·The 7th "Guild of Guilds" is planned to open on October 6 (Tue).
It will not open on the second Wednesday of the month.

Masquerade Demon
Details
It strikes the player with a lightning focus attack that inflicts Paralysis or a dark attack that inflicts Poison.
When its HP goes below a certain amount, it reduces the damage taken from the player with stacked buffs.
Break its powerful wide-reaching energy attack with 1H Rapier Sword Skills!
More damage is dealt to this monster during skill break than other monsters, so take advantage of it.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Daily Dungeons +2 is here! Clear it up to 3 times a day!
EVENT
2020-09-09 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Two attempts have been added to Daily Dungeons, so now players can clear them three times per day!
Daily Dungeons are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of Daily Dungeons to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP, equipment enhancement materials, and transformation materials.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets the next day at 4 AM (JST/UTC+9).

Blackiron Palace
Daily Dungeon
Period
Starts after the September 9, 2020 Maintenance - September 16, 2020 Maintenance (JST/UTC+9)

Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]

Attainable Items:

* Daily Dungeons can be cleared three times during the period starting at 4:00am on September 16 (Wed) and lasting until maintenance begins on September 16 (Wed). (JST/UTC+9)

The 5th "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt.

This monster has a Break Gauge. Deal enough damage to temporarily immobilize it.
When its HP drops below a certain amount, it will use the formidable Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff.
Activate Rush Recollection and deal tons of damage!

There are three types of dungeons in total, and each has a different weakness.
As proof of hunting down a dungeon's boss,
you'll receive the relevant "Proof F. Witch".
At the same time, you'll be able to get each of the "F. Witch Victor" Records as achievement rewards.

* "Proof F. Witch" will be deleted on August 16, 2020 (Sun) at 23:59 (JST/UTC+9).
Record Background
How to Participate
Talk to the "Fatal Battle" NPC at the Teleport Gate Plaza to challenge it.
Event Period
Starts after the August 13, 2020 0:00 - August 16, 2020 23:59 (JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Boss Monster
Fatal Witch
Details
Your opponent is the Fatal Witch.
When she calls forth her clones, she will use attacks that can inflict Stun, Curse, Petrify, and Debility to drag players closer to their demise.
While her clones are alive, the Fatal Witch has a damage-reduction buff, making your attacks far less effective.
Start by defeating her clones, Fatal Witch Entry and Fatal Witch Shadow. This will get rid of the damage-reduction buff and give you the upper hand in battle.
The clones have a Break Gauge, so be aggressive with your attacks and make them fall to Break Status.
On top of that, the Fatal Witch will activate different levels of the formidable Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff depending on her remaining HP.
Since the damage reduction rate varies depending on the level, check the message displayed when Chaos Recollection is activated to determine when to use Rush Recollection.
Weakness
Fatal Battle Slash Weakness:
Slash Element
Fatal Battle Thrust Weakness:
Thrust Element
Fatal Battle Blunt Weakness:
Blunt Element
* The damage-increasing effect of Rush Recollection is not negated by Chaos Recollection.
* Petrify inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
* Petrify is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
* Your max HP will decrease when hit with Debility attacks. It can fall to up to 99% from its original value.
You can restore it with a Cleansing Potion.
* The time limit is 10 minutes.
Give it all you've got.
* This event can be challenged by a max of 6 players.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
5th Guild of Guilds "VS Wander Fatal Scythe" is here!
EVENT
2020-08-12 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Challenge the Raid Boss with up to 30 guild members!
Major Event The 5th Guild of Guilds "VS Wander Fatal Scythe" is now on!
Reward
Try making the accessory avatars
"Wander Gear C"
and
"Wander Cape C"
that come with a guild emblem, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the Raid Boss Dungeon!
How to Participate
Accept it from the "Raid Boss Dungeon" NPC in the Guild Room to take on the challenge.
Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to go to the Guild Room.
* Raid Boss Tickets are not required to challenge the Raid Boss.
* Guild members who challenge the Raid Boss will not be able to challenge other Raid Bosses until they clear or finish their current dungeon.
5th "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt
The
5th "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt
, where you can challenge high difficulty dungeons, will start after maintenance on August 19, 2020 (Wed) and end before maintenance on August 26 (Wed).
The 5th "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt is a new, high difficulty Raid Boss Dungeon that has a boss who's even stronger than those in the Raid Boss Dungeon Special.
In addition to three new types of Avatars, players can get items like Limited Records, "Medals of Unity", and awakening materials as rewards.
Challenge it with the strength of up to 30 guild members.
* No Ranking Event will be held for the 5th "Guild of Guilds".
You can get "Medals of Unity" to use at the exclusive Trader from Guild Ranking prizes or "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt rewards.
You can trade for items like Avatars and awakening materials that were exclusive to past "Guild of Guilds" events.
Period
Starts after the August 12, 2020 Maintenance - September 9, 2020 Maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Changes from the 5th "Guild of Guild"
‧The Wander Fatal Scythe boss that appears this time has different Elemental weaknesses and attack timing than the one from the 1st "Guild of Guilds". Its buffs as well as the status ailments it inflicts on the player also have new levels of effectiveness.
‧The 1st through 4th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list, but you will be able to exchange Medals of Unity for them at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* Production of "Wander Cape B" and "Wander Gear B" will no longer be available as of maintenance on August 19 (Wed).
‧The 1st through 4th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatar material will be removed.
* The materials Wander Cloth and Wander Bone will be removed as of maintenance on August 19 (Wed).
‧As of the 5th "Guild of Guilds", production material will be removed one week after the event ends.
The Production Avatars will also no longer be displayed on the production list.
‧The Avatar rewards for a "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader four months after ranking ends.
* The Avatar rewards from the "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt will likewise be added four months after the event ends.
Important
‧You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a guild Room.
‧Please note that dungeon expiry time and guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
‧Your partner will not participate in the solo Raid Boss Dungeon.
‧this Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
‧There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
A wicked monster that swings a giant scythe. It gets a stacked buff that increases its attack based on the number of players it has defeated.
Watch out for its Dark attacks that can inflict Curse, and beware its set area attacks that can inflict Bleed when touched.
This monster has a Break Gauge. Deal enough damage to temporarily immobilize it.
It has different Elemental weaknesses and attack timing than the one from the 1st "Guild of Guilds". The status ailments it can inflict on the player also have new levels of effectiveness, so a change of strategy is in order.

Notices
Clears +1! Increased drop rates, EXP and attack boosting items earned in the Great Enhancement Event VS Yuuki +1! On now!
EVENT
2020-11-21 04:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take down Yuuki and get useful items for battle!
This time, players get an additional possible clear, allowing two clears per day!
Rewards
The
Great Enhancement Event  VS Yuuki +1
challenge rewards include items that increase attack, drop rate, and EXP earned.
Use the items and double the drop rate and EXP earned for 10 minutes!
Items that increase your attack will boost it by x1.3!
Incense you get from clearing will be effective for 10 minutes.
Use more than one to increase the effect's duration.
Doing so will help you out in a variety of situations
.
* The
Great Enhancement Event  VS Yuuki +1
Dungeon can be cleared two per day.
You can select one of the three items that increases either: drop rate, EXP earned, or attack.
* The dungeon clear allowance resets every day at 4:00 (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be a solo dungeon.
Item Expiration
There is an expiration date on the "Incense to increase Exp S",
"Incense to increase Luck S", and "Incense to Increase Strength S".
The items will disappear once the time limit has passed.

* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

The 8th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is on now.
The 8th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is an event where guilds compete for ranks based on their "highest score" in the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
These bosses are stronger than those that appear in the "Raid Boss Dungeon Special", so team up with your guild members to challenge them.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "8th GoG" Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x10, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Fifteen minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x20.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
Buff & Debuff icon
‧
Rewards
Guild members who make it to the top rankings will get the
"Terrifying Helm (Gray)"
accessory avatar visor that comes with an emote to open its big eye, the
"Terrifying Shield (Gray)"
shield avatar with a big shifting eyeball, and the shield avatar
"Gaze Shield (Black)"
that comes with a guild icon!
They will also get "Arcana Gems", 8th GoG Medals and records, "Medals of Unity", "Awakening Stars", and much more from ranking rewards.
Trade the "High Score Dungeon Badges" you get as challenge rewards for all kinds of "Great Jewels" and "Release Crystals" at the exclusive Trader.
* The Terrifying Shield (Gray)'s eye moves in the direction of the camera.
‧Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
‧Event Period
Starts after the November 11, 2020 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 18, 2020 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* The 8th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be open for one week.
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
‧Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that can inflict Petrify and Poison.
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color and weapon elemental weakness will change.
After it changes, Terror Gaze's attack and defense will increase, and it will get a stack damage-reduction buff.
Once it changes, it can no longer inflict Petrify, but its wide-range area attacks will become super wide-range area attacks.
Perform break with a Bow Sword Skill to prevent its super wide-range area attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye inflicts a debuff that decreases your attack, so watch for when it's preparing to attack, and avoid it.
It has a beam that brings down a focus attack from above your head and inflicts "Poison", "Curse", and "Debility" as well as a debuff that decreases attack.
Challenge its Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff by equipping an Awakening Skill and using Rush Recollection!

* "Petrify" inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
"Petrify" is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
* Your max HP will decrease when hit with Debility attacks. It can fall to up to 99% from its original value.
You can restore it with a Cleansing Potion.
* The damage-increasing effect of "Rush Recollection" is not negated by "Chaos Recollection".
* There is a 30-minute time limit for the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".

‧Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of "Guild Skills" that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use "Guild Raid buffs" acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
‧The score in the 8th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members.
‧ One point will be added to your "time bonus" every 0.02 seconds for the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧There are no "Total Score Rewards" in the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
‧You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a "Guild Room".
‧Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
‧You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon".
‧Your partner will not participate in the solo "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧this Event cannot be challenged with an "Assist Party".

Yuna's song echoes through the air, making even the hearts of the NPCs tremble.
This update includes new quests along with the release of the 40F.
The player level and weapon proficiency level caps have been raised.
The weapon proficiency level cap has been raised, and weapon proficiency skills have been added.
Following up after the Integral Series and the Nox Integral Series, the super rare "Lux Integral Series" weapons are now available!
In addition, the main quests from 2F to 35F are now less difficult, making it easier for players to advance through the floors.

Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
After considering everyone's feedback regarding the game's level of difficulty,
we have decided to make the following game balance adjustments in the November 18, 2020 update.
Planned Adjustments Details
‧Decrease the HP of the main quest and field monsters from 2F to 35F.
‧Make some hostile monsters from 1F to 35F "passive" so that they won't attack until the player hits them.
* Does not include boss monsters or floor bosses.
‧Change the weapon elemental weaknesses of monsters on 13F and above to match that of the floor boss on each floor.
We expect these adjustments will help more players clear floors.

Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that can inflict Petrify and Poison.
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color and weapon elemental weakness will change.
After it changes, Terror Gaze's attack and defense will increase, and it will get a stack damage-reduction buff.
Once it changes, it can no longer inflict Petrify, but its wide-range area attacks will become super wide-range area attacks.
Perform break with a Bow Sword Skill to prevent its super wide-range area attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye inflicts a debuff that decreases your attack, so watch for when it's preparing to attack, and avoid it.
The beam brings down a focus attack from above your head, and it inflicts status ailments as well as a debuff that decreases attack.
The number of status ailments inflicted by the focus attack depends on the dungeon's difficulty.
* Depth: Poison
* DANGER: Poison and Curse
* Special: Poison, Curse, and Debility

The 7th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is on now.
The 7th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is an event where guilds compete for ranks based on their "highest score" in the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
These bosses are stronger than those that appear in the "Raid Boss Dungeon Special", so team up with your guild members to challenge them.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 7th GoG Ranking banner.
Differences from the 7th Guild of Guilds Ranking Event
‧We have made a balance adjustment that will strengthen players after spending a certain amount of time in the dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x10, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Fifteen minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x20.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
Buff & Debuff icon
Rewards
Guild members who make it into the top rankings will get the
"Medusa Shield (Copper) "shield avatar and the "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Green)" accessory avatar marked with their guild's emblem, as well as the "Snake Queen's Hair (Pink)" accessory avatar with hair that sways back and forth when you move.
They will also get Arcana Gems, 7th GoG Medals and records, Medals of Unity, Awakening Stars, and much more from ranking rewards.
Trade the "High Score Dungeon Badges" you get as challenge rewards for all kinds of "Great Jewels" and "Release Crystals" at the exclusive Trader.
Participation Requirements
‧Must be a member of a guild.
‧Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Event Period
Starts after the October 21, 2020 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 28, 2020 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* The 7th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be open for one week.
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Its tail attack can inflict a debuff that lowers your defense.
When it charges forward with its scratch attack, it inflicts a debuff that decreases your attack.
On the other hand, its stationary scratch attack can inflict you with Bleed. It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts Petrify.
She has two powerful wide-range attacks that drop meteorites that can be broken by a 1H Sword Sword Skill and a Dagger Sword Skill.
It gets buffs when preparing these attacks.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a 1H Sword, it gets a buff that decreases the damage it takes from the player.
When its preparing the attack that can be broken with a Dagger, it gets a buff that decreases your critical rate.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and cancel all the buffs it gained.
Challenge its "Chaos Recollection" damage-reduction buff by equipping an Awakening Skill and using "Rush Recollection"!

"Petrify" is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
* The damage-increasing effect of "Rush Recollection" is not negated by "Chaos Recollection".
* There is a 30-minute time limit for the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Get your hands on the "Cactus Head" accessory avatar and choose from the three available colors in the Defense Battle ver. 3 "Attack of the Cactus Trio"!
EVENT
2020-10-28 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Protect the Crystals from the onslaught of monsters and the large "Cactus Trio" boss in this Defense Battle event!
Get a higher score by defeating monsters quickly and preventing the crystals placed on the map from taking too much damage.
Plus, you can get EXP that will help you get stronger.
‧
New Features
"Pathfinding" and "Sub Defense Target" have been added for Defense Battle ver. 3.
Pathfinding
Instead of taking a direct path to reach the Crystals like they did previously, monsters will now take more complex routes.
Sub Defense Target
There will be a number of bonus "Sub crystal" placed around the map. No matter how many of these are destroyed, you will not fail the dungeon.
You will get a huge score boost if you still have intact "Sub crystal" by the end of the final wave.
Protect all the Crystals and try for a high score to get nice rewards.
* You will fail the dungeon if any Main crystal are destroyed.
Rewards
Exchange "Cactus T Medals" at the Trader for
"Cactus Head" accessory avatars modeled after the "Fresh Cactus", "Aged Cactus", and "Bad Cactus" bosses
.
Plus, this Trader features "Medals of Combat Arts", the awakening material "Awakening Star", and "Release Crystals" used for learning proficiency skills!
Get
up to 15 "Medals of Combat Arts" and up to 250 "Arcana Gems"
from the entire event!
There's a chance that the monsters that appear will drop "Release Crystals (S)".
There's a chance that "Star Fragments" will drop at "Maniac" and "Expert" difficulties.
‧Achievement Requirements
Complete the conditions and receive event-limited records and items from achievement rewards.

Notices
[10/21 12:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]  "Special" Added! "Mother's Rosary" is here! Get your hands on a Yuuki Skill Record and a Limited-edition Stamp!
EVENT
2020-10-21 12:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Word has it that "Yuuki" keeps winning against anyone who is willing to challenge her to a "Street Duels" beneath the Great Tree.
Interested in seeing how "Yuuki" fights,"Lisbeth" asks the player to escort her to the Great Tree.
Rewards
Gather "Wolf Beast Chain", tradable items acquired as event rewards and drop items, and exchange them at the Trader for a
"Yuuki Skill Record"
, a Limited-edition Stamp, and the "Life Potion" item that recovers more HP than the "Restorative Potion".
You can get the
"Great Tree Leaf"
in the dungeon and use it to recover all of your party members' HP.
You can also get up to 15 "Medals of Combat Arts", up to 50 "Awakening Stars", up to 10 each of all kinds of "Great Jewels", and up to 300 "Arcana Gems" from all the events.
Icon
Item Name
Effect
Life Potion

Great Tree Leaf
Recover party member's HP in the same field by 5%.
* "Great Tree Leaf" will be deleted on November 18, 2020 (Wed) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
How to Participate
First, talk to the "Event Guide" NPC at the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to head to the "Forest of the Great Tree" Event Map.
Once you're at the "Forest of the Great Tree", talk to "Lisbeth" to start the scenario quest.
There are 5 scenario quests. Clear "What I Want to Leave Behind" to unlock the "Wolf Beast Labyrinth" dungeon.
Once you've cleared all the scenario quests, take a look at the "Great Tree" on the Event Map!

"Special"

"Special"
will be implemented during maintenance on October 21, 2020 (Wed).
You can clear the High difficulty
"Special"
three times per day.
In addition, item use is restricted while inside the dungeon and Revive Crystals can only be used up to 3 times.
* Once you clear the dungeon 3 times, you can't challenge it again until the system resets at 4:00 am (JST/UTC+9).
Event Period
Starts after the October 14, 2020 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 5, 2020 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

"7th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon".
How to Participate
Accept it from the "Raid Boss Dungeon" NPC in the Guild Room to take on the challenge.
Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to go to the Guild Room.
7th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
The
7th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
will start after maintenance on October 21 and end before maintenance on October 28.
The 7th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is a ranking event where guilds compete for ranks based on their high score in the special "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
·The boss is even more powerful than those from the "Raid Boss Dungeon Special".
Plus, the battle will scale to the player's level, so anyone at any level can challenge it.
·15 "7th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" will be required to challenge the Ranking Event dungeon.
·Rankings will be based on high scores achieved during this event period.
·This event will be open for 7 days (2 days longer than the previous event).
·To check your current ranking or score, go to "Menu" > "Community" > "Ranking" > "7th GoG Ranking banner".
·The "7th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" used to take on Raid Bosses are only necessary during the ranking period.
*The ranking event is scheduled to start after the maintenance on the October 21th, but you will be able to collect "7th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" and prepare from after the maintenance on the October 6th.
Gathering tickets will give you an edge in the rankings.
·The NPC "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will be available until the 7th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event ends, before maintenance on October 28 (Wed).
*The "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will not be available after the ranking event ends since "7th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not needed when the event is finished.
*The "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" is only available for a limited amount of time.
·During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
·"Star Fragments", "Record Kit M", "Record Frame M", and all kinds of "Jewels/High Jewels" drop in the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".

·The 8th "Guild of Guilds" is planned to open on November 5 (Thu).
Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Its tail attack can inflict a debuff that lowers your defense.
When it charges forward with its scratch attack, it inflicts a debuff that decreases your attack.
On the other hand, its stationary scratch attack can inflict you with Bleed. It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts Petrify.
She has two powerful wide-range attacks that drop meteorites that can be broken by a 1H Sword Sword Skill and a Dagger Sword Skill.
It gets buffs when preparing these attacks.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a 1H Sword, it gets a buff that decreases the damage it takes from the player.
When its preparing the attack that can be broken with a Dagger, it gets a buff that decreases your critical rate.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and cancel all the buffs it gained.

The 11th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be a High Score Ranking where guilds compete for ranks based on their High Score.
The 11th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is planned for February 17, 2021 (Wed).
--------------------------------
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 10th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
In the 10th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the total score they receive from defeating Bosses in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon"
.
There are two difficulties for this Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon: "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme", where you can
get an even higher score
.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 10th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x10, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Fifteen minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by
x25
.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".

Rewards
Guild members who make it into the top rankings will get the
"Devil Shield B" shield avatar marked with their guild's icon, "Devil Helm D" and "Devil Cape D" accessory avatars themed on the boss monster Masquerade Demon,
"Arcana Gems", 10th GoG Medals and Records, "Medals of Unity", and more!
You can open and close the visor on "Devil Helm D" using emotes.
Plus, "Devil Helm D" comes with your guild icon, just like "Devil Shield B".
Participation Requirements
‧Must be a member of a guild.
‧Complete Main quest "The Indomitable Fang"

Event Period: Starts after the January 20, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 28, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be open for 8 days (1 days longer than the previous event).
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Masquerade Demon
Details
It lowers your defense with lightning focus attacks, dark attacks, and attacks that pierce the ground with its lance.
Be careful of the lightning focus attack, since it can also inflict "Paralysis".
It reduces the damage it takes from the player and increases its critical resistance with a buff.
Break its powerful wide-reaching energy attack with Dagger Sword Skills!
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on Extreme difficulty.

‧Winning.

* If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
* Check if you are eligible for a reward from the 10th GoG Ranking banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of "Guild Skills" that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.

‧this Event cannot be challenged with an "Assist Party".

EVENT

Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 10th Guild of Guilds "VS Masquerade Demon" is here!
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
In the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon", you can get the "10th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon", you will need
10 tickets
for "Depth" difficulty and
5 tickets
for "Extreme" difficulty.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the January 14, 2021 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the January 28, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will now be level restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 51 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 76 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 101 or higher
The number of "10th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you can collect will also change.
Entry: 1 ticket
Interior: 5 tickets
Depth: 10 tickets
Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards.
* Check in-game for more information on other rewards.

accessory avatars "Devil Mask D" and "Devil Tail D", modeled after the "Masquerade Demon"
, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon".

It lowers your defense with lightning focus attacks, dark attacks, and attacks that pierce the ground with its lance.
