·"10th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
·The amount of "10th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
·You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".

The 10th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be a Total Score Ranking where guilds compete for ranks based on their total point score.
The 10th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is planned for January 20, 2021 (Wed).
--------------------------------
The 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is on now.
The 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is an event where guilds compete for ranks based on their highest score in the High Score Ranking "Raid Boss Dungeon".
These bosses are stronger than those that appear in the "Raid Boss Dungeon" Special, so team up with your guild members to challenge them.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 9th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x10, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Fifteen minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by
x25
.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
Buff & Debuff icon
Rewards
Guild members who place in the top rankings can get the "Wander Fatal Scythe" themed accessory avatars,
"Wander Brooch B"
and
"Wander Mask B"
, and the shield avatar
"Wander Shield B"
that comes with a guild icon.
They will also get "Arcana Gems", "9th GoG Medals" and records, "Medals of Unity", "Awakening Stars", and much more from ranking rewards.
Trade the "High Score Dungeon Badges" you get as challenge rewards for all kinds of Great Jewels and "Release Crystals" at the exclusive Trader.
‧Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
‧Event Period
Starts after the December 16, 2020 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 23, 2020 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* The 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be open for one week.
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
‧Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
It gets a stack buff that increases its attack based on the number of players it has defeated.
It inflicts "Curse" with a dark attack, "Debility" with a multi-scythe attack, and "Bleed" with a wide-range set area attack.
This monster has a Break Gauge. Deal enough damage to temporarily immobilize it.
Challenge its "Chaos Recollection" damage-reduction buff by equipping an "Awakening Skill"!
Weakness
Thrust Element
* Your max HP will decrease when hit with Debility attacks.
It can fall to up to 99% from its original value.
You can restore it with a "Cleansing Potion".
* The damage-increasing effect of the "Awakening Skill" is not negated by "Chaos Recollection".
* There is a 30-minute time limit for the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Guild Floor Boss Hunting Event "Floor Boss Battle VS Executioner"
EVENT
2020-12-23 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Grab your guild members and fight the floor boss in the Guild Floor Boss Hunting Event.
"Floor Boss Battle VS Executioner" is on now.
25F Floor Boss "
Asura the Executioner
" is a Raid Boss you can challenge with a maximum of 30 guild members.
Use the combined strength of your guild members to take down "
Asura the Executioner
"!
* Raid Boss Tickets are not required to challenge the Raid Boss.
* Guild members who challenge the Raid Boss will not be able to challenge other "Raid Bosses" until they clear or finish their current dungeon.
Rewards
Take up to 30 members!
Every player will receive their own score and challenge rewards if they clear it.
The rewards feature items like "Awakening Stars", all kinds of "Great Jewels", and "Memoria Niter S".
There's a chance that Star Fragments will drop at "Special" and "Extreme" difficulties.
* "Asura Iron Ball", "Asura Arm", "Asura Armament Stone", and "Core Metal" will not drop.
Limited Record
Receive "25F Floor Boss Battle Badge" by completing "Entry", "Depth", or "Special" difficulty.
Gather 40 "25F Floor Boss Battle Badges" to get the Limited Record "25F Strategy Guild" as an achievement reward.
Receive "Floor Boss Extreme Battle Badge" by completing "Extreme" difficulty.
Gather 40 "Floor Boss Extreme Battle Badges" to get the Limited Record
"Assembly of the Great"
as an achievement reward.
Record Background
Record
Achievement Requirements
Achievement Rewards
25F Strategy Guild
Let's collect a total of 40 25F Floor Boss Battle Badges
Revive Crystal×1
Assembly of the Great
Let's collect a total of 40 Floor Boss Extreme Battle Badges
Revive Crystal×1
* "25F Floor Boss Battle Badge" and "Floor Boss Extreme Battle Badge" will be deleted on January 14, 2021 (Thu) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
How to Participate
Talk to the "Raid Boss Dungeon" NPC in the "Guild Room" to challenge the dungeon.
Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to go to your "Guild Room".
Event Period
Starts after the December 23, 2020 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 14, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
Participation Requirements
‧Must be a member of a guild.
‧Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
The Guild Raid buff acquirable from Guild Level 16 is useful for challenging Raid Boss Dungeons.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Boss Monster
Asura the Executioner
Details
A giant boss hiding its face behind an iron mask. It carries various weapons in its four hands and sends out one dark wave attack after another that inflicts Curse and Paralysis.
Use the Break Gauge to knock him out for a while and aim to deal massive damage.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, some of its weapons and body will change color, giving it a buff that increases its attack and defense.
Challenge its Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff on "Special" and "Extreme" difficulties by equipping an Awakening Skill.
Weakness
Thrust Element
Fire Element

* The boss "Asura the Executioner" that appears is different from the main quest.
·Uses "Chaos Recollection"

news_list.full_details:
Notices
9th Guild of Guilds "VS Wander Fatal Scythe" is here!
EVENT
2020-12-09 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Challenge the Raid Boss with up to 30 guild members!
Major Event
The 9th Guild of Guilds "VS Wander Fatal Scythe" is now on!
Rewards
Try making the accessory avatars
"Wander Gear E"
and
"Wander Cape E"
that come with a guild icon, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon"!
"9th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon".
How to Participate
Accept it from the "Raid Boss Dungeon" NPC in the "Guild Room" to take on the challenge.
Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to go to the "Guild Room".
9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
The
9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
will start after maintenance on December 16 and end before maintenance on December 23.
The 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is a ranking event where guilds compete for ranks based on their high score in the special High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon.
·The boss is even more powerful than those from the "Raid Boss Dungeon Special".
·
5
"9th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" will be required to challenge the Ranking Event dungeon.Rankings will be based on high scores achieved during this event period.
·We have adjusted the Ranking order and raised some "Arcana Gem" rewards.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x10, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Fifteen minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by
x25
.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
Buff & Debuff icon
·To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 9th GoG Ranking banner.
·The "9th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" used to take on Raid Bosses are only necessary during the ranking period.
* The ranking event is scheduled to start after the maintenance on the December 16th, but you will be able to collect "9th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" and prepare from after the maintenance on the December 9th.
Gathering tickets will give you an edge in the rankings.
·The NPC "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will be available until the 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event ends, before maintenance on December 23 (Wed).
* The "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will not be available after the ranking event ends since "9th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not needed when the event is finished.
* The "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" is only available for a limited amount of time.
·During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
·"Star Fragments", "Record Kit M", "Record Frame M", and all "kinds of Jewels/High Jewels" drop in the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Event Period
·Starts after the December 9, 2020 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 14, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
Participation Requirements
·Must be a member of a guild.
·Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Ranking Reward
We have adjusted the Ranking order and raised some "Arcana Gem" rewards.

You can get Medals of Unity to use at the exclusive Trader from Guild Ranking prizes or "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt rewards.
You can trade for items like Avatars and awakening materials that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Important
·The Boss, Wander Fatal Scythe, has different attack timing and weapon elemental weakness than the one that appeared in the previous Guild of Guilds. Plus, it has no natural elemental weakness.
·The 8th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars, Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Gray) and Guild Shoulder Guard (Gray), will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on December 16 (Wed).
·The production materials, Evil Eye Skin and Evil Eye Orb, for the 8th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars will be removed as of maintenance on December 16 (Wed).
·The 9th Guild of Guilds production materials will be removed as of maintenance on January 27, 2021 (Wed).
The Production Avatars will also no longer be displayed on the production list.
·The 5th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and the 5th "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt total reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on December 23, 2020 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Wander Brooch A", "Wander Mask A", "Wander Shield A", "Wander Gear C", and "Wander Cape C"
·The Avatar rewards for the 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader four months after ranking ends.
·There is no guild ranking for total score in the 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
·Each time you clear the "High Score Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon", you'll get High Score Dungeon Badges, which can be exchanged for items at the Trader.
* High Score Dungeon Badges are not shared among guild members. Instead, each player acquires them upon clearing the dungeon.
·All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
·You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a "Guild Room".
·Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
·You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon".
·The "9th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" you receive from the "Ticket Collecting Dungeon" will be deleted during maintenance on December 23 (Wed).
·"9th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
·The amount of "9th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
·Your partner will not participate in the solo "Raid Boss Dungeon".
·This Event cannot be challenged with an "Assist Party".
·There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
·The 10th "Guild of Guilds" is scheduled to open on January 14, 2021 (Thu).
Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
It gets a stack buff that increases its attack based on the number of players it has defeated.
It inflicts Curse with a dark attack, Debility with a multi-scythe attack, and Bleed with a wide-range set area attack.
This monster has a Break Gauge. Deal enough damage to temporarily immobilize it.
Weakness
Thrust Element
* Your max HP will decrease when hit with Debility attacks.
It can fall to up to 99% from its original value.
You can restore it with a "Cleansing Potion".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
"Chaos Boss Dungeon +2" is here! Clear it up to 3 times a day!
EVENT
2020-12-09 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Each difficulty in the Chaos Boss Dungeon can now be cleared up to three times per day during the Holiday Campaign. That's two more times than usual!
This is your chance to make a Chaos Boss Avatar!
Recommended Total Power for the Boss
Difficulty
Total Power
Interior
60,000
Depth
80,000
Total Power is a number that gives an approximation of the player's overall strength.
It changes based on factors like equipment, Skill Records, and weapon proficiency level.
Check it by going to Menu > Status > Player.
When your Total Power is near the recommended amount, challenge the boss with a party!
How to Participate
Accept the Chaos Boss Dungeon from the NPCs "Chaos Boss Dungeon Interior" and "Chaos Boss Dungeon Depth" in the Blackiron Palace.
* Each difficulty has a separate NPC associated with it.
* Once you clear the dungeon 3 times, you can't play it again until the system resets at 4:00 (JST/UTC+9).
-Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
-Event Period
Starts after the December 9, 2020 Maintenance - December 16, 2020 Maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-See here for more details on the "Chaos Boss Dungeon."
Go to Notice List

Notices
[12/9 13:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] "Extreme" Added! Holiday Campaign "An Oath from Long Ago" is here! Get a MOD Skill for ★4 Kirito!
EVENT
2020-12-09 13:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Excited about the party taking place again this year,
you and partner go to meet with "Asuna" and the others and invite them along.
Rewards
Gather Third Medals, tradable items acquired as event rewards and drops, and get the limited-edition Asuna stamp or the
"MOD Skill" "★4 [Man of the Day] Kirito"
from the Trader!
Featuring
"Core Metals"
as a Total Score Reward.
Get up to 1,000
"Arcana Gems"
from the entire event.
You'll earn a certain score by clearing this dungeon.
Scores earned in "Entry", "Interior", "Depth", "DANGER", and "Special" difficulties all count toward the
"Total Score Reward"
. Your rewards will be based on your score.
The score earned in "Extreme" difficulty is not added to the "Total Score Reward", but you will receive rewards based on your score.
"Special"
You can get a high score in the
"Special"
difficulty in this event.
You can clear the
"Special"
three times per day.
* Once you clear the dungeon 3 times, you can't play it again until the limit resets at 4:00 (JST/UTC+9).

"Extreme"
The dungeon difficulty
"Extreme"
will be implemented during maintenance on December 9, 2020 (Wed).
You can clear the
"Extreme"
one times per day.
In addition, item use is restricted while inside the dungeon and "Revive Crystals" can only be used up to 1 times.
*Once you clear a Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets at 4:00 AM (JST/UTC+9).

First, talk to the "Mr. Kirito"  at the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to head to the "Party Area" Event Map.
Once you're at the "Party Area", talk to "Asuna" to start the scenario quest.
There are 5 scenario quests. Clear "A Present of Memories" to unlock the "Cake Party" dungeon.

Starts after the November 30, 2020 (Mon) maintenance and ends before the December 23, 2020 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Notices
《MOD Skills》 are here!
UPDATE
2020-11-30 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The new
《MOD Skill》
feature allowing you to customize skills was added on November 30, 2020 (Mon).
Use the 《MOD Skill》 to attach a Skill Record to the 《MOD Slot》 of a Skill Record of the same weapon type and give that skill [Bonuses].
Get up to 3 《MOD Slots》using items and Col.
Remove attached Skill Records using items.
《MOD Slot》
《MOD Skills》 have 《MOD Slots》where you can attach Skill Records.
Go to Menu > Status > Player Equipment and select any 《MOD Skill》 from MOD, and you can attach Skill Records of the same weapon type.
For example, only a 1H Sword Skill Record can be attached to a 1H Sword 《MOD Skill》.
The [Bonuses] activated by attaching to a 《MOD Skill》 are now marked with a ▲ at the beginning of the skill description and are displayed in blue.
Note that all [Bonuses] will be activated if there are more than one.
Partners and Assisting Characters can also be equipped with 《MOD Skills》.
It is possible to Enhance, Transform, and Limit Break Skill Records while attached to a 《MOD Slots》.
Unlocking 《MOD Slots》
The number of slots required depends on the [Bonuses] of the Skill Record.
There is only 1 《MOD Slot》 to start off with, but you can get up to 3 slots using unlock items and Col.

The higher the floor in Aincrad, the easier it is to collect pieces of the unlock items.
Unlocking the third slot requires a different unlock item for each weapon type.
Go to Menu > Status > Player Equipment and select any 《MOD Skill》 from MOD to unlock the 《MOD Slot》.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 13th Guild of Guilds "VS Wander Fatal Scythe" is here! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2021-04-07 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 13th Guild of Guilds "VS Wander Fatal Scythe" is here!
13th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the April 14, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 21, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be open for 7 days.
* During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The Raid Boss Dungeon is open outside of the ranking period.
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on "Depth" and "Extreme" difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" score rank rewards.
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, log out, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "13th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the April 7, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 21, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be level restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 51 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 76 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 101 or higher
"13th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
* Check in-game for more information on other rewards.
Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the accessory avatars
"Wander Gear F"
and
"Wander Cape F"
that come with a guild icon, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon"!
Event Period: Starts after the April 7, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 12, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Details
At the start of battle, it uses a stack buff that reduces the damage it takes.
This buff stacks based on the number of players defeated.
It also performs a dark attack that inflicts "Curse", and a wide-range set area attack that inflicts "Bleed".

Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Important
‧The Boss, "Wander Fatal Scythe", has different attack timing and more natural elemental weaknesses than it has had in its previous "Guild of Guilds" appearances.
‧The "13th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" you receive from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" will be deleted during maintenance on April 21 (Wed).
‧"13th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
‧The amount of "13th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
‧You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
‧Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
‧Your partner will not participate in the solo "Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧this Event cannot be challenged with an "Assist Party".
‧There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
‧The 12th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars, "Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Pink)" and "Guild Shoulder Guard (Pink)", will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on April 14 (Wed).
‧The production materials, "Evil Eye Skin" and "Evil Eye Orb", for the 12th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars will be removed as of maintenance on April 14 (Wed).
‧The 13th "Guild of Guilds" production materials will be removed as of maintenance on May 19, 2021 (Wed).
The Production Avatars will also no longer be displayed on the production list.
‧The 9th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and the 9th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on April 21, 2021 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Wander Shield B", "Wander Mask B", "Wander Brooch B", "Wander Gear E", and "Wander Cape E".
‧The 13th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader four months after ranking ends.
‧All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
‧You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a "Guild Room".
‧The 14th "Guild of Guilds" is scheduled to open on May 12, 2021 (Wed).

The 13th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be a High Score Ranking where guilds compete for ranks based on their High Score.
The boss, "Wander Fatal Scythe", will have a Dark natural elemental weakness and a Thrust weapon elemental weakness.
The 13th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is planned for April 14, 2021 (Wed).
--------------------------------
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 12th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the March 17, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 24, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 12th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve from defeating
the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depths" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 12th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x10, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Fifteen minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by
x25
.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, log out, or disconnect.

Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that can inflict "Petrify" and "Poison".
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color will change.
After it changes, Terror Gaze's defense will increase.
Once it changes, it can no longer inflict "Petrify", but its wide-range area attacks will become super wide-range area attacks.
When preparing its super wide-range area attack, Terror Gaze will gain a critical resistance buff.
Perform break with a Dagger Sword Skill to prevent its super wide-range area attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye inflicts a stack debuff that decreases your attack and defense, so watch for when it's preparing to attack, and avoid it.
The beam brings down a focus attack from above your head, and it will inflict a stack debuff that decreases attack and defense as well as "Poison" if it hits you.
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on "Extreme" difficulty.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The Worldwide 3 Year Anniversary is here! Add special effects to equipment with "Equipment Refinement"!
UPDATE
2021-03-24 18:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
To celebrate the Worldwide 3 Year Anniversary, we have added the new "Equipment Refinement" feature that lets you add special effects to your equipment according to your needs.
Forge your equipment with 《Hot Ore》, then refine it with 《Ingots》 to add the Ingots' effects to your equipment.
Create your own unique equipment to help see you through the floors and battles that await!
《Hot Ore》 drops from the 《Ragout Rabbit》 that occasionally appears on the field.
《Ingots》 can be produced from the 《Metal Scraps》 that drop when you defeat field monsters.
Choose the《Ingots》 that will give your equipment the desired effects, then refine away!
If you "Composition" multiples of the same 《Ingots》, you can increase the strength of the effect added to your equipment.
《Ingot》 Abilities (Examples)
Using 《Metal Scraps》 as materials, you can produce 《Ingots》 with various effects at random.
Each effect has its own advantages and disadvantages.
Item Name
Positive Effect
Negative Effect
Item Icon
Rare Ingot
Critical damage +10% when using skills under Poison status ailment *Cannot stack *Invalid with Partner
Damage -35%  when not under status ailment Poison
Rare Ingot
Fire elemental skill damage +8.5% *Cannot stack
Damage -35% for elements other than fire
Superior Ingot

Damage -20% for elements other than slash
Superior Ingot
Critical damage +5% against enemies with Burn *Cannot stack
Damage -20% to enemies without status ailment Burn
Common Ingot
Attack +135 when using water skills *Cannot stack
Damage -10% for elements other than water
Common Ingot
Attack +130 when using thrust element skills *Cannot stack
Damage -10% for elements other than thrust
*An 《Ingot》's positive effect is registered when "Composition" reaches the max level.
Equipment Status Increase
"Refined" equipment will receive a status increase: weapons will receive increased Attack, and armor will receive increased Defense.
《Detach》 and 《Disassemble》 Ingots
You can use "Col" to 《Detach》 any refined Ingots from equipment.
《Detach》 returns《Ingots》 to the state they were in before being refined.
《Disassemble》 will turn unneeded 《Ingots》 back into Metal Scraps.
You can select "Refine", "Forge", "Composition", or "Disassemble" by going to Menu > Items > Enhance/Trade > Enhance Equipment.
You can also do any of these by talking to the "Blacksmith" NPC and selecting Equipment.
Lisbeth's Smith Shop
‧The following equipment can only be "forged" or "refined" at Lisbeth's Smith Shop on the 48F.
Integral series
Nox Integral Series
Lux Integral Series
Dark Black Series
48F/In front of the Lisbeth's Smith Shop "Lisbeth"
* "Lisbeth" will appear when you complete the main quest on the 48F.
- Important
‧The effects shown on the banner are only examples.
‧"Shields" cannot be "forged" or "refined".
‧Equipment refined with 《Ingots》 cannot be "discarded", "sold", or used in "succession".
‧《Ingots》 with "Invalid with Partner" in the item description will not have the effect on the partner when refined into equipment.
‧The effects of matching 《Ingots》 cannot be stacked.
But matching effects of different 《Ingots》 can be stacked together.
‧Please receive 《Ingots》 in the Present box by the time limit.

Notices

EVENT
2021-03-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 12th Guild of Guilds "VS Terror Gaze" is here!
12th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the March 17, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 24, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be open for 7 days (1 day less than the previous event).
* During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The "Raid Boss Dungeon" is open outside of the ranking period.
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on Depth and Extreme difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
* From now on, you will receive "GoG Raid Boss Tickets" from "Score Rank Rewards" instead of "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" "Challenge Rewards".
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, log out, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "12th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the March 10, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 24, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the
"Guild Shoulder Guard (Pink)"
accessory avatar that comes with a guild icon, or the
"Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Pink)"
accessory avatar that replicates the Terror Gaze's eyeball, which shifts with any movement, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon"!

Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that can inflict "Petrify" and "Poison".
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color will change.
After it changes, Terror Gaze's defense will increase.
Once it changes, it can no longer inflict "Petrify", but its wide-range area attacks will become super wide-range area attacks.
When preparing its super wide-range area attack, Terror Gaze will gain a critical resistance buff.
Perform break with a Dagger Sword Skill to prevent its super wide-range area attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye inflicts a stack debuff that decreases your attack and defense, so watch for when it's preparing to attack, and avoid it.
The beam brings down a focus attack from above your head, and it will inflict a stack debuff that decreases attack and defense as well as "Poison" if it hits you.

* "Petrify" inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
* "Petrify" is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.

Protect the Crystals from the onslaught of monsters in this Returning now Defense Battle event!
For this event, you can challenge the dungeon with multiple parties in a "group". The player with the highest score in the group will be named the "MVP" on the results screen after clearing the dungeon.
There are Crystals in three locations on the map. The less damage done to them, and the faster the monsters are driven back, the higher your score.
Work with your allies to protect the Crystals and try for a high score to get nice rewards.
Rewards

For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
Pick up period
June 9,2021 Maintenance
* The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
The 12th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be a High Score Ranking where guilds compete for ranks based on their High Score.
The boss "Terror Gaze's" natural elemental weakness is "Water". Once its HP goes below a certain amount, it changes modes and becomes a different color. Its weapon elemental weakness will also change from "Blunt" to "Slash".
The 12th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is planned for March 17, 2021 (Wed).
--------------------------------
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 11th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the February 17, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 25, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 11th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve from defeating
the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depths" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 11th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x10, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Fifteen minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by
x25
.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, log out, or disconnect.
Buff & Debuff icon
Top Ranking Rewards
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Avatar
Get the "Medusa Shield (Brass)" shield avatar and the "Snakeskin Guild Cape (White)" accessory avatar marked with your guild's icon, as well as the "Snake Queen's Hair (Black)" accessory avatar with hair that sways back and forth when you move.

You can also get "Arcana Gems", "Medals of Unity", and more!
Trade the "Ranking Dungeon Badges" you get as challenge rewards for all kinds of "Great Jewels" and "Release Crystals" at the exclusive Trader.
* Check in-game for more information on challenge rewards.
Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Its attacks can inflict you with Bleed and Debility.
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts Petrify.
Recover HP once every 3 seconds for 10 minutes from the start of battle.
She has two powerful wide-range attacks that drop meteorites that can be broken by a 2H Spear Sword Skill and a 1H Rapier Sword Skill.
It gets buffs when preparing these attacks.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a 2H Spear, it gets a stack buff that increases its defense.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a Rapier, it gets a stack buff that increases its attack.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and cancel all the buffs it gained.
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on "Extreme" difficulty.
Weakness
Thrust Element
Poison
Burn
Bleed
Frostbite
* The damage-increasing effect of the "Awakening Skill" is not negated by "Chaos Recollection".
* Petrify inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
* Petrify is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
* Your max HP will decrease when hit with Debility attacks. It can fall to up to 99% from its original value.
You can restore it with a Cleansing Potion.
* The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
-Ranking Reward
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will be awarded with Avatars, Arcana Gems, and limited-edition records, etc.

STEP1
Produce "Stone++" transformation materials at the workshop.
In order to produce "Stone++", you will need "Stone+" and "Core Metal".
* Each "Stone++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: Transforming 1H Swords or Daggers will require a "Slicing Stone++" made from "Slicing Stone+" and "Core Metal".
STEP2
Transform "Lux Integral Series" equipment at the blacksmith using "Stone++" and "Butterfly Armament Stone".
STEP3
Transformation materials from a future floor update will allow you to transform Lux Integral Series equipment even further!
We hope you look forward to it!
Producing Lux Integral Series Equipment
The materials "Butterfly Armament Stone" and "Butterfly Scale" can be used to produce "Lux Integral Series" equipment.
* The base statuses will not be different to "Lux Integral Series" equipment that can be produced on 40F.

Notices
The 11th Guild of Guilds "VS Medusa" is here! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2021-02-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 11th Guild of Guilds "VS Medusa" is here!
11th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the February 17, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 25, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The Raid Boss Dungeon is open outside of the ranking period.
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive Ranking Rewards.
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on Depth and Extreme difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, log out, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "11th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the February 10, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 25, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be level restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 51 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 76 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 101 or higher
"11th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and Release Crystals are available as rewards in the Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon.
* Check in-game for more information on other rewards.
Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the shield avatar
"Snake's Shield (Red)"
and the accessory avatar
"Guild Arm Band (Black)"
, which comes with a guild icon, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the Raid Boss Dungeon!
Event Period: Starts after the February 10, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 10, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Guild Arm Band (Black)
Accessory Avatar
Snake's Shield (Red)
Shield avatar
* Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.
* Check in-game for more information on challenge rewards.
Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Its attacks can inflict you with Bleed and Debility.
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts Petrify.
Recover HP once every 3 seconds for 10 minutes from the start of battle.
She has two powerful wide-range attacks that drop meteorites that can be broken by a 2H Spear Sword Skill and a 1H Rapier Sword Skill.
It gets buffs when preparing these attacks.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a 2H Spear, it gets a stack buff that increases its defense.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a Rapier, it gets a stack buff that increases its attack.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and cancel all the buffs it gained.
Weakness

* Petrify inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
* Petrify is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
* Your max HP will decrease when hit with Debility attacks. It can fall to up to 99% from its original value.
You can restore it with a Cleansing Potion.

[5/19 13:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]Score Reward Changes for Dungeons on 13F and Higher
NOTICES
2021-05-19 13:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
The score reward changes that were previously announced have been implemented with the following details.
Changes
The score rewards for the Entry and Interior difficulty levels in dungeons on 13F and higher (including Labyrinth) have become Total Score Rewards for each dungeon.
As a result, scores earned in Entry and Interior difficulties will be added to the Total Score Reward for that dungeon, and you will now receive a reward based on your score.
1F to 12F dungeons will also be changed to "Total Score Rewards" in the future.
Should you have any feedback regarding the changes, please feel free to reach us at any time via Support.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
-----------------------------
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
Regarding the previously announced Score Reward improvements,
in consideration of those users who have not yet achieved the existing Score Rewards, we will postpone it until our maintenance on May 19, 2021 (Wed).
Should you have any feedback regarding the changes, please feel free to reach us at any time via Support.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
-----------------------------
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
As of the April 27, 2021 (Tue) maintenance, the score rewards for the "Entry" and "Interior" difficulty levels in dungeons on 13F and higher (including Labyrinth) will become "Total Score Rewards" for each dungeon.
As a result, scores earned in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will be added to the "Total Score Reward" for that dungeon, and you will receive a reward based on your score.
Scores earned previously in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will not be carried over to the "Total Score Reward" and will be reset.
Please note that any unclaimed "score rewards" will no longer be available after the maintenance.
1F to 12F dungeons will also be changed to "Total Score Rewards" in the future.
Should you have any feedback regarding the changes, please feel free to reach us at any time via Support.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

The large-scale 14th Guild of Guilds "VS Masquerade Demon" is here!
14th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the May 19, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 26, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be open for 7 days.
* During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The "Raid Boss Dungeon" is open outside of the ranking period.
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on "Depth" and "Extreme" difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" score rank rewards.
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, log out, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "14th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the May 12, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 26, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be level restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 51 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 76 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 101 or higher
"14th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
* Check in-game for more information on other rewards.

and

・Becomes available after you have defeated all the bosses in the Slash, Thrust, and Blunt weakness dungeons.
・The time limit is 10 minutes.

Unlike other difficulties, there is no countdown for the time limit. Please check the elapsed time displayed on the screen.
・You'll receive a score based on the damage you inflict.
You can check your score on the results screen after clearing.
Damage Contribution: increases based on the amount of damage you inflict.
Skill Damage Contribution: increases based on the amount of damage you deal with skills only.
* Any damage done that exceeds the boss's remaining HP will not be added to your score.
・The item "F. Kobold Lord Victor U" drops from the boss.
* Players who were defeated when the boss was defeated will not be able to get drop items.

in consideration of those users who have not yet achieved the existing Score Rewards, we will postpone it until our maintenance on May 19, 2021 (Wed).
Should you have any feedback regarding the changes, please feel free to reach us at any time via Support.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
-----------------------------
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
As of the April 27, 2021 (Tue) maintenance, the score rewards for the "Entry" and "Interior" difficulty levels in dungeons on 13F and higher (including Labyrinth) will become "Total Score Rewards" for each dungeon.
As a result, scores earned in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will be added to the "Total Score Reward" for that dungeon, and you will receive a reward based on your score.
Scores earned previously in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will not be carried over to the "Total Score Reward" and will be reset.
Please note that any unclaimed "score rewards" will no longer be available after the maintenance.
1F to 12F dungeons will also be changed to "Total Score Rewards" in the future.
Should you have any feedback regarding the changes, please feel free to reach us at any time via Support.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

The [1x Only] "Medal of Combat Arts" Trader lineup will be updated during maintenance on April 27, 2021 (Tue).
About [1x Only] "Medal of Combat Arts" Trader.
At the one-time limited "Medal of Combat Arts" Trader you can get rewards that appeared in past events like stamps and Chaos Crystal for producing the Dark Black Series.
Plus, it also features the "Asura Armament Stone", used for producing the Nox Integral Series, and the "Crossgigas Armament Stone", used for producing and transforming the Nox Integral Series!

Participate in the events and gather "Medal of Combat Arts"!
You can get some "Medals of Combat Arts" from different in-game events.

Find the Trader by going to Menu > Items > Enhance/Trade > Trade Limited Items and tapping the 1x Only Trade Medal of Combat Arts banner.

"Score Reward" Changes for Dungeons on 13F and Higher
NOTICES
2021-04-14 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
As of the April 27, 2021 (Tue) maintenance, the score rewards for the "Entry" and "Interior" difficulty levels in dungeons on 13F and higher (including Labyrinth) will become "Total Score Rewards" for each dungeon.
As a result, scores earned in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will be added to the "Total Score Reward" for that dungeon, and you will receive a reward based on your score.
Scores earned previously in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will not be carried over to the "Total Score Reward" and will be reset.
Please note that any unclaimed "score rewards" will no longer be available after the maintenance.
1F to 12F dungeons will also be changed to "Total Score Rewards" in the future.
Should you have any feedback regarding the changes, please feel free to reach us at any time via Support.

[4/12 Edit]Issue with the 12th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
NOTICES
2021-04-12 16:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
[4/12 Edit]
This is an announcement for everyone currently logged into Sword Art Online Integral Factor.
For players who did not properly receive their ranking rewards due to the issue that occurred, rewards will be compensated according to ranking results during our maintenance on 4/14 (Wed).
Additionally, players from guilds whose scores were updated while the issue was occurring and whose ranking rewards were changed will be compensated the difference between their ranking rewards and the ones that have already been sent.
Please note that the ranking results displayed in the game will not be updated due to our system.
We deeply apologize for this issue.
We apologize again for any inconvenience this may cause.
---------------
This is an announcement for everyone currently logged into Sword Art Online Integral Factor.
The following issues occurred with the 12th "Guild of Guilds" ranking event.
- Details
・Scores earned from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" were not reflected in the rankings.
・Ranking rewards were not sent to those who met the conditions to receive them while the issue was occurring.
- Duration of issue
3/24 (Wed) 10:00~13:00
Users affected by this issue will be compensated.
※We will announce the date and details at a later date.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused at this time.

The 17th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event will be a High Score Ranking where guilds compete for ranks based on their High Score.
The appearing boss "Wander Fatal Scythe" will be weak to the natural element "Water Element" and the weapon element "Blunt Element".
The 17th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is planned for August 18, 2021 (Wed).
--------------------------------
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 16th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the July 14, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 20, 2021 (Tue) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
- This event will be open for 6 days.
In the 16th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve from defeating
the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depth" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 16th GoG Ranking banner.
Ranking rewards have been updated for current and future events.
1st through 3rd places in particular will get even more Arcana Gems.
The guild that takes 1st place will earn 10,000 Arcana Gems!
* Currently, the ranking reward list does not display the number of Arcana Gems for the first place player.
The number that should be displayed is 10,000. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by
x30
, and your defense is boosted by x5.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that can inflict "Petrify" and "Poison".
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color will change.
After it changes modes, Terror Gaze's weapon elemental and natural elemental resistances will greatly increase.
Plus, after it changes modes, it will attack with a super wide-range area attack.
When preparing this super wide-range area attack, it will gain a stack buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player.
Perform break with a sword skill that has both Thrust and Earth Elements to prevent its super wide-range area attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye inflicts a stack debuff that decreases your attack and defense, so watch for when it's preparing to attack, and avoid it.
The beam brings down a focus attack from above your head, and it will inflict a stack debuff that decreases attack and defense as well as Poison if it hits you.
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on "Extreme" difficulty.

Ranking Reward Conditions
‧Winning.
‧Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
* The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
* The conditions will not be met if you are logged out when other players clear the dungeon.
* The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
* If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.

Notices

NOTICES
2021-07-21 10:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
The score reward changes that were previously announced have been implemented with the following details.
Changes
The score rewards for the Entry and Interior difficulty levels in  Dungeons on 1F - 12F (including Labyrinth) have become Total Score Rewards for each dungeon.
As a result, scores earned in Entry and Interior difficulties will be added to the Total Score Reward for that dungeon, and you will now receive a reward based on your score.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
-----------------------------
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
As of the August 4, 2021 (Wed) maintenance, the score rewards for the "Entry" and "Interior" difficulty levels in dungeons on 1F - 12F (including Labyrinth) will become "Total Score Rewards" for each dungeon.
As a result, scores earned in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will be added to the "Total Score Reward" for that dungeon, and you will receive a reward based on your score.
Scores earned previously in "Entry" and "Interior" difficulties will not be carried over to the "Total Score Reward" and will be reset.
Please note that any unclaimed "score rewards" will no longer be available after the maintenance.
Should you have any feedback regarding the changes, please feel free to reach us at any time via Support.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
About VR Mode Operation
UPDATE
2021-07-20 17:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
On July 20, 2021 (Tuesday), we added VR Mode.
VR Mode is a feature that allows players view the world of SAOIF in VR by using VR goggles for smartphone.
You cannot fight in VR Mode, but you can use some emotes and move around.
▼How to Start Up VR Mode
1. Open "Menu"> "Settings"> "Functions"> and tap "ON" by "VR Mode Start Up".
2. After tapping "OK" on the dialogue box that appears, a countdown will begin until the switch to VR Mode.
*You can tap OK to skip the countdown.
3. The system will switch to VR Mode, so put on your VR goggles.
*Please turn your device on its side so that the bottom of the device faces the right.
▼How to Quit VR Mode
Tap the "X" at the top left to quit VR Mode.
▼Eye Movement
With your VR goggles in place, you can look up at the sky, down at the ground, or look around at your surroundings by turning your head or body in the direction you want to look.
▼Character Movement
1. When you look at the floor of the place your want to move to, a white square panel will appear.
*If the area is too far, too close, or an area that was originally impossible to move to, the panel will either not be displayed or an "X" will appear.
2. Fix your posture so that the panel on the floor is fixed, and the panel will turn yellow.
3. When the panel turns yellow, the screen will go dark, and you will be moved to the area where the panel was displayed.
*It will appear as if you are walking to your surroundings.
▼Using the VR Menu
1. When you fix your posture, a "MENU" button will appear along with the square panel for movement.
2. Align the square panel with this "MENU" button and the panel will turn into a small, circular cursor.
3. When you fix your posture, the inside of the circle will turn yellow and a list of emotes and the button to reset your view will appear.
▼Using Emotes
With the VR mode menu open, align the cursor with the emote you wish to use, and you will be able to use the emote when the cursor turns completely yellow.
*The content of the emotion list cannot be changed.
▼View Reset
1. With the VR moder menu open, align the cursor with th "View Reset" button, and you will enter reset mode when the cursor turns completely yellow.
2. Please face straight ahead and fix your posture. After 5 sec, your viewing position will be reset, and your view will align with the direction the character is facing.
▼Important Notes
・Please exit VR mode immediately if you feel sick, tired, or experience a headache while using VR mode.
・You will not be able to see your surrounding while using the VR goggles, so please use them in a safe place.
・Any VR goggles used for VR mode must have binocular lenses.
・Some devices may not be VR compatible. Please check the specification of your device beforehand.
・There may be no VR goggles that match the size of your device, so please check beforehand.

EVENT
2021-07-09 04:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
"Daily Dungeons" that can usually only be cleared once per day can be cleared twice per day for the duration of the event!
"Daily Dungeons" are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of "Daily Dungeons" to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP and equipment enhancement items.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets at 4:00 AM (JST/UTC+9).

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 16th Guild of Guilds "VS Terror Gaze" is here! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2021-07-07 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 16th Guild of Guilds "VS Terror Gaze" is here!
16th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Ranking rewards have been updated for current and future events.
1st through 3rd places in particular will get even more Arcana Gems.
The guild that takes 1st place will earn 10000 Arcana Gems!
Event Period: Starts after the July 14, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 20, 2021 (Tue) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be open for 6 days.
* During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The "Raid Boss Dungeon" is open outside of the ranking period.
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on Depth and Extreme difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, log out, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "16th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the July 7, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 20, 2021 (Tue) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be Total Power restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 12,000 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 35,000 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 60,000 or higher
"16th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
* Check in-game for more information on other rewards.
Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the
"Guild Shoulder Guard (Red)"
accessory avatar that comes with a guild icon, or the
"Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Red)"
accessory avatar that replicates the Terror Gaze's eyeball, which shifts with any movement, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon"!
Event Period: Starts after the July 7, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 4, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Production Avatars

* Check in-game for more information on challenge rewards.
Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that can inflict "Petrify" and "Poison".
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color will change.
After it goes into Change Mode, Terror Gaze's weapon elemental and natural elemental resistances will greatly increase.
Plus, after it goes into Change Mode, it will attack with a super wide-range area attack.
When preparing this super wide-range area attack, it will gain a stack buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player.
Perform break with a sword skill that has both Thrust and Earth Elements to prevent its super wide-range area attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye inflicts a stack debuff that decreases your attack and defense, so watch for when it's preparing to attack, and avoid it.
The beam brings down a focus attack from above your head, and it will inflict a stack debuff that decreases attack and defense as well as Poison if it hits you.

At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will be awarded with Avatars, "Arcana Gems", and limited-edition records, etc.

- 1st-3rd place guilds will earn even more Arcana Gems.
- 1st-100th places will receive more Medals of Unity.
- 11th-100th places will be able to earn fewer types of reward Avatars according to their rank.
- 101st-10000th places will earn the same rewards regardless of their rank.

Medal of Unity
The Medals of Unity from Guild Ranking rewards and "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt rewards can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past "Guild of Guilds" events.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Important
‧The Boss, Terror Gaze, has different details and weaknesses than the one from a previous Guild of Guilds.
For the boss's details and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
‧The "16th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you receive from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" will be deleted during maintenance on July 20 (Tue).
‧"16th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
‧The amount of "16th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
‧You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
‧Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
‧Your partner will not participate in the solo "Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧this Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
‧There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
‧The 15th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars, "Guild Arm Band (Light Blue)" and "Snake's Shield (Light Blue)", will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on July 14 (Wed).
‧The production materials, "Snake Queen's Red Stone" and "Snake Queen's Skin", for the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars will be removed as of maintenance on July 14 (Wed).
‧The 16th "Guild of Guilds" production materials will be removed as of maintenance on August 18, 2021 (Wed).
The Production Avatars will also no longer be displayed on the production list.
‧The 12th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and the 12th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on July 20, 2021 (Tue).
Affected Items: Gaze Shield (Red Violet), Terrifying Helm (Pink), Terrifying Shield (Pink), Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Pink), and Guild Shoulder Guard (Pink).
‧The 16th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader four months after ranking ends.
‧All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
‧You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
‧The 17th "Guild of Guilds" is scheduled to begin on August 4, 2021 (Wed).

Notices

EVENT
2021-06-30 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The "[Returning] Watermelon Panic!" event held in 2020 is back!
* Scenario and reward progression are preserved for those who played the event in 2020.
[Returning] Watermelon Panic!
A beautiful beach by the pier with Kirito and Asuna, and...watermelon splitting?!
Fight alongside the SAOIF characters on the beach in the summertime scenario event!
Rewards
Gather "Marvelous Watermelon" available as event rewards and drop items, and exchange them at the Trader for previously-appearing swimsuit avatars and exclusive Memory Stamps.
"Coco Drink" is a useful item you can receive from score rewards or as drop items, and recovers party members' HP in the same field by 2000.
You can also get up to 10 Medals of Combat Arts, up to 50 Awakening Stars, up to 10 each of all kinds of Great Jewels, and up to 300 Arcana Gems from all the events.
* "Coco Drinks" will be deleted on September 8, 2021 (Wed) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).

Open the List of Events from the Menu in the upper left corner of the screen, and tap the [Returning] Watermelon Panic! banner to go to the Day Beach.
(Tapping the in-game banner will take you to the "Beach" Event Map.)
Once you're at the day beach, talk to "Asuna" to start the scenario quest.

Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the June 16, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 23, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the total score they receive from defeating Bosses in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon"
.
There are two difficulties for this Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon: "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme", where you can
get an even higher score
.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 15th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by
x30
, and your defense is boosted by x5.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts "Petrify".
Its other attacks can inflict you with "Bleed" or a debuff that decreases your "Petrify" resistance.
It has two powerful wide-range attacks that drop meteorites. You can break one with a Sword Skill that has both "Blunt" and "Holy Elements", and the other with a "Holy Element" 1H Club Sword Skill.
It gets buffs when preparing these attacks.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a Sword Skill that has both "Blunt" and "Holy Elements", it gets a buff that decreases the damage it takes from the player and a buff that grants critical resistance.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a "Holy Element" 1H Club Sword Skill, it gets a buff that decreases the damage it takes from the player and a buff that increases its Attack.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and cancel all the buffs it gained.
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on "Extreme" difficulty.

Ranking Reward Conditions
‧Winning.
‧Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
* The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
* The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
* The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
* If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
* Check if you are eligible for a reward from the 15th GoG Ranking banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
* You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild

Important
‧Each guild will be able to increase their total score during the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
In exchange, Raid Boss Dungeon score rewards will become unavailable.
Scores earned before the ranking period will be carried over to Raid Boss Dungeons after the ranking period.
* The total score in the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members and is added to after each battle. It is not the total score of all the members added up.
* When the total score reaches a certain amount in the 15th "Guild of Guilds"Ranking Event, a reward will be sent to all current guild members at that time.
* To check the total score rewards for the 15th "Guild of Guilds"Ranking Event, go to the top-left Menu > Community > Ranking > 15th GoG Ranking banner.
‧The time bonus for the Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon will give 1 point for every 3 seconds in Depth and 1 point per second in Extreme.
‧All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
‧You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
‧Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
‧You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
‧Your partner will not participate in the solo "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧this Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
‧If the Ranking Event ends while you are challenging the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon", the score for that attempt will not count toward rankings.
‧If you join a guild during or after the June 23, 2021 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive Ranking Rewards.
‧Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
‧The quest schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
