news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 15th Guild of Guilds "VS Medusa" is here! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2021-06-09 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 15th Guild of Guilds "VS Medusa" is here!
15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
"total score" your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the June 16, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 23, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be open for 7 days.
* During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The "Raid Boss Dungeon" is open outside of the ranking period.
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon", you will need
10
tickets for "Depth" difficulty and
5
tickets for "Extreme" difficulty.
Strong monsters will appear in the Extreme difficulty dungeon, but you'll get more points if you manage to defeat them.
There are also Total Score Rewards in this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* Ranking Dungeon Badges will not be available.
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "15th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the June 9, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 23, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be level restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 51 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 76 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Lv. 101 or higher
"15th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
* Check in-game for more information on other rewards.
Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the shield avatar
"Snake's Shield (Light Blue)"
and the accessory avatar
"Guild Arm Band (Light Blue)"
, which comes with a guild icon, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon"!
Event Period: Starts after the June 9, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 7, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Guild Arm Band (Light Blue)
Accessory Avatar
Snake's Shield (Light Blue)
Shield avatar
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.
* Check in-game for more information on the Total Score Rewards and challenge rewards.
Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts "Petrify".
Its other attacks can inflict you with "Bleed" or a debuff that decreases your "Petrify" resistance.
It has two powerful wide-range attacks that drop meteorites. You can break one with a Sword Skill that has both "Blunt" and "Holy Elements", and the other with a "Holy Element" 1H Club Sword Skill.
It gets buffs when preparing these attacks.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a Sword Skill that has both "Blunt" and "Holy Elements", it gets a buff that decreases the damage it takes from the player and a buff that grants critical resistance.
When it's preparing the attack that can be broken with a "Holy Element" 1H Club Sword Skill, it gets a buff that decreases the damage it takes from the player and a buff that increases its Attack.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and cancel all the buffs it gained.
Weakness
Blunt Element
Holy Element
* "Petrify" inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
* "Petrify" is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
Ranking Reward
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will be awarded with Avatars, "Arcana Gems", and limited-edition records, etc.

The "Medals of Unity" from Guild Ranking rewards and "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt rewards can be used at the exclusive Trader.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Important
Each guild will be able to increase their total score during the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
In exchange, "Raid Boss Dungeon" score rewards will become unavailable.
Scores earned before the ranking period will be carried over to "Raid Boss Dungeons" after the ranking period.
* The total score in the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members and is added to after each battle. It is not the total score of all the members added up.
* When the total score reaches a certain amount in the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event, a reward will be sent to all current guild members at that time.
* To check the Total Score Rewards for the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event, go to the top-left Menu > Community > Ranking > 15th GoG ranking banner, and check "Total Score".
‧The Boss, "Medusa", has different attack timing than the one from a previous "Guild of Guilds".
‧It also has different weapon elemental weaknesses, additional natural elemental weaknesses, and is no longer weak to Frostbite, Burn, and other status ailments.
‧The "15th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" you receive from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" will be deleted during maintenance on June 23 (Wed).
‧"15th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
‧The amount of "15th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
‧You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
‧Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
‧Your partner will not participate in the solo "Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧this Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
‧There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
‧The 14th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars, "Devil Mask E" and "Devil Tail E", will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on June 16 (Wed).
‧The production materials, "Demon Tail" and "Demon Claw", for the 14th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars will be removed as of maintenance on June 16 (Wed).
‧The 15th "Guild of Guilds" production materials will be removed as of maintenance on July 14, 2021 (Wed).
The Production Avatars will also no longer be displayed on the production list.
‧The 11th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and the 11th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on June 23, 2021 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Medusa Shield (Brass)", "Snake Queen's Hair (Black)", "Snakeskin Guild Cape (White)", "Guild Arm Band (Black)", and "Snake's Shield (Red)".
‧The 15th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader four months after ranking ends.
‧All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
‧You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
‧The 16th "Guild of Guilds" is scheduled to open on July 7, 2021 (Wed).

Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 18th Guild of Guilds "VS Masquerade Demon" is here!
18th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the October 6, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 13, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on "Depth" and "Extreme" difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" score rank rewards.
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "18th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the September 29, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 13, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be Total Power restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 5,000 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 10,000 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 25,000 or higher
"18th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the accessory avatars
"Devil Mask F"
and
"Devil Tail F"
, modeled after the "Masquerade Demon", using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon".
Event Period: Starts after the September 29, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 4, 2021 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Details
It gives itself a buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player and a stack buff for critical resistance.
It uses lightning focus attacks to give the player the status ailment "Paralysis" and the debuff "Weak Normal Attack".
With its dark attack, it stabs its spear into the ground and inflicts the player with debuffs that decrease defense and weaken normal attack.
It unleashes attacks that allow for wide range Skill Breaks.
For its Skill Breaking attacks, only "Dark Element" and "Thrust Element" sword skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
Recovers HP once every 3 seconds for 10 minutes from the start of battle.
While it's not easily inflicted with "Frostbite", "Bleed", "Burn", or "Poison", when inflicted, these status ailments do more damage than usual.
Also, it deals more damage than usual with the weapon elemental weakness "Thrust Element".

Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Boss Monster
Fatal Taurus King
Details
Appears with the monster Fatal Colonel Taurus.
After Fatal Colonel Taurus is defeated, Fatal General Taurus will appear.
Its attacks can inflict Paralysis or debuffs that reduce attack or defense, weaken normal attacks, or make you unable to use items.
At the start of battle, it gains a critical resistance buff and a buff that reduces the damage it takes.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
It will activate different levels of the formidable Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff depending on its remaining HP.
The message displayed when the move is activated will show how much damage is being reduced by the current level.
You only have 10 minutes for the dungeon, so timing your Awakening Skills is key!

"Groups"
You can take on Fatal Battles with a group of up to 18 members.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
How to Join Groups
·To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Ultra (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
* The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
·When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
·Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
·If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
·Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
·For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.

The "Search for the Phantom Mushroom ['20 Returning]" event held in 2020 is back!
Search for the Phantom Mushroom ['20 Returning]!
Looking to raise his level, Kirito ventured into a forest area. There, he discovered a strange mushroom sprouting from a cliff.
According to Argo, these mushrooms only grow on cliffs and precipices, have a mellow aroma, and possess an unbeatable flavor. They were the mushrooms on everyone's mind.
Kirito decided to discuss with Asuna how they might be able to harvest these mushrooms to eat later.
Thus, Kirito, Asuna, and the player headed together to the location.
Rewards
Get the tradable "Golden Fruit" and "Big Nuts" items as rewards or drops. Use these to get each Bear Avatar and the "Rare Mush Bow Bright" Weapon Avatar with glowing special effects that appeared before!

Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 17th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the August 18, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 25, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 17th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve from defeating
the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depth" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 17th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Kirito and Asuna were enjoying the event on the beachside map.
Although they looked like they were having a heart-to-heart, their conversation was all strategy.
Klein, believing their lack of romantic progression was due to getting in their own way, looked to fix this by suggesting they take place in a test of courage event.
Rewards
Get Light Brown Wooden Tags from the event and exchange them for the Ghost Costume or the Ghost Mask with new expressions!
"Dark Brown Wooden Tag" will be added as drops, and rewards will be added to the Trader, after the August 18, 2021 (Wed) maintenance.
Get up to 1,000
"Arcana Gems"
, up to 75
"Awakening Stars"
, and up to 15
"Medals of Combat Arts"
from the entire event.
Star Fragments have a chance of dropping from boss on DANGER, Gaining Ground, and Extreme dungeons.
- Limited-Time Items
It drops from bosses of dungeon of all difficulties at a fixed rate.
It can also be claimed from Score Rewards and the Exclusive Trader.

* "Summer Takoyaki", "Summer Snow Cone", and "Summer Cotton Candy" will be deleted on September 8, 2021 (Wed) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
* Limited-time items can also be obtained from the ongoing event Yuna Live "Songstress Festival".
The New Starting Point and Gaining Ground Difficulties
We've added new difficulty levels to dungeons as of this event.
·New Difficulty: Starting Point
Starting Point combines Entry and Interior into a single difficulty level.
The difficulty is the same as Entry, and the score you earn is the same as Interior.
·New Difficulty: Gaining Ground
This difficulty is named Gaining Ground because it's a bonus dungeon where high scores can be obtained.
You'll earn a certain score by clearing the dungeon.
Scores earned in "Starting Point", "Depth", "DANGER", and "Gaining Ground", difficulties all count toward the
Total Score Reward
. Your rewards will be based on your score.
The score earned in "Extreme" difficulty is not added to the Total Score Reward, but you will receive rewards based on your score.

Appears with a new technique.
With its variety of powerful attacks, freedom to run amok in the dungeon, and ability to inflict Debility, it's not going to let players off easily.
When its HP drops below a certain level, it starts to unleash an overpowering dual-blade attack.
On top of that, it will activate different levels of the formidable Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff depending on its remaining HP.
The message displayed when the move is activated will show how much damage is being reduced by the current level.
You only have 10 minutes, so timing "Awakening Skill" is key!

Added groups to Fatal Battles!
You can now take on Fatal Battles with a group of up to 18 members.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
How to Join Groups
·To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Ultra (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
* The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
·When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
·Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
·If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
·Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
·For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.

Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the August 18, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 25, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
* This event will be open for 7 days.
* During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
* The Raid Boss Dungeon is open outside of the ranking period.

tournament-limited "Record"
.

You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
* The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
* This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "17th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.

There will be Total Power restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.

Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 25,000 or higher

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Notice about 75F installation, unlocking super rare Rosso Integral Series weapon transformation, and other updates.
UPDATE
2021-11-30 17:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Assault Team Defeated
Players, allied NPCs, and allied monsters fought together in an unprecedented raid battle.
The Assault Team was defeated that day.
After reaching 75F, the last quarter point, the Assault Team takes on a large-scale raid event.
The Assault Team faces off against the ultimate predator—The Life Harvester.
The Assault Team tries a test run against a raid boss with the same attack patterns as the floor boss.
However, their spirits are broken by its overwhelming power, and they retreat with no will left to fight.
Most of the fighters are out of commission, and the Assault Team has been virtually destroyed. You and your few remaining friends decide on a plan.
The remaining members of the team will defeat the raid boss by themselves and prove that SAO can be cleared.
The mission's success depends on whether or not their powerful NPC allies will lend a hand.
These NPCs, however, need some convincing.
Will you be able to rally the Assault Team and clear the 75F?
Major Updates
‧Added a new quest alongside the release of the 75F.
‧Added large-scale raid All-Out Battles!
‧The super rare Rosso Integral Series weapon transformation has been unlocked.
《New Quest》
Eight quests have been released, including the main quest, two character quests, and subquests! The character quests include "Invincible Holy Sword", which depicts the respawned boss battle between Heathcliff and The Blue-Eyed Demon, and "A Holy Knight Visits a Family Restaurant", which depicts a rare incident that occurred during a brief rest.

Large-Scale Raid All-Out Battles
Take on the All Out Battle [The Skull Reaper] on the 75F.
An All-Out Battle is a large-scale raid where players work together to defeat a raid boss with an enormous amount of HP.
Defeat the raid boss, The Skull Reaper, to get rank rewards that are based on the total damage points.
Plus, the All Out Battle [The Skull Reaper] drops the Core Metal+++ material that you need to transform the Rosso Integral Series.
‧
Details about the "All Out Battle" are available here
"Rosso Integral Series" Transformations
* Image is for visualization purposes only.
Rare "Rosso Integral Series" transformation and production materials are now available!
Transform
"Rosso Integral Series" to make it even stronger!
Transforming Lux Integral Series Equipment
STEP1
Produce "Stone+++" transformation materials at the workshop.
To produce Stone+++, you will need the extremely rare Core Metal+++ and Stone+ materials that drop from the All Out Battle [The Skull Reaper].
* Each "Stone+++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: For 1H Swords or Daggers, you will need to produce Stone+++ using Core Metal+++ and Slicing Stone+.
STEP2
Transform "Rosso Integral Series" equipment at the blacksmith using "Stone+++" and "Gleam Eyes Armament Stone".
STEP3
Transformation materials from a future floor update will allow you to transform Rosso Integral Series equipment even further!
We hope you look forward to it!

news_list.full_details:
Notices
All Out Battle "The Skull Reaper" is on! Get boss avatars and "Core Metal+++", necessary for evolving the Rosso Integral Series!
EVENT
2021-11-30 17:25:00
（JST/GMT+9）
As of our maintenance on November 30, 2021 (Tues), we have added the All Out Battle "The Skull Reaper".
All Out Battle is a large-scale raid in which all players work together to defeat a raid boss with massive HP.
By successfully defeating the raid boss, "The Skull Reaper", you can get Rank Rewards based on Total Damage Points.
Rewards
There are 4 types of rewards obtainable from the All Out Battle "The Skull Reaper".
①Rank Rewards
Each player's Damage Points are calculated on the result screen by taking the amount of HP the boss loses from the start until the battle is cleared and dividing it by the number of players remaining in the dungeon at clear time.
Each player's "Damage Rank" will be calculated based on the Total Damage Points at the moment of defeat, accumulated from chiseling away at the raid boss's total HP. You can get Rank Rewards depending on your "Damage Rank".
Current Total HP and Total Damage Points can be checked from the Dungeon List.
Rank Rewards will be sent to the present box when you log in or move to another map after defeat.
You must get at least 1 Damage Point to qualify to receive Rank Rewards.
②Score Rewards
You can get certain scores by clearing the dungeon.
Clear Bonus, Time Bonus, and Survival Bonus will be calculated, and you will receive rewards based on your score.

③Drop Rewards
"The Skull Reaper" will drop items.
"Core Medal+++", which drops from "The Skull Reaper" at a very low rate, is a required material for evolving the Rosso Integral Series.
You can produce boss avatars based on "The Skull Reaper" from the material items "Skull Reaper Rib" and "Skull Reaper Femur".
* Production recipes for avatar will be displayed after you clear the 75th floor.
Boss avatar Images
④Challenge Rewards
These are rewards you can get based on certain conditions.
You can challenge the All Out Battle "The Skull Reaper" by talking to the Young Record Keeper at "75F In Front of the Boss Room".
You can clear the battle as many times as you like by cutting away at the raid boss's HP until it has been defeated.
* There is a limit to the amount of HP that can be diminished in a single battle.
"The Skull Reaper" will reappear after "Defeat".
Participation Requirements
Clear the 75F Main Quest through the end
Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 120,000 or higher
Go to "75F In Front of the Boss Room" by playing the labyrinth or by using a Corridor Crystal from "Swordswoman Assisting Asuna" in "Battle Gorge".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
"Connect Skill" are here for the Holiday Campaign! Link your skills and activate them!
UPDATE
2021-11-30 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Holiday Campaign!
We've added the new feature
"Connect Skill"
, where you can continuously activate sword skills.
《Connect Skill》 is a feature that allows you to activate sword skills consecutively by linking sword skills of the same weapon time through a 《Connector》 .
Link up to 3 sword skills with a 《Connector》 to activate up to four consecutive sword skills with a single attack.
With no SP consumption and only 1/5 of the skill's cool time, you can activate continuous sword skills with increased ability with the connect chain effect.
Use the sword skills you've been collecting so far and get a whole new power.
How to Get a《Connect Skill》
Clear the 75F Main Quest through the end to get a《Connect Skill》★3[Unshakable Conviction] Heathcliff as a quest reward.
★3[Unshakable Conviction] Heathcliff
weapon type
1H Sword
Skill Name
Savage Fulldivide
SP Cost
22
Element
Slash
Skill effect
1000% damage (3x hit/Single Foe)[Front/Long/Mid]/[Toukou 5/Buff] -50% damage taken for 2 sec.(Invalid when equipped by Partner)
*Evolving & Maximum Breakthrough
Connect Chain
Recovers 300 → 600 → 900 HP when hitting with skills.
How to Use a《Connect Skill》
《Connect Skill》 uses a 《Connector》 to link Skill Records.
By selecting the option 《Connect Skill》 from "Menu"> "Items"> "Enhance/Trade"> "Enhance Skill Record"> "Connect", and linking Skill Records of the same weapon type to the 《Connector》 you will be able to activate sword skills consecutively.
By tapping skill button, the equipped 《Connect Skill》 will continuously activate automatically. You can even move around while using it.
You can cancel it by stepping, normal attacks, using the skill button, or activating switch.
If you are too far away from a target after activating, you will perform a follow-up movement.
This move will be canceled if you perform a move, and the sword skill sequence will end.
1/5 (rounded to the nearest whole number) of the skill cool time of the linked Sword Skills are added to the skill cool time of the 《Connect Skill》.
You can also enhance, evolve, and limit break Skill Records linked to a 《Connector》.
Note that Koharu and assisting characters can also equip 《Connect Skill》, but the connected skill will not be activated.
Connect Chain
The linked sword skills will have the "Connect Chain" effect of the 《Connect Skills》, such as reducing the skill's cool time.
The more sword skills you connect, the more powerful the "Connect Chain" effect will be.
Example:★4[A Will to Carry On] Asuna
Connect Chain:Reduces all skill's cool times when hitting with skills.
First Card Effect:Reduces all skill's cool times by 3 sec when hitting with skills.
Second Card Effect:Reduces all skill's cool times by 6 sec when hitting with skills.
Third Card Effect:Reduces all skill's cool times by 9 sec when hitting with skills.
★4[A Will to Carry On] Asuna
weapon type
1H Rapier
Skill Name
Hydro Reap
SP Cost
24
Element
Thrust/
Water
Skill effect
1420% damage (Single Foe)[Front/Long/Mid]/[Parry4/Buff] When this skill direct hits, the damage you receive decreases at 50%(Effect will disappear after 20 sec if not activated).
*Evolving & Maximum Breakthrough
Connect Chain
Reduces all skill's cool times by 3 → 6 → 9 sec when hitting with skills.
Unlocking a 《Connector》
In the initial stage, you will only have one 《Connector》, but by breaking through Skill Records, you can unlock up to a maximum of three.
The second 《Connector》will be released with one limit break, and the third 《Connector》 will be unlocked after five limit breaks.
Removing a 《Connector》
You can remove a 《Connector》 by selecting the option 《Connect Skill》 from "Menu"> "Items"> "Enhance/Trade"> "Enhance Skill Record"> "Connect".
Important
·Skill records connected to the 《Connector》 will no longer be equippable to the player, Koharu, or assisting characters.
·Skill Records connected to the 《Connector》 cannot be connected to any other 《Connect Skill》.
·A 《Connect Skill》 whose Skill Record is connected to the 《Connector》 cannot be connected to any other 《Connect Skill》.
·《Connectors》 can be connected to Burst Skills, but combos will not count and Burst will not be activated.
·The "Awakening level" of Awakening Skills and "Recollection Skills" linked to a 《Connector》 will not be reflected.
·Unattached MOD Skills can be linked to a 《Connector》.
Similarly, the 《Mod Slot》 of the Mod Skill can be used to attach a Connect Skill without being linked to anything.
·When a 《Connector》 is linked to a Skill Record with a Charge feature, it will be activated at the time of charge.
·For Skill Records you have equipped with effects specified by a character (for example, when an effect is activated by equipping 3 or more of Asuna’s Skill Records), the character part of the Skill Record you have linked to the 《Connector》 will not be reflected.
· "Connect Skill" can also be accessed from the "Connect" menu under "Menu" > "Status" > "Player Equipment" > "MOD".

--------------------------------
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 19th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the November 10, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 17, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 19th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve from defeating
the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depth" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 19th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Top Ranking Rewards
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
At the start of battle, it will gain a stack buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player.
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts "Petrify".
Its other attacks can inflict you with Bleed, a debuff that decreases your Petrify resistance, or a debuff that decreases your defense.
Unleashes a Skill Breakable attack that drops meteorites over a wide area.
The Skill Break gauge of one Skill Breakable attack can be reduced by Sword Skills that have both the Slash and Fire Element, and Fire Element 1H Sword Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge of the other.
It gains the following buffs while preparing a Skill Breakable attack.
‧Reduces damage taken from player (stackable).
‧Increases its attack (stackable).
‧Increases its defense (stackable).
‧Increases its critical resistance (stackable).
Note that if you are hit by a Skill Breakable attack, buff effects on the player will be removed.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and remove all its buffs.
The boss's defense is high, but the damage increase given when it is immobilized after a successful Skill Break is also significant.
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on "Extreme" difficulty.

Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!

2021-11-05 04:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
"Daily Dungeons" that can usually only be cleared once per day can be cleared twice per day for the duration of the event!
"Daily Dungeons" are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of "Daily Dungeons" to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP and equipment enhancement items.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets at 4:00 AM (JST/UTC+9).

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 19th Guild of Guilds "VS Medusa" is here! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2021-11-04 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 19th Guild of Guilds "VS Medusa" is here!
19th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the November 10, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 17, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on "Depth" and "Extreme" difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" score rank rewards.
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "19th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the November 4, 2021 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the November 17, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be Total Power restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 5,000 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 10,000 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 25,000 or higher
"19th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the shield avatar
"Snake's Shield (Brown)"
and the accessory avatar
"Guild Arm Band (Brown)"
, which comes with a guild icon, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon"!
Event Period: Starts after the November 4, 2021 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the December 8, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
At the start of battle, it will gain a stack buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player.
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts "Petrify".
Its other attacks can inflict you with Bleed, a debuff that decreases your Petrify resistance, or a debuff that decreases your defense.
Unleashes a Skill Breakable attack that drops meteorites over a wide area.
The Skill Break gauge of one Skill Breakable attack can be reduced by Sword Skills that have both the Slash and Fire Element, and Fire Element 1H Sword Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge of the other.
It gains the following buffs while preparing a Skill Breakable attack.
‧Reduces damage taken from player (stackable).
‧Increases its attack (stackable).
‧Increases its defense (stackable).
‧Increases its critical resistance (stackable).
Note that if you are hit by a Skill Breakable attack, buff effects on the player will be removed.
Perform a successful Skill Break to incapacitate the boss for several seconds and remove all its buffs.
The boss's defense is high, but the damage increase given when it is immobilized after a successful Skill Break is also significant.
Weakness
Slash Element
Fire Element

The "Medals of Unity" from Guild Ranking rewards and "Guild of Guilds" High Lv Boss Hunt rewards can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past "Guild of Guilds" events.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Important
‧The Boss, Medusa, has different details and weaknesses than the one from a previous Guild of Guilds.
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
‧"Petrify" inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
"Petrify" is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
‧Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.
‧Please check all Rewards in the game.
‧The "19th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" you receive from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" will be deleted during maintenance on November 17 (Wed).
‧"19th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
‧The amount of "19th GoG Raid Boss Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
‧You will be matched with players from other guilds when using Quick Party at the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
‧Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
‧Koharu will not join for "Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧this Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
‧There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
‧The 19th "Guild of Guilds" production materials will be removed as of maintenance on December 15, 2021 (Wed).
The Production Avatars will also no longer be displayed on the production list.
‧The 15th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and the 15th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on November 17, 2021 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Medusa Shield (Bronze)", "Snake Queen's Hair (Light Blue)", "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Light Blue)", "Guild Arm Band (Light Blue)", and "Snake's Shield (Light Blue)".
‧The 19th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
‧All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
‧You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
‧During the ranking period, you cannot challenge Raid Bosses other than those in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
‧The Raid Boss Dungeon is open outside of the ranking period.
‧To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 19th GoG Ranking banner.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
‧The 20th "Guild of Guilds" is scheduled to open on January 6, 2022 (Thu).
Go to Notice List

Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 18th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the October 6, 2021 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 13, 2021 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 18th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve from defeating
the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depth" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 18th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Masquerade Demon
Details
It gives itself a buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player and a stack buff for critical resistance.
It uses lightning focus attacks to give the player the status ailment "Paralysis" and the debuff "Weak Normal Attack".
With its dark attack, it stabs its spear into the ground and inflicts the player with debuffs that decrease defense and weaken normal attack.
It unleashes attacks that allow for wide range Skill Breaks.
For its Skill Breaking attacks, only "Dark Element" and "Thrust Element" sword skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
Recovers HP once every 3 seconds for 10 minutes from the start of battle.
While it's not easily inflicted with "Frostbite", "Bleed", "Burn", or "Poison", when inflicted, these status ailments do more damage than usual.
Also, it deals more damage than usual with the weapon elemental weakness "Thrust Element".
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it removes its own status ailments and debuffs.

・Changed the stamp window.

"Favorite" stamps are no longer added to the history.

・Changed the notification icon for unread chats.
When there are new unread notifications, a yellow "!" mark will be displayed regardless of the chat type.
・Added a feature that makes some items unusable on certain fields.
・Changed the button on the Revive Crystal window.

If you have not obtained the equipment Lv. 90 "Dark Black Armor", please try challenging the boss.
You can challenge "Entry" to get Lv.90 "Dark Black Thunder Bull" equipment and "Interior" to get Lv.95 "Dark Black False Statue" equipment with a party!
Dungeon Duration
Starts after the February 9, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 23, 2022 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
New Boss monster
Crossgigas Chaos
Details
It has critical resistance.
Plus, it continually reduces damage taken from the player.
At the start of battle, it gains a critical resistance buff.
Deal attacks that put players in a status ailment such as "Stun" or "Scorch", and debuffs such as "Seal item", "Decrease defense", and "Weaken normal attack".
If HP is over 50%, all attacks will give the player the debuffs "Decrease defense", and "Weaken normal attack".
Deal four different attacks that can Skill Break.
①"Dagger" Sword skill attack that reduces the skill break gauge.
②"Dagger" sword skill attack that reduces the skill break gauge and a long reception time for skill breaks.
➂An attack that reduces the skill break gauge with a sword skill that meets the two conditions of "1H Sword" and "Holy Element".
④An attack that reduces the skill break gauge with a sword skill that meets the two conditions of "1H Sword" and "Holy Element", and a long reception time for skill breaks.
By blocking an attack that can skill break with a skill break, the buff will be removed. In addition, a stack debuff is applied that increases the damage you take.
Debuffs will grant more stacks if the longer skill break reception time is blocked.
If you fail to block an attack that can skill break, you will receive the following buffs.
‧"Increase Attack" stack buff.
‧"Increase Defense" stack buff.
‧A buff that reduces damage taken from players and reflects damage for a certain amount of time.
Stack buffs will have a stack count of 99 when the player is in near-death state.
When its HP goes below a certain amount, it uses the damage-reduction buff Chaos Recollection.
Use an Awakening Skill to counter.

Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 20th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the January 13, 2022 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the January 19, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 20th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve from defeating
the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depth" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 20th GoG Ranking banner.
‧You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Terror Gaze
Details
It has a high defense and is resistant to all elements aside from its weaknesses at all times.
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that inflicts Petrify and Poison.
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color will change.
After it changes modes, any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed, and its weapon elemental resistances and natural elemental resistances will greatly increase.
Plus, after it goes into Change Mode, it will attack with a super wide-range area attack.
When preparing this super wide-range area attack, it will gain a stack buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player.
Perform a Skill Break with a Sword Skill that has both Blunt and Earth Elements to prevent this attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye removes your buffs and inflicts stack debuffs that decrease your attack and defense.
The beam brings down a focus attack from above your head, and it will erase any buffs on you, as well as inflict a stack debuff that decreases attack and defense as well as Poison if it hits you.
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on "Extreme" difficulty.

‧Winning.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.

Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.

Important
‧The "Terror Gaze" that appears in the "Extreme" difficulty is more powerful than the "Special" difficulty boss.
‧The damage-increasing effect of the "Awakening Skill" is not negated by "Chaos Recollection".
‧"Petrify" inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
"Petrify" is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
‧The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
‧The score in the 20th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is shared between all guild members.
‧There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" of the 20th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event.
‧The time bonus for the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".

（JST/GMT+9）
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The large-scale 20th Guild of Guilds "VS Terror Gaze" is here!
20th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Defeat the fierce Boss from the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" and compete in the rankings with the
highest score your guild achieves during the event.
Event Period: Starts after the January 13, 2022 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the January 19, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" to receive "Ranking Rewards".
Finish with a top rank to receive a
tournament-limited "Record"
.
To enter the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon" on "Depth" and "Extreme" difficulties, you will need
5
tickets from the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon" score rank rewards.
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon
Collect the "20th GoG Raid Boss Tickets" you need to participate in the competition from this dungeon.
Gather the tickets in advance to smooth out the process during rankings.
Event Period: Starts after the January 6, 2022 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the January 19, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
There will be Total Power restrictions on each difficulty for players participating in Quick Parties.
Entry: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 5,000 or higher
Interior: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 10,000 or higher
Depth: Quick Party participation requirement - Total Power 25,000 or higher
"20th GoG Raid Boss Tickets", Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and "Release Crystals" are available as rewards in the "Boss Ticket Collection Dungeon".
Raid Boss Dungeon
Try making the
"Guild Shoulder Guard (Aqua)"
accessory avatar that comes with a guild icon, or the
"Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Aqua)"
accessory avatar that replicates the Terror Gaze's eyeball, which shifts with any movement, using special materials you get as drops from the Raid Boss and as challenge rewards in the "Raid Boss Dungeon"!
Event Period: Starts after the January 6, 2022 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the February 9, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Details
It has a high defense and is resistant to all elements aside from its weaknesses at all times.
A huge eye appears on the ground for a wide-range area attack that inflicts Petrify and Poison.
Once its HP goes below a certain amount, its color will change.
After it changes modes, any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed, and its weapon elemental resistances and natural elemental resistances will greatly increase.
Plus, after it goes into Change Mode, it will attack with a super wide-range area attack.
When preparing this super wide-range area attack, it will gain a stack buff that reduces the damage it takes from the player.
Perform a Skill Break with a Sword Skill that has both Blunt and Earth Elements to prevent this attack.
The beam it shoots from its eye removes your buffs and inflicts stack debuffs that decrease your attack and defense.
The beam brings down a focus attack from above your head, and it will erase any buffs on you, as well as inflict a stack debuff that decreases attack and defense as well as Poison if it hits you.

A new and improved Guild of Guilds!
22nd "Guild of Guilds" is here!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
New Guild of Guilds
Starting with the 22nd "Guild of Guilds", major changes have been made to the event's dungeons and reward system.
■Dungeon Changes
The preparation period for Guild of Guilds has been renamed "Guild of Guilds" Preseason.
The Guild of Guilds ranking period has been renamed "Guild of Guilds" Season.
There are no longer any Ticket Collecting Dungeons. Tickets can now be earned from challenge rewards when you defeat bosses in "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeons.
In addition, avatar production materials can be collected from drop rewards and challenge rewards in "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeons.
Tickets can be collected in advance to ensure a smooth "Guild of Guilds" Season experience.
You'll earn a score by clearing the dungeon.
Scores earned in "Guild of Guilds" Preseason Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the
"Total Score Reward"
. You will earn rewards based on your score.

"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 22 Dungeon Period: Starts after the April 6, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 20, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
"Guild of Guilds" Season 22 Dungeon Period: Starts after the April 13, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 20, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
During the Guild of Guilds event, the Teleport Gate Plaza will have a special design and background music.
■Ranking Reward Changes

Details
Recovers HP once every 3 seconds for 10 minutes from the start of battle.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs.
It gains a buff that reduces the damage it takes from players and a buff that gives it critical resistance.
Its lightning focus attack inflicts Paralysis and Curse, as well as debuffs that weaken normal attacks and decrease defense.
Its Dark attacks and attacks that thrust a spear into the ground inflict Curse and debuffs that decrease defense and weaken normal attacks.
It unleashes attacks that allow for wide range Skill Breaks.
There are three types of Skill Breakable attacks.
1) Only Slash Element Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
2) Only Dagger Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
3) Only Sword Skills that are both 1H Sword and Dark Element can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
When it's preparing a Skill Breakable attack, it gains buffs that decrease the damage it takes from players or give it critical resistance.
Plus, it removes the status ailments it's inflicted with.
While it's not easily inflicted with "Frostbite", "Bleed", "Burn", or "Poison", when inflicted, these status ailments do more damage than usual.

The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".

It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 22 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.

The story goes into uncharted territory...
Introducing SAOIF's first full-length, completely original scenario, which takes place after the end of the Aincrad arc!
A few days after the opening of the 81st floor, Asuna, Argo, and Lind send for you.
You receive a large-scale investigation request from the Knights of the Blood Oath and the Holy Dragon Alliance.
A long quest has been revealed by Argo's preliminary research.
And, with the two major guilds of the Assault Team
focused on raising their current strength,
you are the only one who can complete this epic quest.
When you visit the highlands of Al Tu-Ra, you are met by the people who make the harsh environment their home, and
the Millennial Beasts who dwell deep in the forest and speak the human language.
And between humans and beasts is a never-ending struggle that has been going on since time itself.
As you unravel the story, you will learn the truth of what happened in a distant past
and be tasked with the challenge of ending this long-running conflict.
Will you be able to end the age-long strife and conquer the 81st floor?

Details
This battle will take place on a "field with unusable items".
When the battle starts, it will use a buff that gradually recovers its own HP.
In the Character Quest and Labyrinth, it will also use a "critical resistance" buff.
It will deal attacks that inflict the "Frostbite" and "Poison" status ailments, as well as the "Decrease Defense" and "Weaken Normal Attack" debuffs, on the player.
In the Character Quest and Labyrinth, it will deal attacks that inflict the "seal item" debuff.
This monster has a Break Gauge. Deal enough damage to temporarily immobilize it.
The Break Gauge only accumulates from dagger attacks.
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it will use a buff that gradually recovers its own HP and the "increase attack" buff on itself.
In the Character Quest and Labyrinth, when its HP falls below a certain amount, it will also remove any debuffs from itself.

Collect the material item "Land Devourer Armament Stone" from
extremely rare
boss drops on 81F to transform Rosso Integral Series equipment!
Transform to raise weapon stats and add special effects.
How to Transform to the 3rd Level
STEP1
Get the Rosso Integral Series to ★4 (2nd Level Transformation)!
Transform "Rosso Integral Series" to ★4 here.
STEP2
Produce the transformation material "Stone+++" necessary for the ★5 Rosso Integral Series!
To produce Stone+++, you will need the extremely rare Core Metal+++ and Stone+ materials that drop from the All-Out Battle "The Skull Reaper".
* Production recipes that use Stone+++ will be available when you complete the 74F main quest.
* Each "Stone+++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: For 1H Swords or Daggers, you will need to produce Slicing Stone+++ using Core Metal+++ and Slicing Stone+.
STEP3
Use the Stone+++ you produced and the Land Devourer Armament Stone dropped from the 81F boss monster to transform the Rosso Integral Series equipment to ★5!
Producing Rosso Integral Series Equipment
"Land Devourer Armament Stone" and "Land Devourer Sludge" dropped by the 81F boss can be used to produce Rosso Integral Series equipment.
* The base statuses will not be different to Rosso Integral Series equipment that can be produced on 61F and 74F.
* Production recipes that use "Land Devourer Armament Stone" and "Land Devourer Sludge" will be available when you complete the 77F Main Quest.

--------------------------------
Which guild is the strongest in Aincrad?!
Challenge the Raid Boss with the combined power of up to 30 guild members!
The 21st "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event is here!
Event Period: Starts after the February 17, 2022 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the February 24, 2022 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
In the 21st "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event,
guilds compete for ranks based on the highest score they achieve
from defeating the Boss in the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
There are two difficulties for this "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon": "Depth" and the high-difficulty "Extreme",
where you can get an even higher score
.
Rankings will show the higher of the high scores you earn in difficulties "Depth" and "Extreme".
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 21st GoG Ranking banner.
You will get stronger after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Ranking Raid Boss Dungeon".
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Top Ranking Rewards
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

New Boss monster
Sticky Thing Chaos
Details
It has critical resistance.
Plus, it continually reduces damage taken from the player.
At the start of battle, it gains a critical resistance buff.
It deals attacks that inflict the status ailment "Bloodshed" on the player and the debuff "Weaken normal attack".
When its HP goes below a certain amount, it uses the damage-reduction buff Chaos Recollection.
When this happens, it uses a stack buff to reduce damage dealt by the player and the buff "Increase Attack".
Then it launches a large-scale attack.
Players receiving the large-scale attack will have their buffs removed, as well as receive the status ailment "Bloodshed" and debuff "Weaken normal attack".
Produces a sticky mold in various forms such as worms and balls.
Each time a sticky mold is defeated, all enemies in the field will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage dealt by the player.
Additionally, these sticky molds have a resistance to critical rate, slash element, and blunt element, and they deal attacks that inflict the player with debuffs that lower thrust element damage and wind element damage, as well as remove all buffs from the player.
Attacks dealt by multiple sticky molds at the same time should be considered a threat, as they will cause the player to flinch.
Take counter-measures to prevent this with skills that provide resistance to flinch.

Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
Damage from elemental weaknesses is more than usual.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes and remove any debuffs and status ailments on itself.
The Skill Breakable attack is breakable by skills with the "Thrust Element".
When preparing for its Skill Breakable attack, the boss will use the "Reduce Damage" buff.
As you take some of its attacks, the boss will receive the "Increase Defense" buff.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.

The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period

"Guild of Guilds" Season 24 Dungeon Period: Starts after the June 15, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 22, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]

The "Terrifying Shoulder Gaurd (Orange)" and "Guild Shoulder Gaurd (Orange)" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on June 29 (Wed).
"GoG Season 24 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.

Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.

It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 24 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, other Guild of Guilds dungeon difficulties cannot be attempted.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
85F installed, super rare Yasha Integral Series Equipment, and more.
UPDATE
2022-05-25 18:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Yuuki: Surpassing the Legendary Sword
"My question to you for the next time we meet. Can a being whose time has already passed still be described as alive?"
After the 81st floor is cleared, Lueur informs you of the truth, sending you and Koharu into despair.
Tortured by questions of your own existence, you finally battle the 84F floor boss. In your distracted state, you come close to losing all your HP.
Asuna decides you and the equally troubled Koharu should take a break and temporarily withdraw from the Assault Team.
Lagging behind the Assault Team and brokenhearted, your group finally reaches the 85th floor.
You decide to rest in Longhuai—a Chinese-inspired frontline town.
There, you meet a mysterious and beautiful woman, Anastasia. An unexpected bond of fate connects her to your group...
Meanwhile, Yuuki is also in Longhuai and has become an apprentice of the invincible martial artist Linhua.
Yuuki has already reached the level of the Legendary Sword and now has her sights set on even greater strength.
However, Linhua also has a surprising secret...
You and Anastasia. Yuuki and Linhua.
What will result from this mingling of minds between player and NPC, human and AI?
Will you find the strength to rise again?
Amidst these fateful encounters, Lueur's group of four begins to make their move.
They, too, will risk their lives in a final fight to reclaim a glimmer of hope instilled long ago.
Major Updates
Added a new quest alongside the release of the 85F.
The player level cap has been raised (Lv.190).
Added 85F boss avatars.
The very rare "Yasha Integral Series" of weapons has been added.
Rewards for the 85F main quest include the Blue Rose Badge item.

If you have not yet unlocked Assisting Character Eugeo, this is your chance, so get those rewards!

Boss Monster
Huang the Hundred Arms
Details
This battle will take place on a "field with unusable items".
It deals an attack that inflicts status ailments "Curse" and "Bloodshed" on the player.
Each time it attacks the player, it receives a stack buff that increases its attack.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes mode so that it uses two swords.
At this time, it uses a stack buff that increases its attack.
It will unleash Skill Breakable attacks, and the Skill Break Gauge can only be reduced by Sword Skills that have the Thrust Element.
When a Break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
Also, it will receive a stack debuff that boosts the damage it takes.
In the Character Quest and Labyrinth, When battle starts, it will use a Critical Resistance buff.
Also, in addition to dealing attacks that inflict the player with the status ailments "Curse" and "Bloodshed", it also deals an attack that inflicts the debuff "Seal Item".

-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 23
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 23, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 23 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 23 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from May 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on June 22 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
When battle starts, it will use a stack buff that reduces damage taken from the player.
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts "Petrify" and "Bloodshed".
Additionally, it also deals an attack that inflicts the player with the status ailment "Bloodshed" and an attack that inflicts the debuffs "Decrease attack" and "Seal item".
Unleashes a Skill Breakable attack that drops meteorites over a wide area.
The Skill Break gauge of one Skill Breakable attack can be reduced by Sword Skills that have both the Blunt and Wind Element, and Blunt Element Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge of the other.
It gains the following buffs while preparing a Skill Breakable attack.
‧Reduces damage taken from player (stackable).
‧Increases its attack (stackable).
‧Increases its defense (stackable).
‧Increases its critical resistance (stackable).
If you are hit by a Skill Breakable attack, buff effects on the player will be removed.
When you perform a Break, the boss will be temporarily incapacitated and all of its buffs will be removed.
Additionally, it will receive a stack debuff that boosts further damage taken from the player and the increase in damage taken while incapacitated will be significant.
Act fast to Break it.
Use an Awakening Skill against the Chaos Recollection damage-reduction buff it uses on "Extreme" difficulty.

Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
When battle starts, it will use a stack buff that reduces damage taken from the player.
It also has an attack that emits a powerful light and inflicts "Petrify" and "Bloodshed".
An addition to that, it also deals an attack that inflicts the player with the status ailment "Bloodshed" and an attack that inflicts the debuff "Decrease attack".
Unleashes a Skill Breakable attack that drops meteorites over a wide area.
The Skill Break gauge of one Skill Breakable attack can be reduced by Sword Skills that have both the Blunt and Wind Element, and Blunt Element Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge of the other.
It gains the following buffs while preparing a Skill Breakable attack.
‧Reduces damage taken from player (stackable).
‧Increases its attack (stackable).
‧Increases its defense (stackable).
‧Increases its critical resistance (stackable).
If you are hit by a Skill Breakable attack, buff effects on the player will be removed.
When you perform a Break, the boss will be temporarily incapacitated and all of its buffs will be removed.
Additionally, it will receive a stack debuff that boosts further damage taken from the player and the increase in damage taken while incapacitated will be significant.
Act fast to Break it.
Weakness

Resistance
Damage
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 23 Dungeon Period: Starts after the May 11, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 25, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
"Guild of Guilds" Season 23 Dungeon Period: Starts after the May 18, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 25, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
"Petrify" inflicts a nasty status ailment that makes it impossible to use actions or items, and doubles the amount of damage received.
"Petrify" is undone after a set amount of time has passed, or when damage is taken.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 23 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on May 25 (Wed).
The "Guild Arm Band (Yellow)" and "Snake's Shield (Yellow)" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on May 31 (Tue).
"GoG Season 23 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 23 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The 19th "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and the 19th "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on May 25, 2022 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Medusa Shield (Green)", "Snake Queen's Hair (Brown)", "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Brown)", "Guild Arm Band (Brown)", and "Snake's Shield (Brown)".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 23 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 23 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 23 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, other Guild of Guilds dungeon difficulties cannot be attempted.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 23 banner.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

This is a vicious monster with high HP, attack, and defense.
It has a Break Gauge. Deal enough damage to temporarily immobilize it.

There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.

In "Guild of Guilds" Season 23, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
