"Guild of Guilds" Season 23 is expected to begin on May 18, 2022 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
New "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event
Introducing the new and improved Guild of Guilds Ranking Event,
"Guild of Guilds" Season 22
.
■Champion's Room
Along with the changes to the reward system, we've implemented a special guild room, the Champion's Room, which will only be available to the guild with the highest ranking!
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
"Guild of Guilds" Season 22
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 22, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 22 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 22 banner.
Event Period: Starts after the April 13, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 20, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 22 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

Recovers HP once every 3 seconds for 10 minutes from the start of battle.

It gains a buff that reduces the damage it takes from players and a buff that gives it critical resistance.

It unleashes attacks that allow for wide range Skill Breaks.

2) Only Dagger Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 22 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.

The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.

Reward
Production materials which may drop from the boss can be used to produce
Chaos Boss avatars
.
You can also receive production materials from rewards.
How to Participate
Accept the Chaos Boss Dungeon from the NPCs "Chaos Boss Dungeon Interior" and "Chaos Boss Dungeon Depth" in the Blackiron Palace.
Each "Chaos Boss Dungeon" difficulty can be accepted from a different NPC.
Recommended Total Power
Each dungeon has a different Recommended Total Power for challenging the boss. This is set at 60000×6 or more for Interior and 80000×6 or more for Depth.
Total Power is a number that gives an approximation of the player's overall strength.
It changes based on factors like equipment, Skill Records, and weapon proficiency level.
Check it by going to Menu > Status > Player.
When your Total Power is near the recommended amount, challenge the boss with a party!
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Event Period
Starts after the April 13, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 20, 2022 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

All-Out Battle [Starry Kobold Lord] On Now!
All Out Battle is a large-scale raid in which all players work together to defeat a raid boss with massive HP.
By successfully defeating the raid boss, "Illfang the Kobold Lord", you can get Rank Rewards based on Total Damage Points.
Rewards
There are five types of rewards in the All-Out Battle [Starry Kobold Lord].
①Rank Rewards
Each player's Damage Points are calculated on the result screen by taking the amount of HP the boss loses from the start until the battle is cleared and dividing it by the number of players remaining in the dungeon at clear time.
Each player's "Damage Rank" will be calculated based on the Total Damage Points at the moment of defeat, accumulated from chiseling away at the raid boss's total HP. You can get Rank Rewards depending on your "Damage Rank".

compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.

get an even higher score
.

Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.

The permanent LafCof Phantoms & the Ring Gem Temple was added as of the July 21, 2022 (Thu) maintenance.
LafCof Phantoms & the Ring Gem Temple
The dungeon known as the Ring Gem Temple is said to offer valuable materials.
At the same time, however, there are rumors that LafCof frequents the area.
Take on the Ring Gem Temple!
Ring Gem Temple
The Ring Gem Temple is a solo dungeon that can be attempted over and over again.
The battle progresses in waves. It ends when you are no longer able to fight, or when the time limit runs out.
The enemies will become stronger with each wave.
All enemies are weak to Thrust and resistant to Slash and Blunt.
Since a large number of enemies appear in each wave, a 2H Spear with Thrust, which can deal multiple attacks, is recommended.
Revive Crystals and items that restore HP cannot be used in the dungeon.
Items that cannot be used can be found in "Challenge by yourself" on the Dungeon List.
Reward
The Ring Gemstone is the main reward in the LafCof Phantoms & the Ring Gem Temple.
The Ring Gemstone material is required to produce rings.
It can be obtained from dungeon clears or from drops.
In addition, the following types of rewards are available for the LafCof Phantoms & the Ring Gem Temple.
Battle Reward
Rewards are earned according to the number of waves cleared.
The more waves you clear, the more rewards you receive.
The rewards can be earned as many times as you clear the dungeon.
Challenge Rewards
Earn rewards when a specific wave is cleared for the first time.
Rewards for Total WAVEs Cleared
Rewards are earned according to the total number of waves cleared.
Achievement Rewards
Receive a record from achievements based on the total number of Ring Gemstones obtained.
How to Participate
Take on the challenge by talking to the "50F Algade" "Ring Gem Temple Guide".
Participation Requirements
Clear the 50F Main Quest through the end

news_list.full_details:
Notices
New Equipment Added: Ring!
UPDATE
2022-07-21 21:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
You and Koharu can wear the new equipment, Ring!
Ring
A Ring is a new piece of equipment that is different from armor.
This item can be produced, and it provides a Main Effect that increases natural Element damage, as well as up to two types of Random Bonuses, such as increased attack.
By equipping a Ring, you will also be able to equip another Ability Skill Record as an EX Ability.
Effect Examples
Item Name
Main Effect
Random Bonus
Item Icon
Fire Ring I
Fire element damage +1.5%.
Attack +1.5%.
Damage done to enemies weak to slashing +1.5%.
Water Ring I
Water element damage +1.5%.
Critical rate +3%.
Damage done to enemies weak to thrusting +1.5%.
Wind Ring I
Wind element damage +1.5%.
Poison resistance +3%.
Damage done to enemies weak to blunt +1.5%.
You can equip a Ring or an EX Ability via Menu in the upper left corner of the screen > Status > Player Equipment > Ring.
Ring Production
It can be produced using materials such as the Ring Gemstone obtained in "LafCof Phantoms & the Ring Gem Temple", and "Coarse Stones" dropped on each floor.
You can use a Ring as a material to produce a higher-rarity Ring.
From the Menu in the upper left corner of the screen, select Items > Enhance/Trade > Production.
Alternatively, you can talk to the Workshop NPC and select Production > Ring to produce a Ring.
To view a produced Ring, go to Menu in the upper left corner of the screen > Items > Ring.
See here for more details on the "LafCof Phantoms & the Ring Gem Temple"
EX Ability
To unlock the EX Ability equipment slot, equip a Ring.
Ability Skill Records can be equipped at no cost but will receive no stat increase. Only some skill effects are enabled.
Skill effects that are enabled as EX Ability are indicated with a green ● mark at the beginning of the skill's name.
Equipment Set Registration
Ring and EX Ability can be registered as equipment sets, just like other armor.
When you unlock Ring items, a "Ring / EX Ability" toggle button will appear on the armor equipment set screen.
Important
The effects shown on the banner are only examples.
Unlock Ring by completing the main quest on 50F of Aincrad.
Functions related to Ring will not be available until Ring have been unlocked.
You can equip Ring from Lv. 95 and up.
Unlike other production items, a "Ring" and "Ring Gemstone+" production recipe will only display when all the necessary materials have been collected.
The effects and values of the Random Bonuses and the increased natural Element damage of the Main Effect are selected at random.
Like armor, a Ring will also receive the Production's Additional Bonus Up effect.
A Ring cannot be equipped to an Assisting Character.
If the equipped Ability and EX Ability have the same skill name, only one will activate.
An Awakening Skill Record can be equipped as an EX Ability, but its Awakening Level and Awakening Skill will not be available.
A Skill Record equipped as an EX Ability will not count toward another equipped Skill Record's character-specific effect.
Example: When a Skill Record with the effect "[Black Legendary Sword 4] When equipping 2 or more of Kirito's Skill Records in the same set, Attack +" is equipped as an Ability, Kirito Skill Records equipped as an EX Ability will not count toward the number of Skill Records required for the effect.
Removing a Ring will nullify the effects of the equipped EX Ability.

Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
Weakness
Slash Element
Water Element
Buffs used
Stack Buff "Reduce Damage" and "Increase Attack"
Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Bloodshed" and "Curse"
Debuff "Decrease defense" and "Seal item"
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 25 Dungeon Period: Starts after the July 6, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 21, 2022 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Guild of Guilds Season 25 Dungeon Period: Starts after the July 13, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 21, 2022 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
* The winning guild of the 24th "Guild of Guilds" can challenge the dungeon from the Champion's Room NPC.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 25 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on July 21 (Thu).
The "Wander Gear I" and "Wander Cape I" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on July 27 (Wed).
"GoG Season 25 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 25 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The 21st "Guild of Guilds" Production Avatars and the 21st "Guild of Guilds" Ranking Event reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on July 21, 2022 (Thu).
Affected Items: "Wander Shield E", "Wander Mask E", "Wander Brooch E", "Wander Gear H", and "Wander Cape H".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 25 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 25 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 25 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, other Guild of Guilds dungeon difficulties cannot be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 24 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 24 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from June 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on July 21 (Thu) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

"Daily Dungeon +1" is here! For a limited time, you can clear the dungeon twice!
EVENT
2022-10-05 15:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Daily Dungeons that can usually only be cleared once per day can be cleared twice per day for the duration of the event!
"Daily Dungeons" are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of "Daily Dungeons" to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP and equipment enhancement items.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets at 4:00 AM (JST/UTC+9).

Blackiron Palace
Daily Dungeon
Period
Starts after the October 5, 2022 (Wed) 14:00 - October 14, 2022 (Fri) 3:59 (JST/UTC+9)

There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.

1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.

If you were logged in from before September 22 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 28, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The appearing boss "Terror Gaze" will be weak to the natural element "Dark" "Fire" and the weapon element "Thrust".
"Guild of Guilds" Season 28 is expected to begin on October 19, 2022 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 27
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 27, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 27 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 27 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from September 22 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on October 26 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Details
It has critical resistance.
It continually reduces damage taken from the player.

①Slash element skills

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 27 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.

EVENT

The Scenario Event "Search for the Phantom Mushroom ['20 Returning]" is back!
Search for the Phantom Mushroom ['20 Returning]
Looking to raise his level, Kirito ventured into a forest area. There, he discovered a strange mushroom sprouting from a cliff.
According to Argo, these mushrooms only grow on cliffs and precipices, have a mellow aroma, and possess an unbeatable flavor. They were the mushrooms on everyone's mind.
Kirito decided to discuss with Asuna how they might be able to harvest these mushrooms to eat later.

Sword Art Online Integral Factor's Worldwide 4.5 Year Anniversary!
Sweep Battle: Raging Heard of Boars is here!
Sweep Battle
The Sweep Battle is a solo dungeon that can be attempted over and over again.
The battle progresses in waves. It ends when you are no longer able to fight, or when the time limit runs out.
The enemies will become stronger with each wave.
All enemies are weak to Thrust and resistant to Slash and Blunt.
Since a large number of enemies appear in each wave, a 2H Spear with Thrust, which can deal multiple attacks, is recommended.
Revive Crystals and items that restore HP cannot be used in the dungeon.
Items that cannot be used can be found in "Challenge by yourself" on the Dungeon List.
Reward
The following types of rewards are available in the Sweep Battle.
Battle Reward
Rewards are earned according to the number of waves cleared.
The more waves you clear, the more rewards you receive.
The rewards can be earned as many times as you clear the dungeon.
Challenge Rewards
Earn rewards when a specific wave is cleared for the first time.
Rewards for Total WAVEs Cleared
Rewards are earned according to the total number of waves cleared.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Notice about 91F installation, unlocking super rare Yasha Integral Series weapon transformation, and other updates
UPDATE
2022-08-31 17:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The destroyers of the world...are the Assault Team.
"My dream has come true."
Having taken on a series of floors since Heathcliff's departure, Asuna was finally made the group's official commander.
Leafa was then promoted to captain of the A Team to fill the gap in personnel, causing Kirito to realize his role had come to an end.
You are reunited with Kirito, who has returned to easygoing solo play, in a town on the front line that is a little separated from the 91F main settlement--《Dseal》.
After something unusual, you and Koharu find yourselves in the town where the legend of an evil dragon slain remains. Kirito has set up base in the house of a young aristocratic girl, 《Ado》, and is searching for the boss quest but...
Meanwhile, Asuna has been extremely busy, and Kirito sensed the distance between them growing by the day, but felt there was nothing he could do about it.
During this time, it was also discovered that Dseal, the current base, had a large number of rare items and related quests.
In order to quickly increase the strength of the Assault Team, a plan was hatched to invite crafters who would typically never leave the safe zone.
Asuna then launched an operation to escort an unprecedented number of people to Dseal, the town outside the safe zone.
Things were going well, but as the plan approached its final stages, the malice that had been targeting the Assault Team made another move.
This fact gradually revealed itself through Ado.
With the Assault Team in this dire predicament, you risk everything on a secret plan with a faint hope of turning the tide.
"The destroyers of the world...are the Assault Team." What is the truth behind this revelation?
At the end of this story waits a day that Kirito and Asuna will never forget.

Added a new quest alongside the release of the 91F.

The super rare Yasha Integral Series weapon transformation has been unlocked.

Details
The battle takes place on a "Field with unusable items", where certain items cannot be used.
There are skill breakable attacks, and you can break it with Blunt Element skills.
With a Break, a stack debuff to boost damage is granted to the boss.
As you take attacks from this boss, all enemies in the field will receive a stack buff that increases their defense.
In the Character Quest and Labyrinth, it has critical resistance and high defense.
Also, at the beginning of battle, it grants a "Critical resistance" buff.
It uses the "Seal item" debuff.

Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Boss Monster
The Skull Reaper
Details
The head, torso, and tail are all attackable, and a color cursor will be dislayed at the attackable areas.
Damage dealt to any part of its body is reduced, especially to the torso.
For the full-out attack, if you are within range, damage will be dealt to each area indicated by a color cursor.
There are 3 types of attacks that can reduce the Skill Break Gauge: Slash Element, Thrust Element, and Blunt Element.
Slash Element attacks that can reduce the Skill Break Gauge will have an attack range that extends across the entire field.
Additionally, you can only reduce the Skill Break gauge with attacks to the head.
You can deal more damage to the Skull Reaper during the Break, but the duration of the Break is short.
For the "Beginner" difficulty and scenario quest, you can reduce the Skill Break gauge with all Slash Element attacks.
For the Skill Breakable full-field attack it uses on the Advanced, Premium, Maniac, and Expert difficulties, it removes buffs that have been granted to the player.
Weakness
Slash Element
Fire Element
Buffs used
Stack Buff "Increase Attack" and "Increase Decrease"
* This cannot be used on the "Beginner" difficulty or scenario quests.
Status Ailments used
Status ailments "Burn" and "Debility"
* This cannot be used on the "Beginner" difficulty or scenario quests.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.

If you acquire a ★4[Raging Silver Wolf] Kirito after the Skill Record has reached its Limit Break max, it will be exchanged for Record Kit M.
Up to 6 players can join the dungeon at one time.
The dungeon will be cleared when time is up, but you will no be able to get drop items from the boss.
If you go to the title screen or are disconnected and do not return to the dungeon, you will not be counted as a remaining player, and you will not receive any Damage Points.
If all party members escape through the Exit, no Damage Points will be counted from the time of entry until the time of escape.
Damage Points can be received when the result screen is displayed.
After you clear a "Premium" difficulty dungeon once, you can't play it again until the limit resets at 4:00 (JST/UTC+9).

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before August 23 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 27, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Medusa", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Earth".
"Guild of Guilds" Season 27 is expected to begin on September 14, 2022 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 26
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 26, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 26 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 26 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from August 23 (Tue) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on September 21 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust element skills
②2H Spear skills
③Skills that are Thrust Element and Wind Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 26 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.

Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 26 Dungeon.

②2H Spear skills
③Skills that are Thrust Element and Wind Element

Guild of Guilds Season 26 Dungeon Period: Starts after the August 17, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 22, 2022 (Mon) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]

The Devil Mask H and Devil Tail H Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on August 31 (Wed).
"GoG Season 26 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 26 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.

It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 26 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, other Guild of Guilds dungeon difficulties cannot be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Notices
【Holiday Campaign】Unleash powerful Sword Skills one after the other! The "Accele Skill" has arrived!
UPDATE
2022-11-30 16:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Holiday Campaign!
We have implemented the new
《Accele Skill》
function, which accelerates the activation of Sword Skills.
What is an Accele Skill?
An "Accele Skill" is a new skill that allows you to unleash powerful skills one after the other in rapid succession.
The feature will accelerate the battle scene for players and allow you to enjoy an exhilarating new style of IF combat.
By fulfilling conditions and activating the Accele Skill, Sword Skills you have equipped will receive the following effects for a certain amount of time: 0 SP cost, reduced skill cool time, and boosted damage multiplier.
This allows you to use Sword Skills continuously with increased power.
Only "Accele Skills" or "Maximum Breakthrough Skills" can be used.
Activating an Accele Skill
When you set an Accele Skill type of Sword Skill to the 1st frame of the skill slot, the Rush Gauge will change to an Accele Skill Gauge.
The Accele Skill Gauge will build up automatically and fully recover when you return to a safe area, such as a town.
When all Accele Skill Gauges are filled, and the Switch Gauge is at 2 levels or higher, you can activate the Accele Skill by tapping the Switch Gauge.
The effect time of Accele Skills is 30 sec.
By equipping the Accele Skill ability, the effect time can be extended by 2.5 sec.
Additionally, the effect time extends by 0.5 sec depending on the number of Limit Breaks.
An Accele Skill can be equipped to Koharu and Assisting Characters, but it will not be activated.
Damage mulitiplier
While activated, Sword Skills that fulfill the Accele Skill and Maximum Breakthrough requirements will receive +10% of the 1st frame Accele Skill's damage multiplier.
Maximum Breakthroughs and MOD Skills with a Skill Record attached to the MOD will receive +20% of the 1st frame Accele Skill's damage multiplier.
MOD Skills with a Skill Record attached to the MOD Slot will stop the effect time once fired.
Skill's cool timese reduced
While activated, the skill cool time of Accele Skills and Maximum Breakthrough Skills will all be reduced to 3 sec.
Visual effect of skill slots when activated
When an Accele Skill is activated, the area around the Accele Skill and Maximum Breakthrough Skill slots will glow.
Maximum Breakthrough and MOD Skills with a Skill Record attached to the MOD Slot will glow inside the skill slot as well as around the skill slot.

Conditions where Accele Skill effects will end
The effect time will end after a certain amount of time has passed.
The effect time will end when you are in a near-death state.
The effect time will end when you open the menu.
The effect time will end when you use Quick Change.
The effect time will end when you fire a MOD Skill with a Skill Record in a MOD Slot while the Accele Skill is activated.
About changes to the Switch Gauge
Along with the implementation of "Accele Skills", the Switch Gauge has been changed so that it building up to the 2nd level by default.
Damage when using Switch will be boosted by 15% when using Switch with the Switch Gauge built up to the 2nd level.
The Proficiency Skill "Overcharge I" has been modified so that the Switch Gauge can build up to the 3rd level when you learn it.
Damage when using Switch will be boosted by 200% when using Switch with the Switch Gauge built up to the 3rd level.
Important
The Accele Skill Gauge will automatically recover even if you are logged out of the game.
There is no extended time from the Accele Skill ability when it is set on an EX Ability.
Even if you meet the conditions to activate it, if you tap the skill slot instead of the Switch Gauge, the skill will only activate as normal.
Burst Skill Records can activate Burst.
Accele Skills and Maximum Breakthrough Skills that are connected to a Connect Skill's Connector will have a "damage modifier+" effect while activated.
When an Accele Skill is equipped to the first frame, the Rush Gauge will change to the Accele Skill Gauge, so Awakening cannot be activated.

Game Balance Adjustments

（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to Sword Art Online Integral Factor.
Game balance was adjusted at maintenance on November 30, 2022 (Wed).
Adjustments Details
EXP gained from rewards when clearing the Main Quest have been adjusted upward.
EXP rewards from Subquests (Multiple Rounds) have been adjusted upward.
Drop rates of production materials for the "Integral Series," "Nox Integral Series," and "Lux Integral Series" have been adjusted upward.

For players who have already cleared the Main Quest, based on the clear status of the main quest at the time of maintenance on November 30, 2022

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before November 25 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 30, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Masquerade Demon", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Wind".
"Guild of Guilds" Season 30 is expected to begin on December 21, 2022 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 29
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 29, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 29 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 29 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 29 Dungeon.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
100F Installed & Yasha Integral Series 3rd Level Transformation Unlocked!
UPDATE
2022-11-06 13:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The World of Swords Story: The Final Act
"We'll now begin the final strategy meeting."
After a long and arduous journey, the Assault Team finally reached the 100th Floor.
They cleared the boss quests scattered all over Aincrad. The tactics for the last boss that the Assault Team seized were remarkable.
Asuna drew a single decision from this.
All the remaining players are called together, and the forces of fighters and crafters mobilize.
They all charge forth to the first and final all-out battle.
What will you and Koharu see at the end as you face the final battle on the front lines?
Major Updates
Added a new quest alongside the release of the 100F.
Added Large-Scale Raid All Out Battle [Aincrad]!
The super rare Yasha Integral Series 3rd level weapon transformation has been unlocked.
Added 100F boss avatars.

Release the character quest "Mad World Overture 1" by completing the main quest on 100F.
"Mad World Overture 2 [Summit Lord Fight]" will unlock after you complete "Mad World Overture 1"
Although there are no item drops in "Mad World Overture 2 [Summit Lord Fight]," multiple rounds of the same quest will provide a very large amount of experience.
Large-Scale Raid All-Out Battles
Challenge the All Out Battle [Aincrad] boss, An Incarnate of the Radius, on 100F!
All Out Battle is a large-scale raid in which all players work together to defeat a raid boss with massive HP.
By successfully defeating the raid boss, "An Incarnate of the Radius", you can get Rank Rewards based on Total Damage Points.
Plus, the Summit Lord Armament Stone item which has an
extremely rare chance
to drop in the All Out Battle [Aincrad], is a material required for transformation of the Yasha Integral Series.
Details about the All Out Battle [Aincrad] are available here
* Image is for visualization purposes only.
The super rare Yasha Integral Series 3rd level weapon transformation has been unlocked!
Transform the Yasha Integral Series using Summit Lord Armament Stones you collect!
Transform to raise weapon stats and add special effects.
How to Transform to the 3rd Level
STEP1
Get the Yasha Integral Series to ★4 (2nd Level Transformation)!
Transform "Yasha Integral Series" to ★4 here.
STEP2
Produce the transformation material "Stone+++" necessary for the ★5 Yasha Integral Series!
To produce Stone+++, you will need the extremely rare Core Metal+++ and Stone+ materials that drop from the All Out Battle "The Skull Reaper" or All Out Battle [Aincrad].
* Each "Stone+++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: For 1H Swords or Daggers, you will need to produce Slicing Stone+++ using Core Metal+++ and Slicing Stone+.
STEP3
Use the Stone+++ you produced and Summit Lord Armament Stone to transform the Yasha Integral Series to ★5!
Producing Yasha Integral Series Equipment
The Summit Lord Blood and Summit Lord Armament Stone that drops from All Out Battle [Aincrad] can be used to produce the Yasha Integral Series.
* The base statuses will not be different to Yasha Integral Series equipment that can be produced on 85F and 91F.
* Production recipes that use "Summit Lord Armament Stone" and "Summit Lord Blood" will be available when you complete the 99F Main Quest.
The drop rate for Yasha Integral Series production materials is highest in 85F and 91F Labyrinth - Interior.
Details about the "Yasha Integral Series" are available here

You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Defense Battle" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
[1/26 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 31!
EVENT
2023-01-26 14:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
[1/26 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]
Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.
For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
Pick up period
Until maintenance begins on May 10, 2023 (Wed)
* The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before January 26 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 32, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The appearing boss "Terror Gaze", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Blunt" and a natural elemental weakness to "Fire" "Earth".
"Guild of Guilds" Season 32 is expected to begin on February 15, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 31
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 31, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 31 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 31 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from January 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on February 22, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Limited-edition special avatars for Guild of Guilds are here!
Get the "Medusa Shield (Pink)" shield avatar and the "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Pink)" accessory avatar marked with your guild's icon, as well as the "Snake Queen's Hair (Pink)" accessory avatar with hair that sways back and forth when you move.

Boss Monster

Details
Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust element skills
②Skills that are Thrust Element and Holy Element
When Medusa is preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gets four stack buffs.
The time it is immobilized for after a Skill Break is long and the damage it takes is greater than normal.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

Debuff "Decrease defense" and "Seal item"
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Status ailment "Petrify": Lose the ability to use actions or items, and take double the damage.
This will be removed after a certain amount of time or by taking damage.
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 31 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 31 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 31 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.

There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 31 dungeon.

Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust element skills

You can take on "Fatal Battle Super (Group OK)" with a group of up to 18 members.

To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Super (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
You will automatically move to the standby map.
You can display the standby member list from the action button on the bottom right of the screen.
When groups are formed, players who are not already in a party will be put into a party together and sent to the dungeon automatically.
If you would like to join a random group, we recommend using "Quick Group" to automatically join a group you can participate in.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before December 28 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 31, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Medusa", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Thrust" and a natural elemental weakness to "Holy".
"Guild of Guilds" Season 31 is expected to begin on January 18, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 30
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 30, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 30 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 30 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from December 28 (Wed) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on January 25, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash element skills
②Dagger skills
③Skills that are Slash Element and Wind Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)

Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.

Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 30 Dungeon.

30th "Guild of Guilds"
Defeat the boss in the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 30 dungeon to earn tickets from the challenge rewards and gain entry to the "Guild of Guilds" Season 30 Ranking Event dungeon.

"Devil Tail I"
, modeled after the Masquerade Demon boss, using special production materials you get as drops from "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeons.

Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash element skills
②Dagger skills
③Skills that are Slash Element and Wind Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.

Debuff "Weaken normal attack"
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 30 Dungeon Period: Starts after the December 14, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 27, 2022 (Tue) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Guild of Guilds Season 30 Dungeon Period: Starts after the December 21, 2022 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 27, 2022 (Tue) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Demon Tail" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 30 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on December 27 (Tue).
The "Devil Mask I" and "Devil Tail I" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on January 11, 2023 (Wed).
"GoG Season 30 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 30 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.

The EXP rewards for Main Quests 8F and up have been increased.

Notices
The "Underground Labyrinth" is here! Get Skill Releasers to increase the damage of sword skills!
UPDATE
2023-03-22 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A new challenge for those who have cleared the 100th floor.
The permanent area
"Underground Labyrinth"
was released after the March 22, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
"Underground Labyrinth"
Fight enemies on the same field with players other than party and guild members.
Skill Releasers, which increase sword skill damage, can be obtained from monster drops and treasure chests.
Monsters in the "Underground Labyrinth" attack when players approach them.
All players can attack active monsters. By attacking and dealing damage, players may be randomly selected to receive item drops, even if they are not in a party.
If monsters are not defeated, they disappear after a certain period of time.
If damage is dealt to a monster, the time until it disappears is reset.
The "Underground Labyrinth" is a "field with unusable items" where certain items cannot be used and revives are not allowed.
Future updates are planned to increase the number of Skill Releaser types and the fields that can be attempted.
Rewards
Monsters in the "Underground Labyrinth" have a chance of dropping one of the Skill Releasers.
Any player who manages to inflict damage is eligible to obtain random drop items.
You can also obtain one of the Skill Releasers when you open the treasure chests in the "Underground Labyrinth".
Treasure chests may be rigged with traps.
"Skill Releaser" Details Here
How to Participate
Talk to the "Underground labyrinth Guide" NPC at the "Blackiron Palace" to challenge it.
Participation Requirements
Clear the 100F Main Quest through the end
Boss Monster

Details

When its HP falls beneath a certain amount, it will use the Chaos Recollection buff.
By defeating monsters, many Skill Releasers will be dropped at a fixed rate.
Enemies appearing in the "Underground Labyrinth" all have resistances to the same weapon elements and natural elements.

In "Guild of Guilds" Season 34, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Masquerade Demon", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Blunt" and a natural elemental weakness to "Water".

-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 33
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 33, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 33 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 33 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from March 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on Apri 26, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).

Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
33rd "Guild of Guilds"
Defeat the boss in the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 33 dungeon to earn tickets from the challenge rewards and gain entry to the "Guild of Guilds" Season 33 Ranking Event dungeon.

Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.

Resistance
Critical

Status ailments "Debility", "Curse" and "Stun"
Debuff "Decrease defense" and "Seal item"
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 33 Dungeon Period: Starts after the March 8, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 22, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Guild of Guilds Season 33 Dungeon Period: Starts after the March 15, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 22, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 33 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on March 22 (Wed).
The "Wander Gear K" and "Wander Cape K" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on March 29 (Wed).
"GoG Season 33 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 33 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 29 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 29 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on March 22 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Wander Shield G", "Wander Mask G", "Wander Brooch G", "Wander Gear J", and "Wander Cape J".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 33 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 33 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 33 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Increased Boost Mode Multiplier Campaign

Campaign Details
Boost Mode is a monthly subscription.
During the campaign, you will receive the following Boost Effects at a higher rate than usual.
◆Boost Content
Boost 1: Get 8x EXP when hunting monsters.
Boost 2: Get 4x Weapon Proficiency when hunting monsters.
Boost 3: 2x item drop rate when hunting monsters.
* EXP gained during quests will not be boosted.
* If you use items with the same effect at the same time, the effect rates of the item and Boost Mode will be added together.
* For example, if the effect increase of an item is 2x (100% increase), then the increase will be 100% + 700% = 800% (9x increase).
Campaign Duration
Starts after the February 28, 2023 (Tue) maintenance and ends on March 29, 2023 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
Boost Effects will return to normal on March 29, 2023 (Wed) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
Important
Boost Mode is valid for a month starting from the purchased date and will be automatically renewed each month.
If cancelled during the validity period, you will continue receiving effect of the boosts until you log out after the expiration date.
You cannot make duplicate purchases during the validity period.
Please be aware that deleting the app does not cancel this subscription.
Cancellation
Cancellation may be completed through the following procedure.
1. Tap Settings > [your name] > iTunes & App Store.
2. Tap "Apple ID" at the top of the screen.
3. Tap "View Apple ID" then "Subscriptions".
4. Tap "Boost Mode" purchased on "SWORD ART ONLINE: Integral Factor" to see the purchase history.
5. Cancel subscription by tapping "Cancel Subscription".
Other Precautions
There is a possibility that connection problems may occur when purchasing, so please do not close the application while purchase is still processing.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before February 23 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 33, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Wander Fatal Scythe", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Holy".
"Guild of Guilds" Season 33 is expected to begin on March 15, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 32
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 32, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 32 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 32 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from February 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on March 22, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 32 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 32 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds

You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.

After handling the anomaly on the 56F, you and your team receive word of another on the 31F and head there in a hurry.
The Assault Team gets busy gathering information on how to defeat a new floor boss that won't go down easily...
The 31F had been cleared via the shortest route.
It was a mere transit point for many players, and even after it was cleared, Klein was the only one who continued to revisit it.
For some reason, he feels a strong connection to Mikiha, the NPC on this floor, and is committed to resolving the situation for her sake.
After much effort, your group will learn the secrets and history of this floor.
To protect what is important to him, Klein will stand by what's right and fight on the side of love to reach his full potential as a man!

When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.

"Guild of Guilds" Season 36 is expected to begin on June 14, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 35
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 35, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from May 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on June 21, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.

The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
