Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy ...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 35th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2023-05-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Guild of Guilds Preseason 35 starts today!
Take on the "Medusa" during the event!
Starting after the May 17, 2023 (Wed) maintenance, Guild of Guilds Season 35 will be held,
where guilds compete for rankings based on the highest score earned
!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
35th "Guild of Guilds"
Defeat the boss in the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 35 dungeon to earn tickets from the challenge rewards and gain entry to the "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 Ranking Event dungeon.
To enter the "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 dungeon on Depth and Extreme difficulties, you will need
5
tickets.
Rewards
Try making the accessory avatar
"Guild Arm Band (Red Black)"
, which comes with a guild icon, and the shield avatar
"Snake's Shield (Red Black)"
using special production materials obtained from the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon.
GoG Season 35 Tickets, production materials, Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and Release Crystals are available as rewards in the dungeon.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Guild Arm Band (Red Black)
Accessory Avatar
Snake's Shield (Red Black)
Shield avatar
You'll earn a score by clearing the dungeon.
Scores earned in "Guild of Guilds" Preseason Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the
"Total Score Reward"
. You will earn rewards based on your score.
Dungeon
Score calculation
Max Score
Depth
Basic Clear Bonus:100P＋Survival Bonus:1P per surviving player
130
DANGER
Basic Clear Bonus:2000P＋Survival Bonus:5P per surviving player
2150
Special
Basic Clear Bonus:8000P＋Survival Bonus:10P per surviving player
8300
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash Element skills
②Skills that are Slash Element and Earth Element
When Medusa is preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gets four stack buffs.
The time it is immobilized for after a Skill Break is long and the damage it takes is greater than normal.
Weakness
Slash Element
Earth Element
Resistance
Critical
Damage
Buffs used
Stack Buff "Reduces damage", "Increase Attack", "Increase Defense" and "Critical resistance"
Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Petrify", "Fatal Poison" and "Debility"
Debuff "Decrease defense"
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Status ailment "Petrify": Lose the ability to use actions or items, and take double the damage.
This will be removed after a certain amount of time or by taking damage.
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 35 Dungeon Period: Starts after the May 10, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 24, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Guild of Guilds Season 35 Dungeon Period: Starts after the May 17, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 24, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 35 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on May 24 (Wed).
The Guild Arm Band (Red Black) and Snake's Shield (Red Black) Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on May 31 (Wed).
"GoG Season 35 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 35 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 31 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 31 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on May 24, 2023 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Medusa Shield (Pink)", "Snake Queen's Hair (Pink)", "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Pink)", "Guild Arm Band (Pink)", and "Snake's Shield (Pink)".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 35 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 35 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Details
This is a vicious monster with high HP, attack, and defense.
You can perform breaks.
When a break happens, it receives a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
Each crystal adds a powerful debuff to the player when it appears.
When each crystal is destroyed, it removes the debuff that was added when it appeared.
It uses many buffs, debuffs, and status ailments that drag players closer to their demise.

To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Super (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
You will automatically move to the standby map.
You can display the standby member list from the action button on the bottom right of the screen.
When groups are formed, players who are not already in a party will be put into a party together and sent to the dungeon automatically.
If you would like to join a random group, we recommend using "Quick Group" to automatically join a group you can participate in.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.

If you were logged in from before April 27 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 35, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Medusa", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Earth".
"Guild of Guilds" Season 35 is expected to begin on May 17, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 34
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 34, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 34 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 34 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from April 27 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on May 24, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Notice for maintenance(4/20)
MAINT.
2023-04-20 11:55:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to Sword Art Online Integral Factor.
We will be implementing maintenance to correspond to defects in effect within the scheduled dates down below.
-Scheduled maintenance dates
April 20, 2023 12:30 to 13:30 (JST/UTC+9)
* There may be changes with the date.
-Maintenance Contents
We will fix an issue in which customers who had equipped the "Mr. Kirito Doll" or "Miss Asuna Doll" accessory avatars along with an accessory avatar that equips to the back would be disconnected when opening the equipment screen, performing controls such as recalling an equipment set, and then closing the screen.
Due to this fix, customers logging in after maintenance, who were affected by the issue, will find that the "Mr. Kirito Doll" or "Miss Asuna Doll" has been unequipped, so you will need to re-equip it on your own.
* As of maintenance on 4/19/2023 (Wed), the equipment placement of the "Mr. Kirito Doll" or "Miss Asuna Doll" has been changed from "Face" to "Back", so please note that you will not be able to combine it with avatars that equip to the back.
Please note that the game can not be played during maintenance.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Blunt Element skills
②1H Club skills
③Skills that are Blunt Element and Water Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 34 Dungeon Period: Starts after the April 12, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 26, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Guild of Guilds Season 34 Dungeon Period: Starts after the April 19, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 26, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Demon Tail" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 34 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on April 26 (Wed).
The "Devil Mask J" and "Devil Tail J" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on May 10, 2023 (Wed).
"GoG Season 34 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 34 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 30 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 30 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on April 26, 2023 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Devil Shield G", "Devil Helm I", "Devil Cape I", "Devil Mask I", and "Devil Tail I".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 34 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 34 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 34 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.

If you were logged in from before July 27 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 38, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 37
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 37, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 37 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 37 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from July 27 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on August 23, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).

Underground Labyrinth B2 was released after the July 26, 2023 (Wed) maintenance.
With the release of this new floor, you can face powerful monsters, acquire new Skill Releasers, and produce Integral Series shields.
Underground Labyrinth B2 Floor Installed!
You must first complete the Underground Labyrinth main quest in order to take on this new floor.
This is an automatically accepted quest. The "Underground Labyrinth: B1 Trial" Underground Labyrinth main quest will be accepted upon completing 100F.
Completing "Underground Labyrinth: B1 Trial" will allow you to enter Underground Labyrinth B2.
You can go to Underground Labyrinth B2 from the Underground Labyrinth Guide NPC in the Blackiron Palace or from the "Underground Labyrinth Inspector B1" NPC in Underground Labyrinth B1.
New Underground Labyrinth Quests!
In addition to the automatically accepted Underground Labyrinth main quest mentioned above, repeatable Underground Labyrinth subquests have also been added.
These quests will allow you to acquire Skill Releasers and more by hunting monsters found on various floors.
Underground Labyrinth subquests can be accepted from "Underground Labyrinth Inspector" NPCs found on various floors.
Your progress on these quests can be checked by going to "Menu," then "Quest."
Introducing the New Integral Series Shield!
You can now produce the Integral Series shield "Fermat" using materials acquired in Underground Labyrinth B2.
It can be produced using 2 "Cockatrice Protection Stone" and 200 Distinctive Rock.
You can get "Cockatrice Protection Stone" in Underground Labyrinth B2 in the following ways.
・Get an extremely rare drop from the Bennu : Venom Cockatrice boss monster when dealing damage that's over 1% of the Max HP
・Get an rare drop from the Bennu : Venom Cockatrice boss monster when dealing damage that's over 0.1% of the Max HP, or produce from 200 "Cockatrice Protection Stone Piece" that you can get from treasure boxes as an rare drop.
*The drop rate or number of each item increases with the amount of damage dealt on the boss monster.
*Excluding reflected damage.
"Distinctive Rock" have a chance of dropping from monsters (excluding bosses) in Underground Labyrinth B2.

Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
37th "Guild of Guilds"
Defeat the boss in the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 37 dungeon to earn tickets from the challenge rewards and gain entry to the "Guild of Guilds" Season 37 Ranking Event dungeon.

and
"Wander Cape L"

. You will earn rewards based on your score.

Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.

Resistance
Critical

Stack buff "Reduces damage" and "Increase Attack"
Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Debility", "Curse" and "Stun"
Debuff "Decrease defense" and "Seal item"
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 37 Dungeon Period: Starts after the July 12, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 26, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Guild of Guilds Season 37 Dungeon Period: Starts after the July 19, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 26, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete 1F (Main Quest "Labyrinth Strategy")
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 37 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on July 26 (Wed).
The "Wander Gear L" and "Wander Cape L" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on August 2 (Wed).
"GoG Season 37 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 37 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 33 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 33 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on July 26 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Wander Shield H", "Wander Mask H", "Wander Brooch H", "Wander Gear K", and "Wander Cape K".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 37 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 37 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 37 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Get 1,000 Arcana Gems at S Rank, 1,500 at SS Rank, and 2,500 at SSS Rank from the achievements!
If you reach SSS Rank, you can get a total of 5,000 Arcana Gems!
Guild Battle Challenge
In this guild event, you can set Challenge Rule restrictions and take on difficult raid boss dungeons.
Adding more restrictions and selecting higher levels will increase the dungeon's difficulty and quality of rewards.
There are up to 3 levels for each Challenge Rule.

①Clear Rank reward
One point is added for each Challenge Rule level, and players are assigned a Clear Rank based on the point total for clearing the dungeon.
Lv. 3 will award 3 points.
There are 10 Clear Ranks from G to SSS, with rewards like Black Challenge Plates, White Challenge Plates, and GP according to rank.
* Black Challenge Plates and White Challenge Plates can be used at the Trader mentioned in another section.
Guilds and individual players will each have their own Clear Rank.
You can earn Clear Rank rewards for every attempt.
Additionally, the guild can earn GP from Clear Rank rewards based on the number of participants.
Only members who clear the dungeon can earn items and GP.
②Challenge Reward
You can earn items and GP as challenge rewards for each Challenge Rule level you set.
Items will be delivered to all guild members' present boxes.
The displayed GP amount will be rewarded to the guild regardless of the number of members.
Setting the level higher will let you earn more GP when you clear a dungeon.
Each challenge reward can only be earned once.

[6/22 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 36!
EVENT
2023-06-22 14:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
[6/22 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]
Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.
For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
Pick up period
Until maintenance begins on October 11, 2023 (Wed)
* The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before June 22 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 37, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Wander Fatal Scythe", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Dark".
The next "Guild of Guilds" is scheduled to begin on July 12, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 36
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 36, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from June 22 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on July 26, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Wind Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
On Extreme difficulty, the enemy uses a Chaos Recollection buff and a Seal Items debuff.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Status ailment "Petrify": Lose the ability to use actions or items, and take double the damage.
This will be removed after a certain amount of time or by taking damage.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild

Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
The "Terror Gaze" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the June 21 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive Ranking Rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Notices
The 36th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?

2023-06-07 17:00:00

The Guild of Guilds Preseason 36 starts today!
Take on the "Terror Gaze" during the event!
Starting after the June 14, 2023 (Wed) maintenance, Guild of Guilds Season 36 will be held,
where guilds compete for rankings based on the highest score earned
!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
36th "Guild of Guilds"
Defeat the boss in the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 36 dungeon to earn tickets from the challenge rewards and gain entry to the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 Ranking Event dungeon.
To enter the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 dungeon on Depth and Extreme difficulties, you will need
5

"Guild Shoulder Guard (Lemon)"
accessory avatar, that comes embellished with the guild icon, or the
"Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Lemon)"
accessory avatar based on Terror Gaze's eyeball, which shifts with any movement.
GoG Season 36 Tickets, production materials, Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and Release Crystals are available as rewards in the dungeon.

Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Wind Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.

* Status ailment "Petrify": Lose the ability to use actions or items, and take double the damage.
This will be removed after a certain amount of time or by taking damage.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 36 Dungeon Period: Starts after the June 7, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 21, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
"Guild of Guilds" Season 36 Dungeon Period: Starts after the June 14, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 21, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Evil Eye Skin" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The GoG Season 36 Tickets will be deleted during maintenance on June 21 (Wed).
The Guild Shoulder Gaurd (Lemon) and Terrifying Shoulder Gaurd (Lemon) Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on June 28 (Wed).
"GoG Season 36 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 36 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 32 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 32 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on June 21 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Gaze Shield (Brown)", "Terrifying Helm (Brown)", "Terrifying Shield (Brown)", "Terrifying Shoulder Guard (Brown)", and "Guild Shoulder Guard (Brown)".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 36 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 36 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 39
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 39, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 39 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 39 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from September 21 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on October 25, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 39
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 39, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 39 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 39 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from September 21 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on October 25, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.

Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 39 Dungeon.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
[SAOIF Game Strategy Meeting 2023] The All-Out Battle "Laughing Coffin" is here!
EVENT
2023-08-27 09:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Sword Art Online Game Series 10th Anniversary!
SAOIF Game Strategy Meeting 2023 on now!
Beat the LafCof members as quickly as you can!
The All-Out Battle "Laughing Coffin" is here!
An All-Out Battle is a large-scale raid where players work together to defeat a raid boss.
By successfully getting their Total HP down to 0, you can get rank rewards based on your total damage points.
Rewards
Get a variety of rank rewards, challenge rewards, and Total Score Rewards.
You can also get limited-edition avatars like Male Knight Armor and Female Knight Armor from this event!
Don't miss this opportunity!
Avatar Images
"Star Fragments" may drop on certain difficulty levels!
If you achieve an S rank or higher, you will also receive a record from the achievements.
About the Dungeon
There are three difficulties: Normal, Advanced, and Expert.
Numerous Laughing Coffin members appear in the dungeon.
No matter what difficulty you clear, the damage you deal will affect the Total HP.
* Damage to any member is eligible.
Select the difficulty that suits you best and clear it to efficiently inflict damage to the total HP.
How to Participate
Talk to Asuna in the Tolbana Amphitheater to take on the challenge.
Clear it as many times as necessary until the total HP reaches zero and they have been defeated.
* There is a limit to the amount of HP that can be diminished in a single battle.
The Laughing Coffin members will appear again after they've been defeated.
Event Period
August 27, 2023 (Sun) 17:00 - 20:00 (JST/UTC+9)
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [From Knowledge, Life]
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
Up to 6 players can join the dungeon at one time.
You can still complete a dungeon if you run out of time, but you will not acquire items dropped by the undefeated monsters.
If you go to the title screen or are disconnected and do not return to the dungeon, you will not be counted as a remaining player, and you will not receive any Damage Points.
If all party members escape through the Exit, no Damage Points will be counted from the time of entry until the time of escape.
Damage Points can be received when the result screen is displayed.
There are no First Attack or Last Attack bonus.
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Notices
[SAOIF Game Strategy Meeting 2023] Defend Kirito and Eugeo! The IF Festival is on now!
EVENT
2023-08-27 09:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Sword Art Online Game Series 10th Anniversary!
Here's the big closing event of the
SAOIF Game Strategy Meeting 2023
!
IF Festival on now!
Defend Kirito and Eugeo's concert events!
Defense Battle
In the IF Festival Defense Battle, you'll need to protect four Defense Target locations in each venue from an onslaught of monsters!
You will fail if all of the Defense Targets are destroyed.
You'll get a huge score boost if the Defense Targets are intact by the end of the final wave.
Protect all the Defense Targets and try for a high score to get the best possible rewards.
Don't miss out on Kirito and Eugeo's concert performance set to various BGMs!
Rewards
Get up to 1000
"Arcana Gems"
, up to 100
"Awakening Stars"
, up to 10
"Medals of Combat Arts"
, and up to 50
"Memoria Niter S"
from the event.
There's a chance that monsters will drop "Release Crystals (S)".
"Star Fragments" have a chance of dropping from Boss Monsters.
Reward Avatar
Item Name
Avatar Images
SAOIF Strategy Mtg T-Shirt G
About the Dungeon
You'll earn a certain score by clearing the dungeon.
Scores are all counted toward the
Total Score Reward
. Your rewards will be based on your score.
You can earn score rank rewards based on how high your score is when you clear the dungeon.
On Maniac difficulty, there will be Total Power restrictions for players participating in Quick Parties.
Quick Party participation requirement: Total Power 60,000 or higher
The No Battle difficulty is a special dungeon where no monsters appear, giving you plenty of time to safely enjoy the concert.
How to Participate
First, talk to Klein in the Tolbana Amphitheater to go to the Summer Night Stage Event Map.
Talk to the Event Staff NPC on the Summer Night Stage Event Map to take on the challenge.
Event Period
August 27, 2023 (Sun) 22:00 - 24:00 (JST/UTC+9)
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [From Knowledge, Life]
Spectating Mode
Talk to the "Event Staff" NPC. "Check the Spectator Dungeon list" will be at the top of the list.
Tap "Check the Spectator Dungeon list" to view a list of battles you can spectate.
Select a battle to spectate, then choose either Watch normally or Watch with VR.
* Up to 15 players can spectate a battle. Battles that have reached this limit will no longer be displayed on the list.
* Spectating players cannot attack monsters.
* Spectators will not be displayed on the screen of the player fighting the battle.
- Watch normally
"Spectators" will appear above the spectators' heads instead of their player names.
Use the Exit to stop spectating mid-battle.
- Watch with VR
Starts VR mode. This lets you spectate the battle in virtual reality using smartphone VR goggles.
Please make sure your smartphone is held horizontally with the bottom of the phone pointing to the right.
See the notice below for more details on using VR mode.
How to Use VR Mode
Tap the X button in the upper left corner to exit VR mode when spectating.
Enjoy an even more realistic concert using VR Mode!
* VR goggles with binocular lenses are required.
* Please exit VR mode at once if you begin to develop a headache, feel sick, or become tired.
Limited-Time Emotes
Use the limited-time "Cheer" emote to liven up the concert!
Cheer
* Emotes will not give you a buff or any other special effect.
* The limited-time Cheer emote will be removed August 30, 2023 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
When the dungeon is finished, you can skip the monster hunt log wait time by tapping the screen.
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before August 24 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 39, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Medusa", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Blunt" and a natural elemental weakness to "Fire".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on September 6, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 38
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 38, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 38 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 38 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from August 24 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on September 6, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 38 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.

（JST/GMT+9）
The Assault Team rushed to the new Runaway Floor, the 83rd Floor, but Notte was waiting for them as soon as they arrived.
In order to protect the Old Phone, Leafa dares to challenge Notte, the GM. She loses miserably, however, and is thrown into the sea.
The Moray Pirate Fleet, who rules those seas, manages to rescue her, but she is left devastated by the fact that she was not able to hold her own in a swordfight.
Meanwhile, information about the floor boss on the Runaway Floor is at an all-time low, leading people to wonder if the shelved boss really exists.
You and Koharu cooperate with the pirates as a way to repay them for rescuing Leafa and, along with Argo, deepen your friendship with the leader, Fuego.
During this time, Leafa stays with the Fleet's bodyguard to recuperate, and she gets to know him and his family. They have a surprising secret, however...

Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.
For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
--------------------------------
Fishing Ranking Event "2023 Midsummer Fishing Competition" is on now.
In the "2023 Midsummer Fishing Competition", you fight for the best rank based on your catch scores.
The Canned Seal, Tiga Ray, Glitch Fish, and Milky Way Tanglefish fish were selected from user submissions and appear on this Event Map!
Catch them to get a
high score
!
Event Period
Event Maps "Beach" and "On Board" Period: Starts after the August 9, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 30, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Ranking Period: Starts after the August 9, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 16, 2023 (Wed) 23:59 (JST/UTC+9).
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 2023 Midsummer Fishing Competition ranking banner.
Rewards
Place at the top of the rankings to get limited-edition Fishing Competition records, rare fishing bait, and
Memoria Niter L
, a Skill Record Limit Break material, as a present!
Exchange for up to 1,000
Arcana Gems
, up to 15
Medals of Combat Arts
, as well as other items such as
Core Metals
and Release Crystals at the 2023 Midsummer Fish Trader.
Each fish likes different bait.
Try different things and challenge the event.
2023 Midsummer Fish Trader Period
Starts after the August 9, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 6, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Record
You will also be able to receive a record via achievement rewards by finishing in the top ranking.
Record Acquisition
Achievement Rewards
MS Fishing King 2023
Revive Crystal×1
MS Fishing Elite 2023
Revive Crystal×1
MS Fishing Mania 2023
Revive Crystal×1
Event Locations
There are 8 locations in total, with day and night versions of the Event Maps "Beach" and "On Board", and day and night versions of Serene Shore and Peaceful Forest Path on 22F.
Head to the day beach by talking to the "Beach Guide" NPC at the Teleport Gate Plaza.
Move to the night beach by talking to the "Night Map Guide" NPC at the day beach.
Move on board the boat by talking to the "Boarding Guide" NPC at the beach.
Go to the "Serene Shore" or "Peaceful Forest Path" on the 22F by talking to "Nishida" in the "Teleport Gate Plaza".
Talk to the "Night Map Guide" NPC on the "Serene Shore" to go to the night map.

EVENT
2023-08-16 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 38
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 38, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 38 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 38 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from August 24 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on September 6, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 38 Dungeon.

If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
New for the Holiday Campaign! Focus your invulnerable firepower to beat down your enemies! Introducing Full Burst Skills!
UPDATE
2023-11-30 17:45:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Full Burst Skill
added!
What is a Full Burst Skill?
These are skills where you enter the Full Burst state for a period of time after unleashing an attack and become temporarily invulnerable, like a Burst Skill.
By entering the Full Burst state, you can immediately use a Full Burst Skill or a Burst Skill (Limit Break +10) regardless of activation requirements.
You can also use it an additional number of times by equipping Full Burst Skill Ability equipment pieces.
The following are Full Burst-Associated Skills that acquire additional effects and can be used while in the Full Burst state.
Full Burst-Associated Skills are Full Burst Skills and Limit Break +10 Burst Skills.
Activating a Full Burst Skill
Like Burst Skills, using Skill Records in a specific order will fulfill the Burst activation requirements.
You will enter the Full Burst state after the skill's Burst activates.
Fulfilling the activation requirements will cause the skill icon to glow magenta.
Using skills while in the Full Burst state
An equipped Full Burst-Associated Skill can be used once immediately regardless of activation requirements. (SP will not be consumed.)
Additional Full Burst-Associated Skills can then be used according to the number of Full Burst Ability pieces equipped.
The same Skill Record cannot be used more than once during these additional Full Burst Ability equipment usages.
After the Full Burst state ends, there will be 120 seconds of cooldown time until the Full Burst state can be activated again by fulfilling the activation requirements.
* Full Burst Skills can be used during this cooldown time, but the Full Burst state will not be entered.
You can check how much time is left in the Full Burst state and the cooldown period using the Time Limit Gauge at the bottom of the screen.
Limit Breaking Full Burst Skills
Limit Breaking a Full Burst Skill to +10 will remove the final activation requirement.
Example:
Regular Full Burst Skill: Fire → Fire → Slash → Wind
Limit Break +10 Full Burst Skill: Fire → Fire → Slash
Full Burst Ability
Full Burst Skill abilities are known as Full Burst Abilities.
By equipping these abilities to an ability slot, you can increase the number of Full Burst-Associated Skill usages while in the Full Burst state by one time per piece.
Effects while in the Full Burst state change depending on the Burst type.
* Stock: Using a Full Burst-Associated Skill resets the time remaining, and the Full Burst state time is extended with each additional piece of equipment.
* Chain: The damage multiplier of Full Burst-Associated Skills used while in the Full Burst state increases with each additional piece of equipment.
The maximum number of uses while in this additional Full Burst state is equal to the number of Sword Skill or Ability Full Burst / Limit Break +10 Burst Skill Records equipped within the same set, whichever is fewer.
Example:
4 Sword Skills equipped, 4 Abilities equipped: 4 activations possible
3 Sword Skills equipped, 4 Abilities equipped: 3 activations possible
3 Sword Skills equipped, 2 Abilities equipped: 2 activations possible
The Burst type and the number of additional usages while in the Full Burst state will be displayed on the Time Limit Gauge at the bottom of the screen.
Please note that equipping something to an EX Ability slot will not provide any effects relating to Full Burst.
How to get Full Burst Skills
"[Swinging Blade] Kirito" can be acquired in the following ways. Various Full Burst Skill Records can also be acquired from Orders.
* Completion Reward for the 51st Floor Main Quest
* Day 1 reward for the Holiday Campaign! Login Bonus (From December 1, 2023 4:00 to December 31, 2023 3:59 (JST/UTC+9))

Exiting the Full Burst state
The Full Burst state is primarily exited in the following ways.
* The remaining time in the Full Burst state runs out.
* All Full Burst-Associated Skill uses are exhausted.
* The area changes.
* A Quick Change is performed.
* The Menu Screen is displayed.
* Your character is defeated.
Important
If a Full Burst Skill is used during a Switch, it will have its regular skill effect.
Only regular Bursts will activate during the cooldown time following the end of the Full Burst state.
Skill Records aside from Full Burst-Associated Skills can still be used even when in the Full Burst state.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before November 22 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 42, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Masquerade Demon", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Blunt" and a natural elemental weakness to "Dark".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on December 6, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 41
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 41, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from November 22 (Wed) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Event Period: Starts after the November 15, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 21, 2023 (Tue) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
*Please note that along with the change in our maintenance schedule, the Champion's Room will be available for use until the end of "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 on 11/21 (Thur) at maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete 1F (Main Quest "Labyrinth Strategy")
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
How to Participate
Gather GoG Season 41 Tickets from the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon.
Tickets can be earned from challenge rewards when you defeat bosses.

Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 41!
EVENT
2023-11-15 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 41
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 41, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from November 22 (Wed) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.

There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.

There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.

In "Guild of Guilds" Season 41, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.

-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 40
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 40, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 40 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 40 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from October 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on November 22, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 40 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.

Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 40!
EVENT
2023-10-18 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 40
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 40, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 40 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 40 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from October 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the maintenance on November 22, 2023 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Terror Gaze
Details
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Thrust Element and Holy Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
On Extreme difficulty at the start of battle, the enemy gains a stack buff that reduces damage, and uses a Chaos Recollection buff and a Seal Items debuff.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
* Status ailment "Petrify": Lose the ability to use actions or items, and take double the damage.
This will be removed after a certain amount of time or by taking damage.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 40 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 40 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.

The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.

You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.

Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.

Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 43
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 43, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 43 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 43 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from January 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.

Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 43 Dungeon.

The extremely difficult dungeon "Fatal Battle" has appeared!
Let's make full use of our abilities and challenge it with all we've got!

There are two dungeons available: Fatal Battle Super and Fatal Battle Super (Group OK).
If you defeat the boss of "Fatal Battle Super", you will receive the "
