Talk to the "Fatal Battle" NPC at the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to challenge it.
Event Period
December 29, 2023 (Fri) 12:00 - Before the January 11, 2024 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Boss Monster
Fatal Chaos Drake
Details
This is a vicious monster with high HP, attack, and defense.
You can perform breaks.
It deals Skill Breakable attacks, and can Skill Break with Wind Element skills.
When a break or skill break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
In addition, it will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
Depending on the boss monster's status ailment  (Poison,Burn, Bleed, Frostbite) stacks, the damage it takes increases.
It uses many buffs, debuffs, and status ailments that drag players closer to their demise.
Determine the boss's state and the progress of the battle, and use your battle experience to defeat it.

Damage
* Break: Filling the entire Break Gauge will temporarily immobilize the boss and remove all of its buff effects.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
"Groups"
You can take on "Fatal Battle Super (Group OK)" with a group of up to 18 members.
How to Join Groups
To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Super (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
You will automatically move to the standby map.
You can display the standby member list from the action button on the bottom right of the screen.
When groups are formed, players who are not already in a party will be put into a party together and sent to the dungeon automatically.
If you would like to join a random group, we recommend using "Quick Group" to automatically join a group you can participate in.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
If you are in a party, only the party leader can create or join a Group.

You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before December 21 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 43, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Medusa", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Thrust" and a natural elemental weakness to "Water".

-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 42
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 42, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 42 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 42 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from December 21 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from December 21 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Winning.

2023-12-06 17:00:00

The Guild of Guilds Preseason 42 starts today!
Take on the "Masquerade Demon" during the event!
Starting after the December 13, 2023 (Wed) maintenance, Guild of Guilds Season 42 will be held,
where guilds compete for rankings based on the highest score earned
!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
42nd "Guild of Guilds"
Defeat the boss in the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 42 dungeon to earn tickets from the challenge rewards and gain entry to the "Guild of Guilds" Season 42 Ranking Event dungeon.
To enter the "Guild of Guilds" Season 42 dungeon on Depth and Extreme difficulties, you will need
5
tickets.

and
"Devil Tail L"
, modeled after the Masquerade Demon boss, using special production materials you get as drops from "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeons.

Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Blunt Element skills
②2H Axe skills
③Skills that are Blunt Element and Dark Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 42 Dungeon Period: Starts after the December 6, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 20, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Guild of Guilds Season 42 Dungeon Period: Starts after the December 13, 2023 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 20, 2023 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete 1F (Main Quest "Labyrinth Strategy")
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 42 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on December 20 (Wed).
The "Devil Mask L" and "Devil Tail L" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on December 27 (Wed).
"GoG Season 42 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 42 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 38 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 38 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on December 20 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Devil Shield I", "Devil Helm K", "Devil Cape K", "Devil Mask K", and "Devil Tail K".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 42 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 42 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 42 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Notices
Notice about Chapter 2 Aincrad 51F, super rare Machina Integral Series weapon, and other updates
UPDATE
2023-11-30 17:45:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Assault Team was at their wits' end in the face of the new Runaway Floor, the 51st.
The 51st floor is known for the Pit, a city of criminals that left traumatic scars on the Assault Team after their battles with wicked NPCs there in the past.
What's worse, orange players who avoided prosecution have now gathered in the Pit from across the floors and grown merciless.
However, in order to make it into the labyrinth, the Assault Team has no choice but to reconquer its streets that change so dizzyingly that some call them "auto-generated," and so they decide to take emergency measures.
Meanwhile, Vela's plans bring Leafa back together with Notte. While the interaction is awkward, they are able to connect once more.
Yet Vela's final moments continue to grow closer by the moment...
Major Updates
"Aincrad 51F" and a new quest has been implemented.

The player level cap has been raised (Lv.230).

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 45!
EVENT
2024-03-13 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 45
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 45, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from March 22 (Fri) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.

The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
The "Wander Fatal Scythe" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the March 21 (Thu) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 45th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-03-06 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Guild of Guilds Preseason 45 starts today!
Take on the "Wander Fatal Scythe" during the event!
Starting after the March 13, 2024 (Wed) maintenance, Guild of Guilds Season 45 will be held,
where guilds compete for rankings based on the highest score earned
!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
45th "Guild of Guilds"
Defeat the boss in the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 45 dungeon to earn tickets from the challenge rewards and gain entry to the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 Ranking Event dungeon.
To enter the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon on Depth and Extreme difficulties, you will need
5 tickets
.
Rewards
Try making the accessory avatars
"Wander Gear N"
and
"Wander Cape N"
, which come with a guild icon, using special production materials obtained from the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon.
GoG Season 45 Tickets, production materials, Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, and Release Crystals are available as rewards in the dungeon.

Item Name
Type

Accessory Avatar
You'll earn a score by clearing the dungeon.
Scores earned in "Guild of Guilds" Preseason Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the
"Total Score Reward"
. You will earn rewards based on your score.

Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Medal of Unity
Medals of Unity obtained from the Guild of Guilds or Guild Events can be used at the exclusive Trader.
You can trade for items like awakening materials and Avatars that were exclusive to past Guild of Guilds events.
Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Period
Guild of Guilds Preseason 45 Dungeon Period: Starts after the March 6, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 21, 2024 (Thu) maintenance.
Guild of Guilds Season 45 Dungeon Period: Starts after the March 13, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 21, 2024 (Thu) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete 1F (Main Quest "Labyrinth Strategy")
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
Important
For the boss's characteristics and weaknesses, please refer to the "Boss Monster" information in this announcement.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "GoG Season 45 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on March 21 (Thu).
The "Wander Gear N" and "Wander Cape N" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on March 27 (Wed).
"GoG Season 45 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 45 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 41 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 41 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader after maintenance on March 21 (Thu).
Affected Items: "Wander Shield J", "Wander Mask J", "Wander Brooch J", "Wander Gear M", and "Wander Cape M".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 45 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 reward Avatars will be added to the Medal of Unity Trader at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before February 22 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 45, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.

Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 44
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 44, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from February 22 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 44
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 44, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from February 22 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Details
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Wind Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

This will be removed after a certain amount of time or by taking damage.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild

The "Terror Gaze" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 44 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the February 21 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before January 25 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 44, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Terror Gaze", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Earth" and "Wind".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on February 7, 2024 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 43
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 43, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 43 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 43 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from January 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Notices
Underground Labyrinth B3 installed! Transformation for the Integral Series shield "Fermat" has been unlocked! Tons of new Skill Releasers added!
UPDATE

（JST/GMT+9）
Underground Labyrinth B3 was released after the January 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance.
A special scenario has been added to the Underground Labyrinth! Experience it in the Underground Labyrinth B3 main quest!
There will also be powerful monsters, new Skill Releasers, and the addition of transformation for the Integral Series shield.
They were certain he had disappeared...
After the 100th Floor Incident, a new Underground Labyrinth suddenly appears in the Blackiron Palace.
Scouts bring back two things from the unknown dungeon: the new Skill Releaser power and a message from a mysterious supporter of the Assault Team.
In order to unravel the mysteries of the Underground Labyrinth and obtain greater power, the Assault Team forms a scouting team.
With the man everyone was certain had disappeared, your group takes on the Underground Labyrinth!
Underground Labyrinth B3 Floor Installed!
You must first complete the Underground Labyrinth main quest "Underground Labyrinth: B2 Trial" in order to take on this new floor.
If you've already cleared "Underground Labyrinth: B1 Trial", you will automatically accept "Underground Labyrinth: B2 Trial".
Completing "Underground Labyrinth: B2 Trial" will allow you to enter Underground Labyrinth B3.
Once you reach Underground Labyrinth B3, the scenario for the Underground Labyrinth main quest will automatically begin.
Similar to other floors, Underground Labyrinth subquests have been added to the Underground Labyrinth B3.
* You can accept them after clearing the Underground Labyrinth main quest "A Knight May Fall but Will Rise Again".
Your progress on these quests can be checked by going to "Menu," then "Quest."
Changed Requirements for the Underground Labyrinth Main Quest "Underground Labyrinth: B1 Trial"
The requirement has been changed from defeating monsters in Underground Labyrinth B1 to collecting 25 Skill Releasers.
Skill Releasers received in any way, including from treasure chests and quest rewards, will now be counted.
They will count toward the quest requirements even if your inventory is full.
* Ongoing Underground Labyrinth: B1 Trials were reset during the January 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance.
Please proceed again with the new requirements.
This does not affect players who already cleared it.
How to Get to the Underground Labyrinth
You can go to each floor of the Underground Labyrinth by talking to the Underground Labyrinth Guide NPC in the Blackiron Palace or the Underground Labyrinth Inspector NPC on each floor, then selecting "You will move to the Underground Labyrinth" to see a list of the floors.
Added Achievements!
Added an achievement that awards 500 Arcana Gems when you clear certain Underground Labyrinth main quests.
You can get a total of 1,500 Arcana Gems by clearing up to Underground Labyrinth B3.

Transformation of the Integral Series Shield "Fermat" Unlocked!
You can now use two Crimson King Protection Stones and one Core Metal+++ obtainable from the Underground Labyrinth B3 to transform the Integral Series shield, Fermat.
You can get "Crimson King Protection Stone" in Underground Labyrinth B3 in the following ways.
・Get an extremely rare drop from the Kenneth : Crimson Kobold Lord boss monster when dealing damage that's over 0.1% of the Max HP

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 47th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-05-09 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 47th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Guild Arm Band (Red Green)
Accessory Avatar
Snake's Shield (Red Green)
Shield avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Medusa Shield (Red Green)
Shield avatar
Snake Queen's Hair (Red Green)
Accessory Avatar
Snakeskin Guild Cape (Red Green)
Accessory Avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 47 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the May 9, 2024 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the May 22, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the May 15, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 22, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 47 Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust Element skills

When Medusa is preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gets four stack buffs.
The time it is immobilized for after a Skill Break is long.

Important

Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.

Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.

Affected Items: "Guild Arm Band (Purple Yellow)", "Snake's Shield (Purple Yellow)", "Medusa Shield (Purple Yellow)", "Snake Queen's Hair (Purple Yellow)", and "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Purple Yellow)".

It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.

To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Super (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
You will automatically move to the standby map.
You can display the standby member list from the action button on the bottom right of the screen.

If you would like to join a random group, we recommend using "Quick Group" to automatically join a group you can participate in.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
If you are in a party, only the party leader can create or join a Group.

The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.

If you were logged in from before April 25 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 47, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 46 has begun!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the April 17, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 46, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 46 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from April 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 46 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash Element skills
②Dagger skills
③Skills that are Slash Element and Water Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.

5 GoG Season 46 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 46 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 46 dungeons.
"GoG Season 46 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 46 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 46 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 46 Badge."

The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 is shared between all guild members.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 46!
EVENT
2024-04-17 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 46 has begun!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the April 17, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 46, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 46 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from April 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Arcana Gems
The higher your ranking, the more Arcana Gems you will receive as rewards.
All players ranked 101 and lower will receive the same amount of Arcana Gems.
Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 46 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash Element skills
②Dagger skills
③Skills that are Slash Element and Water Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 46 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 46 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 46 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 46 dungeons.
"GoG Season 46 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 46 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 46 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 46 Badge."
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Masquerade Demon" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 46 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the April 24 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on August 14, 2024 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 46 Badges will be deleted on April 30, 2024 (Tue) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Ring
A Ring is a piece of equipment that is different from armor.
This item can be produced, and it provides a Main Effect that increases natural Element damage, as well as up to two types of Random Bonuses, such as increased attack.
By equipping a Ring, you will also be able to equip another Ability Skill Record as an EX Ability.

Ring Production
It can be produced using materials such as the Ring Gemstone obtained in "LafCof Phantoms & the Ring Gem Temple", and "Coarse Stones" dropped on each floor.
You can use a Ring as a material to produce a higher-rarity Ring.
Produce lots of rings until you have one with your favorite effects and bonuses.

Rewards

Transformation Items
Various types of Rabbit Cookies grant buffs that allow you to transform into specific rabbit monsters for a period of time.
They are effective for 180 seconds.
Movement, the evasion button, and some items can be used while transformed. However, other actions such as attacking cannot be performed.
Transformation will end in the following cases:
Transformation buff effect time ends.
The player moves between areas (including entering/exiting dungeons, etc.).
Cancel Transformation button is tapped (the Attack button will turn into the Cancel Transformation button while transformed).
* Using another type of transformation item while transformed will overwrite your transformation state.
* The Awakening button can be used while transformed to play a flashy rabbit animation.
[4/1 0:01 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]
We have confirmed the following issues with the tranformation feature.
Pressing the Cancel Transformation button does not cancel the transformation
While transformed, Burst and Full Burst can be activated (No damage is dealt)
While transformed, the player is not blown away even when taking a blow-away attack
While transformed, the player appears to be standing on other players' screens when defeated
While transformed, the field of vision is incorrect when using VR Mode
While transformed, the player may become buried in the ground
While transformed and warping with warp devices, etc, the player may become stuck
* Controls return to normal when transformation is canceled.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 46th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-04-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 46th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 46 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the April 10, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the April 17, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 46 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash Element skills
②Dagger skills
③Skills that are Slash Element and Water Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.

Transformation buff effect time ends.

Transformation Items
Various types of Rabbit Cookies grant buffs that allow you to transform into specific rabbit monsters for a period of time.
They are effective for 180 seconds.
Movement, the evasion button, and some items can be used while transformed. However, other actions such as attacking cannot be performed.
Transformation will end in the following cases:
Transformation buff effect time ends.
The player moves between areas (including entering/exiting dungeons, etc.).
Cancel Transformation button is tapped (the Attack button will turn into the Cancel Transformation button while transformed).
* Using another type of transformation item while transformed will overwrite your transformation state.
* The Awakening button can be used while transformed to play a flashy rabbit animation.
[4/1 0:01 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]

Pressing the Cancel Transformation button does not cancel the transformation
While transformed, Burst and Full Burst can be activated (No damage is dealt)
While transformed, the player is not blown away even when taking a blow-away attack
While transformed, the player appears to be standing on other players' screens when defeated
While transformed, the field of vision is incorrect when using VR Mode
While transformed, the player may become buried in the ground
While transformed and warping with warp devices, etc, the player may become stuck
* Controls return to normal when transformation is canceled.

Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.

Pick up period
Until maintenance begins on July 10, 2024 (Wed)
* The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before March 22 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 46, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Masquerade Demon", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Water".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on April 10, 2024 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 45
During the Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 45, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 banner.
Ranking Reward
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in against the boss monster and clear any difficulty of a "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from March 22 (Fri) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The Champion's Room is scheduled to remain unlocked until the end of the next Guild of Guilds season.
* Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to get a prestigious Record including your rank as an Achievement Reward.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.

The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".

Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Land at least 1 hit and clear the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 Dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.

The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
Guilds

You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.

Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.

The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 dungeon.

Holiday Campaign!
The new event Successive Strike: Roaring Rocks is here!
In this event, you'll try to clear stages within the time limit by routing tons of low-level monsters that appear in a field made just for this event.
Defeating all the low-level monsters will cause a boss monster to appear.
The stage will be completed if you reach the time limit or defeat the boss monster.
The less time it takes for you to clear the stage, the more points you'll get, allowing you to more rapidly earn total score rewards!

You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Successive Strike Event" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.

Pick up period
Until October 9, 2024 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before June 27 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on July 10, 2024 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 49, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
And the boss that will appear... is none other than the new monster "
Viaio Cetus
", the fifth type of GoG boss!
Of course, the reward avatar available is also themed after this new boss!
It will have a weapon elemental weakness to Slash Element and a natural elemental weakness to Wind Element.
Look forward to it coming on July 10 (Wed)!
Important
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 48 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the June 19, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 26, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 48, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 48 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 48 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from June 27 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Avatar
Limited-edition special avatars for Guild of Guilds are here!
The "Terrifying Helm (Blue Yellow)" is an accessory avatar visor that comes with an emote to open its big eye.
The "Terrifying Shield (Blue Yellow)" has a large moving eye.
The "Gaze Shield (Blue Yellow)" comes with a guild icon.

All players ranked 101 and lower will receive the same amount of Arcana Gems.
Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 48 Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Water Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.
