* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Status ailment "Petrify": Lose the ability to use actions or items, and take double the damage.
This will be removed after a certain amount of time or by taking damage.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 48 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 48 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 48 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 48 dungeons.
"GoG Season 48 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 48 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 48 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 48 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 48 Badge."
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Terror Gaze" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 48 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 48 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 48 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the June 26 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on October 9, 2024 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 48 Badges will be deleted on July 3, 2024 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Notices
Underground Labyrinth B4F installed! ★5 Transformation for the shield "Fermat" has been unlocked! Lots of new Skill Releasers also added!
UPDATE
2024-06-26 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Underground Labyrinth B4F was released after the June 26, 2024 (Wed) maintenance.
What deserves to be trusted? Things that humans have already placed their trust in?
After conquering the third basement floor of the Underground Labyrinth, the scouting team heads to the next floor, B4F.
As Diavel throws himself into the search with Silica, the "young senior", he comes face to face with his questions about trust.
Silica displays her own kind of strength as a member of the Assault Team.
What does Diavel think as he witnesses this, and what answer does he arrive at...?
Major Updates
Underground Labyrinth B4F, new quests, and achievements have been added.
Transformation for the Integral Series shield "Fermat" has been unlocked.
Many Skill Releasers available in Underground Labyrinth B4F have been added.
Underground Labyrinth floor naming has been standardized in the format "Underground Labyrinth B(x)F."
Underground Labyrinth B4F Floor Installed!
Completing Underground Labyrinth B3F's Underground Labyrinth main quest will allow you to enter Underground Labyrinth B4F.

Holiday Campaign!
The new event Successive Strike: Roaring Rocks is here!
In this event, you'll try to clear stages within the time limit by routing tons of low-level monsters that appear in a field made just for this event.
Defeating all the low-level monsters will cause a boss monster to appear.
The stage will be completed if you reach the time limit or defeat the boss monster.
The less time it takes for you to clear the stage, the more points you'll get, allowing you to more rapidly earn total score rewards!
You can also get even more Successive Strike Plates required for exchange by defeating the boss monster. On certain difficulties, there's also a chance that the boss monster will drop Star Fragments.
The treasure boxes you find on the path will provide useful effects, so go get them as needed!
Finally, this event can be played with groups of up to 12 members.

Successive Strike Event allows you to form groups of up to 12 players.
How to Join Groups
You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Successive Strike Event" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.

Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".

Holiday Campaign!
The new event Successive Strike: Roaring Rocks is here!
In this event, you'll try to clear stages within the time limit by routing tons of low-level monsters that appear in a field made just for this event.
Defeating all the low-level monsters will cause a boss monster to appear.
The stage will be completed if you reach the time limit or defeat the boss monster.
The less time it takes for you to clear the stage, the more points you'll get, allowing you to more rapidly earn total score rewards!
You can also get even more Successive Strike Plates required for exchange by defeating the boss monster. On certain difficulties, there's also a chance that the boss monster will drop Star Fragments.
The treasure boxes you find on the path will provide useful effects, so go get them as needed!
Finally, this event can be played with groups of up to 12 members.
Take it on with the biggest group you can to gain an advantage on the battlefield!

EVENT
2024-06-19 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 48 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the June 19, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 26, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 48, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 48 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 48 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from June 27 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.

The amount of "GoG Season 48 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.

Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 48 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.

Notices
The 48th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-06-12 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 48th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 48 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the June 12, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 26, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the June 19, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 26, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter

Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.

Notices
Chapter 2 Aincrad 69F! Super rare Machina Integral Series 3rd level transformation unlocked!
UPDATE
2024-05-29 18:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Argo heads to a foreign country.
The Assault Team departs for the 69th floor after receiving reports of a Doped monster from the Virtual Division.
To investigate, you head into the territory of the Adamasadderians, Aincrad's strongest and fiercest tribe of warrior-reptilians.
This group is so dangerous that even the Assault Team has forbidden its members from fighting them during their first surveys of the floor.
The tribe has its own language, and rumors say they cannot be spoken to or negotiated with. After encountering a group of them, you find yourselves captured.
Hearing this, Aincrad's top information broker, Argo the Rat, leaps into action.
In a foreign country where humans, elves, and vampires all speak a common language, the Rat raises the curtain on a new and exciting tale!
Major Updates
"Aincrad 69F" and a new quest has been implemented.
Added 69F boss avatars.
The super rare Machina Integral Series weapon transformation has been unlocked.
Player attack has been increased.
The weapon proficiency level cap has been raised, and weapon proficiency skills have been added.
For details, please see the
"Weapon proficiency level cap raised and weapon proficiency skills added!"
article.

The drop rate for Machina Integral Series production and transformation materials is highest in Labyrinth - Interior.
Boss Monster
Alphard the Adamas Snake
Details
The battle takes place on a "Field with unusable items", where certain items cannot be used.
At the beginning of battle, it grants a "Critical resistance" buff.
Some attacks will remove buffs from the players.
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
Depending on the boss monster's status ailment (Burn, Frostbite) stacks, the damage it takes increases.
You can break it with Slash Element skills.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Dark Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.

STEP1
Get the Machina Integral Series to ★4 (2nd Level Transformation)!
Transform "Machina Integral Series" to ★4 here.
STEP2
Use the Stone+++ you produced and Adamas Snake Armament Stone to transform the Machina Integral Series to ★5!
To produce Stone+++, you will need the extremely rare Core Metal+++ and Stone+ materials that drop from the All Out Battle "The Skull Reaper" or All Out Battle [Aincrad].
* Each "Stone+++" is associated with a different weapon type.
Example: For 1H Swords or Daggers, you will need to produce Slicing Stone+++ using Core Metal+++ and Slicing Stone+.

Use the Stone+++ you produced and Adamas Snake Armament Stone to transform the Machina Integral Series to ★5!

In Guild of Guilds Season 47, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.

get an even higher score
.

Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.

Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

"GoG Season 47 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 47 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 47 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Groups
Defense Battle allows you to form groups of up to 12 players.
How to Join Groups
You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Defense Battle" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
When the dungeon is finished, you can skip the monster hunt log wait time by tapping the screen.

Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 47!
EVENT
2024-05-15 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 47 has begun!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the May 15, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 22, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 47, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 47 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from May 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.

The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".

GoG Season 47 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 47 dungeons.
"GoG Season 47 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 47 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 47 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Medusa" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the May 22 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on September 11, 2024 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 47 Badges will be deleted on May 29, 2024 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 50 has begun!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the August 21, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 28, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 50, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 50 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 50 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from August 29 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

The amount of "GoG Season 50 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 50 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 50 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 50!
EVENT
2024-08-21 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 50 has begun!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the August 21, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 28, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 50, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 50 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 50th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-08-15 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 50th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 50 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the August 15, 2024 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the August 28, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the August 21, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 28, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 50 Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.

Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
The "GoG Season 50 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on August 28 (Wed).
The "Wander Gear O" and "Wander Cape O" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on September 4 (Wed).
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 45 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 45 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Scythe" after maintenance on August 28 (Wed).

It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 50 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Boss Monster
Fatal Prison Warden
Details
This is a vicious monster with high HP, attack, and defense.
You can perform breaks.
It deals Skill Breakable attacks, and can Skill Break with Slash Element skills.
When a break or skill break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
In addition, it will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
Depending on the boss monster's status ailment  (Poison,Burn, Bleed, Frostbite) stacks, the damage it takes increases.
This boss will use a variety of buffs, debuffs, and status ailments to lure the player to their death.
Determine the boss's state and the progress of the battle, and use your battle experience to defeat it.

"Groups"
You can take on "Fatal Battle Super (Group OK)" with a group of up to 18 members.
How to Join Groups
To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Super (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
You will automatically move to the standby map.
You can display the standby member list from the action button on the bottom right of the screen.
When groups are formed, players who are not already in a party will be put into a party together and sent to the dungeon automatically.
If you would like to join a random group, we recommend using "Quick Group" to automatically join a group you can participate in.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
If you are in a party, only the party leader can create or join a Group.

Each player's Damage Points are calculated on the result screen by taking the amount of HP the enemy loses from the start until the battle is cleared and dividing it by the number of players remaining in the dungeon at clear time.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 49 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the July 17, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 49, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 49 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 49 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from July 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).

For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Breaks can be performed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Wind Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

.

GoG Season 49 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 49 dungeons.
"GoG Season 49 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 49 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 49 dungeon's monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 49 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

EVENT

（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 49 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the July 17, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 49, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 49 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 49 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from July 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.

GoG Season 49 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Breaks can be performed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Wind Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Break: Filling the entire Break Gauge will temporarily immobilize the boss and remove all of its buff effects.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 49 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 49 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 49 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 49 dungeons.
"GoG Season 49 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 49 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 49 dungeon's monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 49 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
A new boss appears! The 49th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-07-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 49th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
Appearing this time is the new 5th Guild of Guilds boss, Viaio Cetus!
Take on this unknown enemy again and again to figure out how to defeat it!
Reward avatars and Records themed after Viaio Cetus will also be appearing for the first time!
Do your best to earn them!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Cetus Mask A
Accessory Avatar
Cetus Arm Band A
Accessory Avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Cetus Shield A
Shield avatar

Accessory Avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 49 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the July 10, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the July 17, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 24, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 49 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Breaks can be performed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Wind Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
Weakness
Slash Element

Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Sleep", "Bloodshed" and "Debility"
Stack debuff "Decrease Defense"
* Break: Filling the entire Break Gauge will temporarily immobilize the boss and remove all of its buff effects.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Debility: Lowers max HP with each hit (up to 99%).
Recover using items like Cleansing Potions.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Violent Whale Scale" material required for production.
The "GoG Season 49 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on July 24 (Wed).
The "Cetus Mask A" and "Cetus Arm Band A" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on July 31 (Wed).
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 49 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 49 reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Cetus" at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 49 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 52!
EVENT
2024-10-17 17:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 52 has begun!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the October 17, 2024 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the October 23, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 52, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 52 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from October 24 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 52 Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust Element skills
②Skills that are Thrust Element and Dark Element
When Medusa is preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gets four stack buffs.
The time it is immobilized for after a Skill Break is long.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 52 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 52 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 52 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 52 dungeons.
"GoG Season 52 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 52 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 52 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 52 Badge."

The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 dungeon.

A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the first Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the October 9, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 30, 2024 (Wed) maintenance.
Monster's weak element for This Tournament
Thrust Element
Earth Element
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the circle by your feet.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The First Squad Jumble."
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 3 minutes, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Newly Added Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return."
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.

* Rank will not be lowered by a decrease in Rank Points.
Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned
"Match Count Rewards", according to the number of battles participated in
Rewards exchanged at the Trader using gathered Squad Symbols
Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The first Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2024-10-09 17:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the first Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the October 9, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 30, 2024 (Wed) maintenance.
Monster's weak element for This Tournament
Thrust Element
Earth Element
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the circle by your feet.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The First Squad Jumble."
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 3 minutes, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Newly Added Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return."
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.

* Rank will not be lowered by a decrease in Rank Points.

Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned

Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 52nd "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-10-09 17:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 52nd "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon

Type

Shield avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Avatars

Type

Shield avatar

Accessory Avatar
