Accessory Avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 52 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the October 9, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 23, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the October 17, 2024 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the October 23, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.

Medusa

"Status Ailments"

Please check all Rewards in the game.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.
The "GoG Season 52 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on October 23 (Wed).
The "Guild Arm Band (Blue Pink)" and "Snake's Shield (Blue Pink)" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on October 30 (Wed).
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 47 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 47 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Medusa" after maintenance on October 23 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Guild Arm Band (Red Green)", "Snake's Shield (Red Green)", "Medusa Shield (Red Green)", "Snake Queen's Hair (Red Green)", and "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Red Green)".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 52 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Medusa" at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
[10/2 13:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] The Trial Gym is now available to challenge as a party!
UPDATE
2024-10-02 13:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
In the "Trial Gym", you can practice with game controls as well as check skill effects and equipment power by attacking the high-HP "Crystals" placed around the dungeon.
There are 18 different types of Crystals that combine a Slash, Thrust, or Blunt weapon elemental weakness with a "Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Holy, or Dark" natural elemental weakness.
Take advantage of them to measure the amount of damage you can deal and establish an effective skill set.
"Trial Gym" Details
- The "Trial Gym" dungeon has two difficulties: "Trial Gym Normal" and "Trial Gym Chaos".
The "Crystals" in the "Trial Gym Chaos" difficulty will gain the damage-reducing "Chaos Recollection" buff when they receive any damage.
The Crystals' Chaos Recollection decreases damage by 50%.
- After 60 minutes have passed, the dungeon will automatically be cleared.
If you want to stop before that, you can use the exit to escape.
* Please note that the dungeon will not be cleared if you escape.
- Your partner will join you when challenging solo.
"Trial Gym" Uses
- See how much damage your attacks do based on equipment and skill combinations.
- Find the optimal skill combination for each monster's weakness.
- Practice game controls such as skill activation order.
* The dungeon contains only "Crystals" that don't attack and "Recover Flowers".
For this reason, some aspects of your skills may not be usable.
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Crystal List
- There are 6 different colors of "Crystals", each with its own "natural elemental weakness".
They are split into "Slash, Thrust, or Blunt" weapon elemental weakness groups within the dungeon.
- The "Crystals" have 500,000,000 HP.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before September 26 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 52, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Medusa", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Thrust" and a natural elemental weakness to "Dark".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on October 9, 2024 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
Important
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 51 has begun!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the September 18, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 51, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 51 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 51 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from September 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.
Record Acquisition

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 51 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash Element skills
②Dagger skills
③Skills that are Slash Element and Holy Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 51 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 51 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 51 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 51 dungeons.
"GoG Season 51 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 51 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 51 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 51 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 51 Badge."
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild

Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Masquerade Demon" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 51 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 51 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 51 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the September 25 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 51!
EVENT
2024-09-18 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 51 has begun!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the September 18, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 51, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 51 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 51 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from September 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Avatar
Limited-edition special avatars for Guild of Guilds are here!
"Devil Shield L" and "Devil Helm N" come with your guild icon.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 51 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Slash Element skills
②Dagger skills
③Skills that are Slash Element and Holy Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 51 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 51 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 51 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 51 dungeons.
"GoG Season 51 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 51 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 51 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 51 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 51 Badge."
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Notice for maintenance(9/18)
MAINT.
2024-09-17 18:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
Maintenance we have implemented from 9/18, 2024, 14:00, was completed on 9/18, 2024, 17:00(JST/UTC+9).
The following are new updates.
▼Newly Implemented & New Events
"Guild of Guilds" Season 51 begins
[Worldwide 6.5 Year Anniversary] "Boss Rush VS Taurus King" begins
Added [Worldwide 6.5 Year Anniversary] "Gourmand Macaque Hunt" Event rewards
[Worldwide 6.5 Year Anniversary] "Chaos Showdown: All Open" begins
"Paint Out Order" begins
"Arcana Gem Super Boost Campaign" begins
▼Added Features & Feature Adjustments
Town of Beginnings: Teleport Gate Plaza and Town of Beginnings: Merchant District have been combined into one map
Added FPS values to the settings
You can adjust FPS settings from the "FPS" area under Menu > System > Settings > Setting Details > Controls.
* The default value is 60.
▼Fixed Issues
Fixed an issue where the camera would enter restricted areas when using View Mode on the elevator
When attacking monsters with damage reflection, the total damage from consecutive attacks was displaying as the damage of the first hit, so we have fixed it so that damage inflicted will now display for each hit as it does with normal attacks.
* Other minor improvements, adjustments, and issues are being handled.
▼New Events
Thank you for your cooperation.
-----------------------------

How to Participate
Talk to the "Event Dungeon" NPC at the "Teleport Gate Plaza" to challenge it.
Event Period
Starts after the September 4, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2024 (Wed) maintenance.
* The high-difficulty dungeon Abyss will be implemented after the September 11, 2024 (Wed) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
Boss Monster
Gourmand Macaque
Details
Break with Slash Element.
On Abyss difficulty, you can break it with the Thrust Element.
When a break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
In addition, when a Break happens, it will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
On Special, Extreme, Unknown and Abyss difficulties, the enemy uses a Seal Items debuff.
On DANGER, Gaining Ground, Special, Extreme, Unknown and Abyss difficulty levels, it will use the Chaos Recollection buff.
In the "Special", "Extreme", "Unknown", and "Abyss" difficulties, it is less susceptible to "Burn" and "Bleed" status ailment attacks due to resistance.
Depending on the boss monster's status ailment (Poison,Burn, Bleed, Frostbite) stacks, the damage it takes increases.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 51th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2024-09-11 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 51th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 51 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the September 11, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the September 18, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.

When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a buff that "Increase Attack".
When a break or skill break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
In addition, when a Break happens, it will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
It has a resistense that make it less susceptible to attacks with the Burn and Bleed status ailments.
Depending on the boss monster's status ailment (Poison,Burn, Bleed, Frostbite) stacks, the damage it takes increases.
It reflects some damage when attacked.
Some attacks will reduce the Awakening gauge.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
A wild frenzy of switches and counters! Chain Skills are here!
UPDATE
2024-11-29 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Chain Skills
have been added to the game!
What Are Chain Skills?
When using a Chain Skill by switching, you will temporarily enter a Chain state.
While in a Chain state, you can use all of your skills, not just the one in your first Skill Slot, as switches.
* However, non-Chain Skill skills must be Limit Break +10 to be used as switches while in a Chain state.
Using a Chain Skill while in a Chain state will also provide special effects to skills used as switches while in a Chain state.
Using multiple Chain Skills can cause their special effects to overlap, allowing you to unleash powerful attacks.
Also, special additional damage will be applied beyond the regular chain effects depending on the number of times you switch while in a Chain state.
This is known as a Super Chain.
To see these special effects, go to a skill's details screen and check the tab marked with the blue "CS" icon.
While in a Chain state, special effects will apply to other skills that are Limit Break +10, such as Connect Skills, Accele Skills, and Full Burst Skills.
For example, using Connect Skills while in a Chain state will give each skill the Chain state's effects so long as the linked skills are Limit Break +10.
Also, the Chain Skill's special effects will be applied to those linked skills if a Chain Skill is a linked skill.
Full Burst Skills act similarly, with the Chain state's effects applying to Full Burst or Burst Skills while the Full Burst state is also active.
This can result in powerful effects depending on how you combine them, so try it out in battle!
Activating a Chain State
There are two ways to activate a Chain state by using a Chain Skill.
1: Use a Chain Skill placed in your first Skill Slot during a switch.
2: Use a Chain Skill at the right moment during certain attacks. (Detailed later under "Counter Switch")
The remaining effect time will be displayed on the Switch Gauge when in a Chain state.
You can also extend a Chain state's activation time depending on the amount of Switch Gauge you have.
Switch Gauge Amount
Activation Time
1
30 sec.
2
45 sec.
3
60 sec.
There will be a set amount of cooldown time after a Chain state ends.
You cannot enter a Chain state by using a Chain Skill during this cooldown time.
You can check on this cooldown time by referencing the color of the Switch Gauge's border.
When the border's gray area is entirely gone and the "CS" area is lit, the cooldown time has ended.
Chain Skill Abilities
Equipping these allow you to raise the maximum damage of your Super Chains and increase the activation time of your Chain states.
Please note that equipping something to an EX Ability slot will not provide any of these effects.
Counter Switch
Use a Chain Skill at the right moment during specific attacks to both nullify that attack's damage and deal damage to your opponent with that Chain Skill.
If you meet the conditions to enter a Chain state as this happens, you will then enter one.
A debuff will be applied to the enemy for a period of time, allowing you to deal increased damage.
Attacks that can be Counter Switched have different visual effects from regular attacks.
The color of the visual effect displayed on the ground will be a deep orange that switches to blue.
In order to successfully Counter Switch, you will need to land a Chain Skill during the moment that this effect is blue.
Not all enemies have these kinds of attacks.
Also, you cannot enter a Chain state by using a Chain Skill during its cooldown time even if you activate a Counter Switch.
Monster with a Counter Switch Targeted Attacks
With the introduction of Counter Switch, not only newly added monsters but also the following existing monsters will now use Counter Switch Targeted Attacks.
Floor bosses and dungeon bosses of each floor
Each boss of the Chaos Showdown
* "Teo the Teaser Tentacles", "The Last Number" and "Last Number Chaos" are not included.
Additional Counter Switch Targeted Attacks may be added to existing monsters in the future.
Exiting the Chain state
The Chain state is primarily exited in the following ways.
The remaining time in the Chain state runs out.
The area changes.
A Quick Change is performed.
The Menu Screen is displayed.
Your character is defeated.
How to get Chain Skills
Aside from Orders, you can get the ★4[Leader Through Peril] Griselda Chain Skill Record as a quest reward from the 19F Main Quest.

■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before November 21 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 54, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Viaio Cetus", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Fire".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on December 11, 2024 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).

-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 53 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the November 13, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 20, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 53, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 53 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 53 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

The amount of "GoG Season 53 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.

Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 53 dungeon's boss monster.

The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 2nd Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2024-11-20 18:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 2nd Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Differences from the Previous Tournament
Changes will primarily consist of the following improvements and adjustments:
Shortened matching time / quick team formation time (150 seconds maximum)
★ mark placed over your character's head
Adjusted blue team's color on the mini-map
Removed alphabetical characters in ranks
Shortened initial appearance time of Damage Areas
Changed Killer Monsters so that they cannot be defeated
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the November 20, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 5, 2024 (Thu) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Slash Element
Earth Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the circle by your feet.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 2nd Squad Jumble."
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 3 minutes, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return."
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.

* Rank will not be lowered by a decrease in Rank Points.
Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned
"Match Count Rewards", according to the number of battles participated in
Rewards exchanged at the Trader using gathered Squad Symbols
Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 53!
EVENT
2024-11-13 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 53 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the November 13, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 20, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 53, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 53 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 53 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from November 21 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.

When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.

Alternatively, please refer to the

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 53 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 53 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 53 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 53 dungeons.
"GoG Season 53 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 53 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 53 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 53 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.

The 53rd "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 53 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.

Season: Starts after the November 13, 2024 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 20, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

The Gleam Eyes
Details
The battle takes place on a "Field with unusable items", where certain items cannot be used.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Wind Element.
For the Abyss difficulty, Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Thrust Element and Fire Element.
When a break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
In addition, when a Break happens, it will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
On Special, Extreme, Unknown and Abyss difficulties, the enemy uses a Seal Items debuff.
On DANGER, Gaining Ground, Special, Extreme, Unknown and Abyss difficulty levels, it will use the Chaos Recollection buff.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 52 has begun!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the October 17, 2024 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the October 23, 2024 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 52, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 52 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from October 24 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 52 Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust Element skills
②Skills that are Thrust Element and Dark Element
When Medusa is preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gets four stack buffs.
The time it is immobilized for after a Skill Break is long.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 52 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 52 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 52 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 52 dungeons.
"GoG Season 52 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 52 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 52 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 52 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 52 Badge."

Underground Labyrinth B5F Floor Installed!
Completing Underground Labyrinth B4F's Underground Labyrinth main quest will allow you to enter Underground Labyrinth B5F.
Once you reach Underground Labyrinth B5F, the scenario for the Underground Labyrinth main quest will automatically begin.
Similar to other floors, Underground Labyrinth subquests have been added to the Underground Labyrinth B5F.
* These can be accepted by completely clearing Underground Labyrinth B5F's Underground Labyrinth main quest.
Added Achievements!
Added an achievement that awards 500 Arcana Gems when you completely clear Underground Labyrinth B5F's Underground Labyrinth main quest.
Introducing the New Nox Integral Series Shield!
You can now produce the Nox Integral Series shield "Nox Fermat" using materials acquired in Underground Labyrinth B5F.
It can be produced using 2 "Spit Spider Protection Stone" and 200 "Sinister Skeleton Crystal".
You can get "Spit Spider Protection Stone" in Underground Labyrinth B5F in the following ways.
・Get an extremely rare drop from the Stacy : Spit Spider boss monster when dealing damage that's over 0.1% of the Max HP
・Drops with a low probability when you damage the Stacy : Spit Spider boss monster, or produce from 200 "Spit Spider Protection Stone Piece" that you can get from treasure boxes as an rare drop.
*The drop rate or number of each item increases with the amount of damage dealt on the boss monster.
*Excluding reflected damage.

Details
The battle takes place on a "Field with unusable items", where certain items cannot be used.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Wind Element.
For the Abyss difficulty, Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Thrust Element and Fire Element.
When a break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
In addition, when a Break happens, it will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
On Special, Extreme, Unknown and Abyss difficulties, the enemy uses a Seal Items debuff.
On DANGER, Gaining Ground, Special, Extreme, Unknown and Abyss difficulty levels, it will use the Chaos Recollection buff.

Ring
A Ring is a piece of equipment that is different from armor.
This item can be produced, and it provides a Main Effect that increases natural Element damage, as well as up to two types of Random Bonuses, such as increased attack.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 55!
EVENT
2025-01-15 18:30:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 55 has begun!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the January 15, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 22, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 55, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 55 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 55 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from January 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

All players ranked 101 and lower will receive the same amount of Arcana Gems.
Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 55 Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff on Extreme difficulty.

section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 55 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 55 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 55 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 55 dungeons.
"GoG Season 55 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 55 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 55 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 55 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 55 Badge."
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Wander Fatal Scythe" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 55 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 55 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 55 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the January 22 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on June 11, 2025 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 55 Badges will be deleted on January 29, 2025 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 55th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-01-08 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 55th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 55 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the January 8, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 22, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the January 15, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 22, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).

Complete the 1F Main Quest

Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.

Notices
Wonder Animal Assault 2025 is on now! Rewards include everything from Exp Crystals, re-released Skill Records, accessory avatars, stamps and more!
EVENT
2025-01-08 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Hordes of monsters attack in the "Wonder Animal Assault 2025"!
After a certain amount of time passes, the boss monster will appear.
Drive off hordes of monsters and earn
tons of EXP

With this update, the Special difficulty, which is even harder than Maniac, has been added!
While it is more difficult than Maniac, you can earn incredible scores on this difficulty.

An Expert high-difficulty dungeon will appear at a later date featuring powerful monsters far tougher than previous Expert dungeons.

Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Boss Monster
Fatal Strict Hermit
Details
A total of four bosses will appear.
Each boss is breakable.
▼Fatal Träumerei Hermit
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
▼Fatal Plasterer Hermit
It deals Skill Breakable attacks, and can Skill Break with Blunt Element skills.
They have high damage resistance.
You can inflict large amounts of damage when a break happens.
▼Fatal Strict Hermit Chaos
It deals Skill Breakable attacks, and can Skill Break with Dagger skills.
They have high damage resistance.
Depending on the monster's status ailment (Poison,Burn, Bleed, Frostbite) stacks, the damage it takes increases.
▼Fatal Strict Hermit
It deals Skill Breakable attacks, and can Skill Break with Thrust Element skills.
They have high damage resistance.
They are resistant to status ailments, but depending on the monster's status ailment (Poison,Burn, Bleed, Frostbite) stacks, the damage it takes increases.
When a break or skill break happens, they will receive a stack debuffs that increase the damage they take.
This boss will use a variety of buffs, debuffs, and status ailments to lure the player to their death.
Determine the boss's state and the progress of the battle, and use your battle experience to defeat it.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
"Groups"
You can take on "Fatal Battle Super (Group OK)" with a group of up to 18 members.
How to Join Groups
To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Super (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
You will automatically move to the standby map.
You can display the standby member list from the action button on the bottom right of the screen.
When groups are formed, players who are not already in a party will be put into a party together and sent to the dungeon automatically.
If you would like to join a random group, we recommend using "Quick Group" to automatically join a group you can participate in.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
If you are in a party, only the party leader can create or join a Group.
