news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 58!
EVENT
2025-04-16 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 58 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the April 16, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 23, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 58, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 58 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 58 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from April 24 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 58 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 58 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 58 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 58 dungeons.
"GoG Season 58 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 58 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 58 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 58 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 58 Badge."

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 58th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-04-09 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 58th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 58 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the April 9, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 23, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the April 16, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 23, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 58 Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Holy Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.

Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 53 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 53 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Gaze" after maintenance on April 23 (Wed).

It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 58 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

EVENT

（JST/GMT+9）
The Scenario Event "Fluffy Bunny Panic!" is back!
The Assault Team is in big trouble!?
The curtain rises on the biggest 'incident' in SAO...!
Rewards
Get Rabbit Cookies, a new item, as rewards!
Using these allows you to transform into various types of rabbit monsters for a period of time!
These are limited-time items, so be sure to use them all before the event ends!
Other rewards in this event include the
event-limited ★4[Rabbit Crown] Agill Skill Record, as well as Memory Stamps!

"Star Fragments" may drop on certain difficulty levels!
For this returning event, acquisition status of Total Score Rewards, Challenge Rewards and Trader Rewards from last time will be reset, allowing players to acquire these rewards once more.
Transformation Items
Various types of Rabbit Cookies grant buffs that allow you to transform into specific rabbit monsters for a period of time.
They are effective for 180 seconds.
Movement, the evasion button, and some items can be used while transformed. However, other actions such as attacking cannot be performed.
Transformation will end in the following cases:
Transformation buff effect time ends.
The player moves between areas (including entering/exiting dungeons, etc.).
Cancel Transformation button is tapped (the Attack button will turn into the Cancel Transformation button while transformed).
* Using another type of transformation item while transformed will overwrite your transformation state.
* The Awakening button can be used while transformed to play a flashy rabbit animation.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Get Chaos Boss avatars by defeating enhanced bosses! Chaos Boss Dungeon Part 22 has been added!
EVENT
2025-03-26 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
"White Wyrm Chaos" has arrived in the high-difficulty Chaos Boss Dungeon!
The "Chaos Boss Dungeon Part 23" is open.
Reward
Production materials which may drop from the boss can be used to produce
Chaos Boss avatars
.
You can also receive production materials from rewards.
Avatar Images
How to Participate
Accept the Chaos Boss Dungeon from the NPCs "Chaos Boss Dungeon Interior" and "Chaos Boss Dungeon Depth" in the Blackiron Palace.
* "Chaos Boss Dungeon Interior" and "Chaos Boss Dungeon Depth" can each be cleared only once per day.
Participation Requirements
Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]
Dungeon Duration
This dungeon can be challenged after the maintenance on March 26, 2025.
Chaos Boss Dungeon/Black White Wyrm
Difficulty
Recommended Total Power
Interior
200,000 × 6
Depth
250,000 × 6
Total Power is a number that gives an approximation of the player's overall strength.
It changes based on factors like equipment, Skill Records, and weapon proficiency level.
* Each dungeon has a different total power recommendation.
Check it by going to Menu > Status > Player.
When your Total Power is near the recommended amount, challenge the boss with a party!
White Wyrm Chaos
Details
The beginning of battle, it uses a "Critical resistance" buff.
Depending on the boss monster's status ailment stacks, the damage it takes increases.
You can break it with Dagger skills.
With each Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
*This does not include Skill Breaks.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Water Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a buff that "Reduce Damage".

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."

Notices
[3/20 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 57!
EVENT
2025-03-20 14:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
[3/20 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]
Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.
For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
Pick up period
Until August 13, 2025 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before March 20 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 58, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Terror Gaze", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Earth" and "Holy".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on April 9, 2025 (Wed) (JST/UTC+9).
Important
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 57 has begun!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the March 12, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 19, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 57, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 57 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 57 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from March 20 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 57 Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Blunt Element skills
②Skills that are Blunt Element and Wind Element
When Medusa is preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gets four stack buffs.
The time it is immobilized for after a Skill Break is long.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 57 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 57 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 57 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 57 dungeons.
"GoG Season 57 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 57 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 57 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 57 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 57 Badge."
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.

Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Medusa" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 57 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 57 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 57 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.

Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 60!
EVENT
2025-06-18 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 60 has begun!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the June 18, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 25, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 60, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 60 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 60 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from June 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 60 Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff on Extreme difficulty.

"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 60 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 60 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 60 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 60 dungeons.
"GoG Season 60 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 60 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 60 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 60 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 60 Badge."

Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!

Please see below for more details on guilds.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 60th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-06-11 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 60th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Wander Gear Q
Accessory Avatar
Wander Cape Q
Accessory Avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Wander Brooch N
Accessory Avatar
Wander Mask N
Accessory Avatar
Wander Shield N
Shield avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 60 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the June 11, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 25, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the June 18, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 25, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 60 Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.
Weakness
Slash Element
Dark Element
Resistance
Critical
Damage

Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Old Grudge", "Fatal Poison" and "Sleep"
Debuff "Decrease defense", "Decrease Non-Elemental Damage" and "Seal item"
* Decrease Non-Elemental Damage: Lowers non-element damage.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Shinigami Cloth" material required for production.
The "GoG Season 60 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on June 25 (Wed).
The "Wander Gear Q" and "Wander Cape Q" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on July 2 (Wed).
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 55 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 55 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Scythe" after maintenance on June 25 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Wander Gear P", "Wander Cape P", "Wander Brooch M", "Wander Mask M", and "Wander Shield M".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 60 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 60 reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Scythe" at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 60 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

-----------------------------
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 6th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Differences from the Previous Tournament
Changes will primarily consist of the following improvements and adjustments:
Match-end notifications will now appear in "New Notifications".
Fixed the continued damage from damage areas after matches end.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the May 21, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 28, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Blunt Element
Water Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 6th Squad Jumble."
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return."
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned
"Match Count Rewards", according to the number of battles participated in
Rewards exchanged at the Trader using gathered Squad Symbols
Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
A server list has been implemented, and players can now choose to transfer servers!
UPDATE
2025-05-28 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A server list has been implemented that can be used to see which servers are currently available.
In addition, players will be able to transfer to a specified server.
Please use this feature to gather with guild members or party members, or to form groups to take on the Underground Labyrinth.
Server transfers can be performed as follows:
Transfer from Server List
Go to Menu > System > Server Transfer to display the server list.
A green line will be displayed to the left of your current server.
The status to the right ("Normal," etc.) indicates the current population.
The number of servers that you can transfer to will change depending on the total number of players.
Tap your desired server in order to transfer to that server.
* Players cannot transfer to servers marked as "Full."
Transfer from Guild Member List
Go to Menu > Community > Guild > Member to display the list of guild members.
Tap the guild member you want to transfer to and select Change Servers.
* You cannot transfer servers if the selected guild member is offline.
Transfer to Party Leader's Server
Tap Move to Party Leader's Server from Party Settings to transfer to their server.
* You cannot transfer servers if the party leader is offline.
Transfer to a Follows or Follower's Server
Go to Menu > Community > Follows to see lists of players under the Follows or Followers tabs.
Tap the player you want to transfer to and select Contact > Change Servers
* "Change Servers" will not be shown will you are in a party.
* You cannot transfer servers if the selected player is offline.
Important
Players may be automatically moved to servers with normal populations when taking on dungeons or going to a Guild Room.
Go to Notice List

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Various inventory limits raised! Some items can now be owned up to 99,999, and Equipment, Ring, and Ingot inventory slots can all be increased at once through purchases at the Shop!
UPDATE
2025-05-28 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to "Sword Art Online Integral Factor."
The following updates have been implemented following the maintenance on May 28, 2025 (Wed).
Some Items Can Now Be Owned up to 99,999
Some items that could previously be owned up to 9,999 can now be owned up to 99,999.
* This does not apply to GoG Season Tickets and other special items, and their limit will remain 9,999.
With this change, the number of items owned when shown on an item icon will be displayed as "9,999+" when exceeding 9,999.
To see a more detailed number of items owned, please go to the item detail screen.
Expanded Equipment, Ring, and Ingot Inventory Limits
With this update, the previous "Ingot Expansion" product sold in the Shop has been upgraded to "Expand Equip./Ring/Ingot Inv."
Each purchase of Expand Equip./Ring/Ingot Inv. in the Shop will expand your Equipment, Ring, and Ingot limits by 20.
Furthermore, players who have bought Ingot Expansions prior to this update will also receive expanded Equipment and Ring inventories according to the number of purchases made.
No changes have been made to price.
The maximum number of purchases has also been increased from 10 to 15 with this update.
As each purchase increases inventory slots by 20, up to a maximum of 15 times, the maximum numbers of inventory slots for Equipment, Rings, and Ingots are as follows:
Default 100 slots + 300 slots with 15 purchases = 400 slots
There may be cases where purchasing "Expand Equip./Ring/Ingot Inv." displays as just "Ingot Expansion".
Please note that this product expands the storage for Equipment, Rings, and Ingots simultaneously.
Increase in Number of Purchasable Expand Equipment Sets
Expand Equipment Set can now be purchased up to 10 times in the Shop, increased from 6 times.
One Expand Equipment Set purchase expands your equipment set slots by 3.
Other Adjustments
Item and Skill Record icons now display detailed information on some screens.
Example: Skill Record icons on the Special Bonus list in an event dungeon, etc.
Please also check the following update details.
・
Notice about Chapter 2 Aincrad 44F, super rare Rex Integral Series weapon, and other updates!
・
Additional ring and EX Ability slots! Players can now equip two rings as well as two EX Abilities!
・
A server list has been implemented, and players can now choose to transfer servers!
We will continue to make modifications while considering the circumstances of our customers.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
Go to Notice List

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Additional ring and EX Ability slots! Players can now equip two rings as well as two EX Abilities!
UPDATE
2025-05-28 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Following the May 28, 2025 (Wed) maintenance, players can now equip two rings as well as two EX Abilities!
EX Ability effects will be activated when the corresponding ring is equipped.
* EX Ability 1's effects will activate when Ring 1 is equipped, and EX Ability 2's effects will activate when Ring 2 is equipped.
We are also holding the Ring Production Campaign until the June 11, 2025 (Wed) maintenance begins.
Don't let this chance pass you by!
Ring
Unlock Ring by completing the main quest on 50F of Aincrad.
This item can be produced, and it provides a Main Effect that increases natural Element damage, as well as up to two types of Random Bonuses, such as increased attack.
By equipping a ring, you will also be able to equip an Ability Skill Record as an EX Ability.
Koharu can also equip rings and EX Abilities. Assisting Characters cannot equip them.
EX Ability
To unlock the EX Ability equipment slot, equip a Ring.
Ability Skill Records can be equipped at no cost but will receive no stat increase. Only some skill effects are enabled.
Skill effects that are enabled as EX Ability are indicated with a green ● mark at the beginning of the skill's name.
More Ring Details Here

In "Guild of Guilds" Season 60, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 59 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the May 14, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 21, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 59, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 59 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from May 22 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 59 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Accompanying monsters have the same weapon elemental resistance and critical resistance as Viaio Cetus.
Break with Fire Element.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Thrust Element and Fire Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Break: Filling the entire Break Gauge will temporarily immobilize the boss and remove all of its buff effects.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
* Decrease Non-Elemental Damage: Lowers non-element damage.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 59 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 59 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 59 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 59 dungeons.
"GoG Season 59 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 59 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 59 dungeon's monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 59 Badge."

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 59!
EVENT
2025-05-14 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 59 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the May 14, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 21, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 59, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 59 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from May 22 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Limited-edition special avatars for Guild of Guilds are here!
"Cetus Shield C" and "Cetus Cape C" come with your guild icon.
"Cetus Helm C" is themed on the boss monster Viaio Cetus.

Arcana Gems
The higher your ranking, the more Arcana Gems you will receive as rewards.
All players ranked 101 and lower will receive the same amount of Arcana Gems.
Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 59 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Accompanying monsters have the same weapon elemental resistance and critical resistance as Viaio Cetus.
Break with Fire Element.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Thrust Element and Fire Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Stun", "Scorch" and "Debility"
Stack debuff "Decrease Attack", "Decrease Non-Elemental Damage" and "Seal item"
* Break: Filling the entire Break Gauge will temporarily immobilize the boss and remove all of its buff effects.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
* Decrease Non-Elemental Damage: Lowers non-element damage.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 59 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 59 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 59 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 59 dungeons.
"GoG Season 59 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 59 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 59 dungeon's monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 59 Badge."
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Viaio Cetus" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the May 21 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on October 8, 2025 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 59 Badges will be deleted on May 28, 2025 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 59th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-05-08 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 59th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 59 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the May 8, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the May 21, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the May 14, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 21, 2025 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 59 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Break with Fire Element.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Thrust Element and Fire Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
Weakness
Thrust Element
Fire Element
Resistance
Critical
Damage
Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Stun", "Scorch" and "Debility"
Stack debuff "Decrease Attack" and "Decrease Non-Elemental Damage"
* Break: Filling the entire Break Gauge will temporarily immobilize the boss and remove all of its buff effects.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Decrease Non-Elemental Damage: Lowers non-element damage.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Violent Whale Scale" material required for production.
The "GoG Season 59 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on May 21 (Wed).
The "Cetus Mask C" and "Cetus Arm Band C" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on May 28 (Wed).
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 54 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 54 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Cetus" after maintenance on May 21 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Cetus Mask B", "Cetus Arm Band B", "Cetus Shield B", "Cetus Helm B", and "Cetus Cape B".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 59 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Cetus" at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 59 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

Complete Main quest [The Indomitable Fang]

Details
This is a vicious monster with high HP, attack, and defense.
You can perform breaks.
When a Break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
In addition, it will receive a stack debuff that increases the damage it takes.
It will split up and merge during battle.
This boss will use a variety of buffs, debuffs, and status ailments to lure the player to their death.

"Groups"
You can take on "Fatal Battle Super (Group OK)" with a group of up to 18 members.
How to Join Groups
To create or join a group, talk to the Fatal Battle NPC and select Fatal Battle Super (Group OK), then choose "Challenge with a group (18)".
You will automatically move to the standby map.
You can display the standby member list from the action button on the bottom right of the screen.
When groups are formed, players who are not already in a party will be put into a party together and sent to the dungeon automatically.
If you would like to join a random group, we recommend using "Quick Group" to automatically join a group you can participate in.
While on the Fatal Battle group Waiting Room screen, players can check the number of members, view the weapons equipped to Set 1, and see the Group Total Power.
The "18" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
If you are in a party, only the party leader can create or join a Group.

Skill Break with Fire Element.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
[8/7 12:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] The 7th Squad Jumble Restart Schedule
EVENT
2025-08-07 12:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
[8/7 12:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]
The 7th Squad Jumble, which was paused temporarily on July 9, 2025 (Wed), will resume with the following schedule.
Period
Starts after the August 14, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the August 20, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
No changes have been made to the mechanics from July 9, 2025 (Wed).
Data such as battle records and obtained items will be carried over from before the pause.
The trader and limited-time items that had their time limits removed as a tentative fix will have appropriate time limits put back in place when Squad Jumble resumes.
Details will be made available again on the day the event resumes.
We sincerely apologize for taking so much time to fix the bugs.
We will do our best to continue making Squad Jumble and enjoyable experience.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
-----------------------------
[7/10 11:30 Update]
We have confirmed an issue that prevented battles from functioning properly in the 7th Squad Jumble, which began on 7/9/2025 (Wed). As a result, the event has temporarily suspended during the emergency maintenance held on the same day.
We will make an announcement when the event is scheduled to be reopened.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Groups
Defense Battle allows you to form groups of up to 12 players.
How to Join Groups
You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Defense Battle" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 61 has begun!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the July 16, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 24, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 61, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 61 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 61 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from July 25 (Fri) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 61 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Blunt Element skills
②1H Club skills
③Skills that are Blunt Element and Holy Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
