Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 61 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 61 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 61 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 61 dungeons.
"GoG Season 61 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 61 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 61 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 61 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 61 Badge."

news_list.snippet: Thank you for playing Sword Art Online: Integral Factor. The following updates were made during the maintenance scheduled on 7/24/2025 (Thu).  Custom Hair Color Adjustment Feature The previous "Hair" option in the Makeup screen, which allowed editing of hairstyle and hair color, has now been split i...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
Added custom Hair Color Adjustment Feature and a setting to adjust the number of buff/debuff icons displayed!
UPDATE
2025-07-24 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Thank you for playing Sword Art Online: Integral Factor.
The following updates were made during the maintenance scheduled on 7/24/2025 (Thu).
Custom Hair Color Adjustment Feature
The previous "Hair" option in the Makeup screen, which allowed editing of hairstyle and hair color, has now been split into two separate categories: "Hairstyle" and "Hair Color."
In the new Hair Color section, a list of preset hair colors is available for easy selection.
If you would like to further customize your look, you can fine-tune your chosen base color using the "Setting Details" button.
In the Setting Details you can set the base, shadow, and highlights.
You can use the sliders or manually input values for each RGB (Red, Green, Blue) component.
The ratio value is the ratio of shadow to base tint.
You can revert to the color before the Setting Details changes by pressing the reset button.
Additionally, some preset color palette samples were previously mismatched with the actual hair color in-game. These samples have now been corrected to accurately reflect your character's hair.
There is no change to your character's hair color.
Makeup Screen Improvements
To make it easier to experiment with your appearance freely, the Makeup screen has been improved so that you can now cancel changes and revert to your original appearance.
Changes can be canceled by tapping the "x" in the top right corner.
*On the previous Makeup screen, changes would take effect immediately upon selection.
Now edits will appear after pressing "Editing Complete" > "OK".
*You can access Makeup from "Menu" > "Status" > "Makeup".
Active Buff & Debuff Display Settings
You can now set the number of active buff and debuff icons displayed for both yourself and enemies.
You can access these settings via: "Menu" > "System" > "Settings" > "Setting Details" > "PC Display".
Adjust the number in increments of 10 with the slider. (Up to 100)
Default values are as follows:
Your Effect Display Limit: 20
Enemy Effect Display Limit: 10
We will continue to improve features to make your adventures in Aincrad even more enjoyable.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

Groups
Defense Battle allows you to form groups of up to 12 players.
How to Join Groups
You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Defense Battle" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
When the dungeon is finished, you can skip the monster hunt log wait time by tapping the screen.
After you clear a "Premium" difficulty dungeon once, you can't play it again until the limit resets at 4:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The "Purple Fenrir Plate" and "Navy Blue Fenrir Plate" item will be deleted on August 14, 2025 (Thu) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

news_list.name: Update to the Equipment Set saving system at maintenance on 7/24 (Thu)
news_list.snippet: Thank you for playing Sword Art Online: Integral Factor.  An update to how Equipment Set data is saved will be implemented following the maintenance scheduled for Thursday, July 24, 2025. This change will ensure that your precious Equipment Sets will now carry over even after a data transfer.  - Abo...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
Update to the Equipment Set saving system at maintenance on 7/24 (Thu)
IMPORTANT
2025-07-23 15:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Thank you for playing Sword Art Online: Integral Factor.
An update to how Equipment Set data is saved will be implemented following the maintenance scheduled for Thursday, July 24, 2025.
This change will ensure that your precious Equipment Sets will now carry over even after a data transfer.
- About Key Changes
Up until now, Equipment Set data was saved individually to the server only when actions were taken, such as registering a set or renaming it.
Because of this, any slots that weren't manually edited could sometimes be reset during a data transfer.
New System Following the 7/24 (Thu) Update
From now on, simply opening the Equipment Set list screen will automatically save all Equipment Set data to the server in one batch.
This eliminates the need for manual saving, making it easier and more reliable to retain your Equipment Set information.
- Date of Changes
Following maintenance on 7/24/2025 (Thur)
*Details about the maintenance time will be announced at a later date.
- [Important] A Request Following the Update
To apply the new saving system, we ask you to follow the steps below after maintenance has finished.
What to Do
Go to:
Menu > Player Equipment > Equipment Set
, and simply open the list screen.
Doing this will save all of your currently registered Equipment Sets under the new system, making them eligible for future data transfers.
*The number of unlocked Equipment Set slots will still carry over as usual.
We will continue to improve features to make your adventures in Aincrad even more enjoyable.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
Go to Notice List

Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the July 16, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 24, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 61, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 61 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.

Winning.

Groups
Defense Battle allows you to form groups of up to 12 players.
How to Join Groups
You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Defense Battle" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
When the dungeon is finished, you can skip the monster hunt log wait time by tapping the screen.
After you clear a "Premium" difficulty dungeon once, you can't play it again until the limit resets at 4:00 (JST/UTC+9).
The "Purple Fenrir Plate" and "Navy Blue Fenrir Plate" item will be deleted on August 14, 2025 (Thu) at 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

EVENT

（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 61st "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 61 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.

Notices
The Market and Bank have been added! Buy and sell equipment and items at the Market, and store your Col at the Bank!
UPDATE
2025-06-25 17:00:10
（JST/GMT+9）
The Market and the Bank were added as of the June 25, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
The Market
The "Market" is a convenient system that allows players to buy and sell items and equipment with Col.
You can list items for sale by setting a price and other players who want the item can then purchase it.
Likewise, if you find something you want in the Market, you can purchase it directly.
The Market can be accessed from the menu screen.
* This can only be used in safe areas where monsters do not appear, such as Teleport Gate Plaza.
How to Buy Items
① Start Your Search
To begin, tap "Buy Items" from the Market Menu. This opens a filter screen where you can set search conditions to find the item you want.
② Narrow Down the Results
To help you find a specific item, set the appropriate filters.
・Filter by Category
Tap the Category button of the item you are looking for and a list of items in that category will appear.
・Filter by Name
Enter part or all of the item name into the text field and tap the Search button. Items containing the entered text will be displayed.
③ Choose an Item to View Listings
From the list of search results, select your desired item and tap Confirm to view its Listings.
* For equipment, listings are divided by rarity, so please be aware when selecting.
* Items with zero active listings may still appear as candidates in the search results.
④ Select an Item to Purchase
Listings are sorted by price, starting from the lowest.
Items that you cannot purchase, due to insufficient Col or exceeding your inventory limit, will be shown at the bottom of the list.
ou can view detailed item information (such as equipment stats) on the right side of the screen.
* Items you have personally listed will not appear in your own results.
⑤Confirm Your Purchase
Tap "Buy" to spend Col and buy the selected item.
If the item has already been sold by the time you confirm, the purchase will not go through.
Check Your Transaction History
You can view Date & Time, Price, Unit Price, and Amount of previous successful purchases by tapping "Transaction History".
* Up to 20 of your most recent transactions will be displayed.
How to Sell Items
① Select "List Items for Sale"
Tap "List Items for Sale" from the Market Menu. This will display a list of items you currently have listed.
* While using the "List Items for Sale" screen, your current listings will be temporarily removed from visibility.
They will not appear to other players until you finish editing and re-list the items.
② To List a New Item
From the Listings screen, tap "New Listing".
③ Narrow Down the Item You Want to List
To help you find a specific item, set the appropriate filters.
・Filter by Category
Tap the Category button of the item you are looking for and a list of items in that category will appear.
・Filter by Name
Enter part or all of the item name into the text field and tap the Search button. Items containing the entered text will be displayed.
④ Select an Item to List
A list of eligible items will be displayed. Select the item you wish to list for sale.
The following items will not appear in the candidate list:
・Items not eligible for trading
・Items not currently in your inventory
・Items that have been locked
・Equipment with any attached ingots
・Equipment or rings that have been equipped at least once (starting from the Market's launch on 6/25/2025)
・Items currently equipped (including avatars, fishing bait, and gear equipped as of maintenance on 6/25/2025)
⑤ Set the Price and Amount
On the listing screen, enter the Item Price and Amount, then tap OK to add the item to your Listings.
* When the item is sold, a 10% fee will be automatically deducted from the listed price.
The number shown in parentheses reflects the actual amount of Col you will receive.
* Any decimal amounts after the fee is applied will be rounded down.
Please note that if you list an item for 1 Col, you will receive 0 Col due to the transaction fee.
* You can set an Amount of up to 100 items per listing.
* While listed, the item is removed from your storage and treated as being deposited into the Market.
⑥ Start Your Listing
Tap Open Listing in the bottom right of the screen to officially post the selected items to the Market.
Listings will still start even if you close the screen with the "×" button or the app closes unexpectedly.
* You can list up to 20 items at a time.
When You Sell an Item
When an item you've listed is sold, 90% of the set Price (after a 10% fee is deducted) will be sent to your "Bank".
The fee is automatically deducted at the time of purchase.
No fees are charged when starting a listing or canceling a listing.
To Cancel or Edit a Listing
・To Cancel a Listing
Tap "Return to Storage" for the item you want to cancel, then tap OK to remove it from the Listings.
* If returning the item will exceed your inventory limit, the item cannot be returned to storage.
・To Change the Listing Settings
If you want to change the unit price or amount of a listed item, you must first cancel the listing.
Follow the steps above to cancel the listing, then repeat steps ② to ⑥ under "How to Sell Items" to re-list the item with the new settings.
Listing Duration
Items will be listed for 168 hours.
If the item is not purchased within 168 hours, the listing will automatically expire, and the item will no longer be available to other players.
Even if a listing expires, the item will still appear in your Listings.
If you wish to cancel it completely, tap "Return to Storage" to remove it.
Every time you tap "Open Listing", the 168-hour listing timer will reset, starting a new duration from that moment.
About Sales History
Tap "Sales History" in the Market Menu to view how many of your listed items have been sold and track your sales performance.
Items not eligible for trading
Starting from the Market's release (after maintenance on 6/25/2025), equipment and rings that have been equipped even once will no longer be eligible for listing.
* Any equipment or rings that were equipped during the 6/25 maintenance will be treated as unequipped unless you re-equip them afterward.
In addition, the following items cannot be listed in the Market:
Skill Records
Items and avatars only available from the Shop via Orders, etc.
Avatars obtained from events
Limited time only items
Items to be used at the Trader
Buff items such as Incense
Stamp items
Material items for production
Guild of Guilds related items
Core Metal, Core Metal+++, Medals of Combat Arts , Medals of Unity
Various Hot Ores and Memoria Niters
Fish, Fishing Rods, etc.
Avatar Coins
Arcana Gems
Some exclusive items
Etc.
To view a complete list of tradeable items, check the item lists within each category of "Buy Items" in the Market.
Helpful Search Tips
When using the text search field, entering keywords like "Lux" or "Yasha" will display Integral Series items even if they don't include the series name in their item name.
You can use "AND" and "OR" as follows.
AND: Displays items that contain all entered keywords.
OR: Displays items that contain any of the entered keywords.
Bank
The Bank is a feature that allows you to deposit and withdraw Col.
Also, if another player buys an item you've put up for sale on the Market, the Col they pay will be sent to your Bank after a Market fee has been subtracted.
There is no fee for deposits and withdrawals.
How to Use
Open the Menu screen and tap Market to open the Market menu screen.
Tap Bank when on the Market menu screen to display the Bank screen.
* This can only be used in safe areas where monsters do not appear, such as Teleport Gate Plaza.
Depositing Col
Tap Deposit to display the amount input screen.
Input an amount of money and tap Deposit to deposit that amount of Col into the Bank.
* The input screen can be closed by tapping x.
Depositing the Maximum Amount of Col
Tap Deposit Max to immediately deposit all held Col into the Bank.
If you reach the Col deposit limit, the amount that brings you to that limit will be deposited.
Withdrawing Col
Tap Withdraw to display the amount input screen.
Input an amount of money and tap Withdraw to withdraw that amount of Col from the Bank.
* The input screen can be closed by tapping x.
Withdrawing the Maximum Amount of Col
Tap Withdraw Max to withdraw all of your deposited Col, up to the maximum amount that can be held.
If you would exceed the maximum amount that can be held, the amount of Col that will bring you to 99,999,999 Col held will be withdrawn.
Maximum Amounts
Maximum single deposit amount
99,999,999 Col
Maximum single withdrawal amount
99,999,999 Col - Col held
(The amount that would bring you to the maximum amount of Col that can be held)
Maximum deposit amount
999,999,999,999,999,999 Col
(If Col that exceeds this amount would be placed into your Bank from the Market, that Col will be discarded instead)
Important
Please be aware that we are unable to assist with disputes or issues that may arise between players through use of the Market.
The list of tradeable items may be subject to change in future updates.
Players who have not yet unlocked the Ring feature can now purchase rings from the Market.
While owning a ring, the Ring Menu will temporarily become accessible. However, rings cannot be equipped until the feature has been unlocked. You can only sell rings during this time.
* Unlock Ring by completing the main quest on 50F.

Notices
[9/26 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE] Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 63!
EVENT
2025-09-26 14:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
[9/26 14:00 (JST/UTC+9) UPDATE]
Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.
For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
Pick up period
Until February 11, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before September 26 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 64, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Viaio Cetus", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Thrust" and a natural elemental weakness to "Holy".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on October 8, 2025 (Wed).
Important
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 63 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the September 18, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 63, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 63 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from September 26 (Fri) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Avatar
Limited-edition special avatars for Guild of Guilds are here!
The "Terrifying Helm (Orange Blue)" is an accessory avatar visor that comes with an emote to open its big eye.
The "Terrifying Shield (Orange Blue)" has a large moving eye.
The "Gaze Shield (Orange Blue)" comes with a guild icon.

Arcana Gems
The higher your ranking, the more Arcana Gems you will receive as rewards.
All players ranked 101 and lower will receive the same amount of Arcana Gems.
Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 63 Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Water Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 63 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 63 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 63 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 63 dungeons.
"GoG Season 63 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 63 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 63 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 63 Badge".
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Terror Gaze" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the September 25 (Thu) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on February 11, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 63 Badges will be deleted on October 2, 2025 (Thu) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 63!
EVENT
2025-09-18 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 63 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the September 18, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 63, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 63 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from September 26 (Fri) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Limited-edition special avatars for Guild of Guilds are here!
The "Terrifying Helm (Orange Blue)" is an accessory avatar visor that comes with an emote to open its big eye.
The "Terrifying Shield (Orange Blue)" has a large moving eye.
The "Gaze Shield (Orange Blue)" comes with a guild icon.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 63 Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Water Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 63 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 63 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 63 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 63 dungeons.
"GoG Season 63 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 63 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 63 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 63 Badge".
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!

The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 63 is shared between all guild members.

Campaign Duration
Starts after the September 18, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the October 8, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Ring
A Ring is a piece of equipment that is different from armor.
Unlock Ring by completing the main quest on 50F of Aincrad.
This item can be produced, and it provides a Main Effect that increases natural Element damage, as well as up to two types of Random Bonuses, such as increased attack.
By equipping a ring, you will also be able to equip an Ability Skill Record as an EX Ability.
Up to two rings can be equipped, and an EX Ability can be equipped to each.
Koharu can also equip rings and EX Abilities. Assisting Characters cannot equip them.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 8th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2025-09-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 8th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the September 10, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 18, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Slash Element
Dark Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 8th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 63rd "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-09-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 63rd "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 63 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the September 10, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the September 18, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the September 25, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.

When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Water Element.

Period

About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 62, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 62 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.

Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.

Notices
A sort feature for Equipment Sets has been added!
UPDATE
2025-08-27 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Thank you for playing Sword Art Online: Integral Factor.
A sort feature for Equipment Sets was added as of the August 27, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
The feature can be used as follows:
1. Open the Equipment Sets screen
Menu → Status → Player Equipment → Equipment Set to open the screen.
2. Set the Sort button to ON
Press the following button to allow the Equipment Sets list to be sorted.
Note: The message "Aligning Equipment Set" will appear.
3. Select an Equipment Set
Select the Equipment Set you would like to move.
4. Sort the Equipment Set
Use the "Up" and "Down" buttons to move each set.
5. Set the Sort button to OFF
Press the following button again to finalize your changes.
With the addition of this feature, the following changes have been made to Equipment Sets.
All Equipment Set data is now managed on the server.
This negates the need for individual saves as in the previous system.
Numbers have been removed from the default Equipment Set names.
Check the on-screen description for Equipment Set numbers and quantities.

compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 62 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 62 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from August 28 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 62 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 62 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 62 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 62 dungeons.
"GoG Season 62 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 62 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 62 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 62 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.

Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Medusa" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 62 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 62 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 62 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the August 27 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on January 15, 2026 (Thu) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 62 Badges will be deleted on September 3 2025 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).

Fishing Ranking Event "2025 Midsummer Fishing Competition" is on now.
In the "2025 Midsummer Fishing Competition", you fight for the best rank based on your catch scores.
The Poyon Fish, Rabbit Fish, Gear Fish, and Honey Fish were selected from user submissions and appear on this Event Map!
Catch them to get a
high score
!
Event Period
Event Maps "Beach" and "On Board" Period: Starts after the August 6, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 27, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Ranking Period: Starts after the August 6, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 14, 2025 (Thu) maintenance.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > 2025 Midsummer Fishing Competition ranking banner.
Rewards
Place at the top of the rankings to get limited-edition Fishing Competition records, rare fishing bait, and
Memoria Niter L
, a Skill Record Limit Break material, as a present!
Exchange for up to 1,000
Arcana Gems
, up to 15
Medals of Combat Arts
, as well as other items such as
Core Metals
and Release Crystals at the 2025 Midsummer Fish Trader.
Each fish likes different bait.
Try different things and challenge the event.
2025 Midsummer Fish Trader Period
Starts after the August 6, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the September 3, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Record
You will also be able to receive a record via achievement rewards by finishing in the top ranking.

Event Locations
There are 8 locations in total, with day and night versions of the Event Maps "Beach" and "On Board", and day and night versions of Serene Shore and Peaceful Forest Path on 22F.
Head to the day beach by talking to the "Beach Guide" NPC at the Teleport Gate Plaza.
Move to the night beach by talking to the "Night Map Guide" NPC at the day beach.
Move on board the boat by talking to the "Boarding Guide" NPC at the beach.
Go to the "Serene Shore" or "Peaceful Forest Path" on the 22F by talking to "Nishida" in the "Teleport Gate Plaza".
Talk to the "Night Map Guide" NPC on the "Serene Shore" to go to the night map.

Notices
[Returning Event] Seize victory in a four-team face-off battle! The 7th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2025-08-14 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The 7th Squad Jumble, which was paused temporarily on July 9, 2025 (Wed) to deal with bugs, has resumed.
Data such as battle records and obtained items have been carried over.
No changes have been made to battle content from July 9, 2025 (Wed).
Also, the use period for the Trader and the deletion deadline for Squad Symbols has been reset to coincide with the new schedule.
Please check this notification for more details.
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the August 14, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the August 20, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Thrust Element
Fire Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 7th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

* Rank will not be lowered by a decrease in Rank Points.
Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned

Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 62nd "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-08-14 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 62nd "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Guild Arm Band (Red White)
Accessory Avatar
Snake's Shield (Red White)
Shield avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Medusa Shield (Red White)
Shield avatar
Snake Queen's Hair (Red White)
Accessory Avatar
Snakeskin Guild Cape (Red White)
Accessory Avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 62 Ticket."
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the August 14, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the August 27, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the August 20, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the August 27, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 62 Boss Monster
Medusa
Details
Only the following 2 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Fire Element skills
②Skills that are Slash Element and Fire Element
When Medusa is preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gets four stack buffs.
The time it is immobilized for after a Skill Break is long.
Weakness
Slash Element
Fire Element
Resistance
Critical
Damage
Buffs used
Stack Buff "Reduces damage", "Increase Attack", "Increase Defense" and "Critical resistance"
Status Ailments and Debuffs used
Status ailments "Petrify" and "Scorch"
Debuff "Decrease Defense" and "Decrease Non-Elemental Damage"
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments," please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments."
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
Production Avatars will be displayed in the production list when you have the "Snake Queen's Red Stone" material required for production.
The "GoG Season 62 Tickets" will be deleted during maintenance on August 27 (Wed).
The "Guild Arm Band (Red White)" and "Snake's Shield (Red White)" Avatars will no longer be displayed on the production list after maintenance on September 3 (Wed).
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 57 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 57 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Medusa" after maintenance on August 27 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Guild Arm Band (Blue Orange)", "Snake's Shield (Blue Orange)", "Medusa Shield (Blue Orange)", "Snake Queen's Hair (Blue Orange)", and "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Blue Orange)".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 62 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 62 reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Medusa" at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 62 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
