news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 65th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-11-06 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 65th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 65 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the November 6, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the November 19, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the November 12, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 19, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 65 Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes its elemental weakness to Holy.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.

Groups
Defense Battle allows you to form groups of up to 12 players.
How to Join Groups
You can create and join a group by talking to the NPC "Defense Battle" and selecting the difficulty level and "Challenge with a group (12)".
The "12" on the button indicates the maximum number of group members.
When you create or join a group, you will move to the Standby Map.
Display the Standby Member List by tapping the action button at the bottom right of the Standby Map.
Once the group is formed, you will automatically be moved from the Standby Map to the dungeon.
If you have a party, only the party leader will be able to create or join a group.
Players who aren't in a party will be automatically joined together to form one when making a group.
For players looking to easily jump into a group, we recommend a "Quick Group".
"Quick Group" will automatically add you into a group that is in need of members.
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
When the dungeon is finished, you can skip the monster hunt log wait time by tapping the screen.
After you clear a "Premium" difficulty dungeon once, you can't play it again until the limit resets at 4:00 (JST/UTC+9).

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 9th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2025-10-22 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 9th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Differences from the Previous Tournament
Changes will primarily consist of the following improvements and adjustments:
Fixed an issue where Quick Change could no longer be used after being defeated during Quick Change cool time and switching to Watch mode
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the October 22, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the October 29, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Blunt Element
Dark Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 9th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks

Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement

Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Period

About the Ranking Event

.

.

* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.

Ranking Reward

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 64 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the October 16, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the October 22, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 64, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 64 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 64 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from October 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.

You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Viaio Cetus" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 64 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 64 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 64 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the October 22 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on March 11, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 64 Badges will be deleted on October 29, 2025 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Details
Since this is a field with unusable items, some items cannot be used.
The beginning of battle, it uses a "Critical resistance" buff.
It has a resistense that make it less susceptible to attacks with the Poison and Frostbite status ailments.
You can break it with 1H Sword skills.
Once a Break happens, the Break requirements change to Dagger skills.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Slash Element and Wind Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a buff that "Reduce Damage".
Once a Break or Skill Break is performed, the damage it takes increases depending on the monster's status ailment (Poison, Burn, Bleed, Frostbite) stacks.
When its HP falls beneath a certain amount, it will use the Chaos Recollection buff.
Some attacks will remove buffs from the players.

Carry over your hard work in SAOVS to pave the way to success in the world of SAOIF!

How to Participate
- Linking from SAOVS
1. On the home screen, open Menu, then press the Settings button.
2. On the settings screen, press the Account tab.
3. Press the Account Transfer button to link to your Bandai Namco ID.
See the official SAOVS website for more details.
https://vs.sao-game.jp/en/news04ghtl/
* Please link your Bandai Namco ID while online service is still underway (until October 30, 2025, 13:00 (JST/UTC+9)). Once service for SAOVS ends (after October 30, 2025, 13:00 (JST/UTC+9)), you will be unable to make a new link to your Bandai Namco ID.
- Linking from SAOIF
1. Press the SAOVS icon located in the bottom-right of the title screen.
2. A screen asking for your consent to look up your account status for SAOVS will appear. If you consent, press Agree.
3. Enter your Bandai Namco ID and password on the login screen, then press Log In.
4. If an age verification screen appears, enter your date of birth and press Next.
5. If a screen asking you to review and agree to the terms appears, review the contents, and if you agree, check the Agree to the above and register box, then press Agree.
6. Your account status in SAOVS will then be referenced, and if the link to your Bandai Namco ID is confirmed, you will receive your reward items.
* You will not be able to receive your rewards if you have not completed linking your account in SAOVS. Try again from Step 1 once you have finished linking your account in SAOVS.
Important Notes
- You can only take part in this campaign once per account.
If you have already participated, the SAOVS icon will not appear on the title screen.
- The items you receive are based upon your progress at the time you participate in the campaign.
Progressing further in the game after taking part in the campaign will not grant any new rewards.
- You cannot link while game maintenance is underway in SAOIF or SAOVS.
For maintenance details, please check the official profiles (SAOIF:
@saoif_gameinfo
, SAOVS:
@SAOVS_WW
)
- Bandai Namco IDs used in the campaign cannot be used to transfer in SAOIF.
To transfer your SAOIF account, press the Menu button in the upper-left corner of the title screen. Then, press Transfer followed by Transfer Registration.
* Please be aware that this campaign may change or end without prior notice.
We hope you continue to enjoy Sword Art Online Integral Factor.

Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 64 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.

Notices

account linking campaign is now underway!
Campaign
2025-10-02 18:00:01
（JST/GMT+9）
Notice for those users logging on to Sword Art Online Integral Factor (SAOIF):
Link your Sword Art Online Variant Showdown (SAOVS) account to your SAOIF account to receive amazing gifts based on your progress in SAOVS!
In addition to up to 2,500 Arcana Gems needed to purchase things like Skill Records and Avatar Orders, you can obtain not just EXP items that instantly boost your level from 1 to 78, but also handy gameplay items for healing or upgrading Skill Records, not to mention lots of Col, the in-game currency!
Carry over your hard work in SAOVS to pave the way to success in the world of SAOIF!
■Campaign Duration
- Starts after the October 2, 2025 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the November 28, 2025 (Fri) maintenance
■Reward Items
▼XR: 20-100, or player Lv.: 10-100
- 2,500 Arcana Gems
- Exp Crystal S x 500
- Revive Crystal x 100
- Restorative Potion x 500
- Record Frame L x 300
- Saleable Col Bag x 50 (5M Col total)
▼XR: 5-19, or player Lv.: 5-9
- 1,250 Arcana Gems
- Exp Crystal S x 400
- Revive Crystal x 100
- Restorative Potion x 400
- Record Frame L x 200
- Saleable Col Bag x 25 (2.5M Col total)
▼XR: 1-4, or player Lv.: 1-4
- 500 Arcana Gems
- Exp Crystal S x 300
- Revive Crystal x 100
- Restorative Potion x 300
- Record Frame L x 100
- Saleable Col Bag x 10 (1M Col total)
How to Participate
- Linking from SAOVS
1. On the home screen, open Menu, then press the Settings button.
2. On the settings screen, press the Account tab.
3. Press the Account Transfer button to link to your Bandai Namco ID.
See the official SAOVS website for more details.
https://vs.sao-game.jp/en/news04ghtl/
* Please link your Bandai Namco ID while online service is still underway (until October 30, 2025, 13:00 (JST/UTC+9)). Once service for SAOVS ends (after October 30, 2025, 13:00 (JST/UTC+9)), you will be unable to make a new link to your Bandai Namco ID.
- Linking from SAOIF
1. Press the SAOVS icon located in the bottom-right of the title screen.
2. A screen asking for your consent to look up your account status for SAOVS will appear. If you consent, press Agree.
3. Enter your Bandai Namco ID and password on the login screen, then press Log In.
4. If an age verification screen appears, enter your date of birth and press Next.
5. If a screen asking you to review and agree to the terms appears, review the contents, and if you agree, check the Agree to the above and register box, then press Agree.
6. Your account status in SAOVS will then be referenced, and if the link to your Bandai Namco ID is confirmed, you will receive your reward items.
* You will not be able to receive your rewards if you have not completed linking your account in SAOVS. Try again from Step 1 once you have finished linking your account in SAOVS.
Important Notes
- You can only take part in this campaign once per account.
If you have already participated, the SAOVS icon will not appear on the title screen.
- The items you receive are based upon your progress at the time you participate in the campaign.
Progressing further in the game after taking part in the campaign will not grant any new rewards.
- You cannot link while game maintenance is underway in SAOIF or SAOVS.
For maintenance details, please check the official profiles (SAOIF:
@saoif_gameinfo
, SAOVS:
@SAOVS_WW
)
- Bandai Namco IDs used in the campaign cannot be used to transfer in SAOIF.
To transfer your SAOIF account, press the Menu button in the upper-left corner of the title screen. Then, press Transfer followed by Transfer Registration.
* Please be aware that this campaign may change or end without prior notice.
We hope you continue to enjoy Sword Art Online Integral Factor.

Damage to the torso is especially reduced.

①Skills that are Thrust Element and Holy Element
②2H Spear skills
③Bow skills

All skill breakable attacks can only reduce the Skill Break gauge when attacking the head.
Some attacks will reduce the Awakening gauge.
Some attacks will remove buffs from the players.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 66!
EVENT
2025-12-17 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 66 has begun!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the December 17, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 24, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 66, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 66 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 66 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from December 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 66 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust Element skills
②2H Spear skills
③Skills that are Thrust Element and Dark Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

Debuff "Decrease Non-Elemental Damage" and "Seal item"
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* The percentage increase in damage from skills such as Poison Boost will not be applied to the increased percentage of damage dealt by status ailments.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 66 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 66 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 66 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 66 dungeons.
"GoG Season 66 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 66 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 66 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 66 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 66th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2025-12-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 66th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Devil Mask Q
Accessory Avatar
Devil Tail Q
Accessory Avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Devil Shield O
Shield avatar
Devil Helm Q
Accessory Avatar
Devil Cape Q
Accessory Avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 66 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the December 10, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 24, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the December 17, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the December 24, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 66 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
With the use of a specific attack, it will begin to gradually recover HP for 10 min and gain 2 buffs.
This recovery effect cannot be removed until time runs out.
Only the following 3 types of Sword Skills can reduce the Skill Break gauge.
①Thrust Element skills
②2H Spear skills
③Skills that are Thrust Element and Dark Element
When it's preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains 2 buffs and removes its status ailments.
Although resistances will hinder many status ailment attacks, successful attacks will deal a significantly higher percentage of status ailment damage.

Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
There are no first or last attack bonuses on any difficulty.
The "Guild of Guilds" Preseason 61 Production Avatars and the "Guild of Guilds" Season 61 ranking reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Demon" after maintenance on December 24 (Wed).
Affected Items: "Devil Mask P", "Devil Tail P", "Devil Shield N", "Devil Helm P", and "Devil Cape P".
"Guild of Guilds" Preseason 66 Production Avatars and "Guild of Guilds" Season 66 reward Avatars will be added to the "Medal of Unity Trader Demon" at a later date.
It will be impossible to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the "Guild of Guilds" Season 66 ranking period, regardless of whether or not that guild is participating in the event.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
While guild members are in a Guild of Guilds dungeon, no other Guild event dungeons or Guild of Guilds dungeons can be attempted.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The Moment You Sync, the Battle Evolves!  Introducing 《Link Skills》!
UPDATE
2025-11-28 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The moment you sync, the battle evolves.
A new era of synchronization begins with
《Link Skill》
!
《Link Skill》 are a new type of skill that transforms the actions of you and your allies into pure power!
A new combat skill that grows stronger in Link State
Equip a Link Sword Skill or Link Ability, then press the dedicated Link Button to activate 《Link State》.
While in Link State, performing actions in battle raises your Link Level, gradually enhancing the following abilities:
・Attack
・Defense
・Critical Rate
・Damage amount of Link Sword Skills
Link Level increases when you attack with a Link Sword Skill, use a Switch, activate party buffs, and perform other qualifying actions.
Reaching certain Link Levels will also unlock unique effects based on each Skill Record, allowing for additional enhancements tailored to your playstyle.
Greater power through teamwork
When your party members overlap states such as Awakening, Accele, Full Burst, Chain, or Link, a new state, Skill Link State, is activated.
While in this state, the power of the corresponding skills increases, and when combined with the enhanced stats of Link State, you can unleash even greater firepower.
And if both you and your allies are in Link State and successfully perform a Switch using a Link Sword Skill together...
The ultimate 《Switch Link》 can be unleashed!
This powerful action, unique to 《Link Skill》, occurs the moment synchronization clicks into place.
About the detailed specifications
The following section explains the full mechanics of Link Skills in detail.
About Link State
1. Activating Link State
By pressing the Link Button, which appears when a Link Skill is equipped, you can enter Link State.
If Koharu or an Assisting Character also has a Link Skill equipped, they will enter Link State automatically when the player activates it.
*If you only have Link Sword Skills equipped that do not match your current weapon type, the Link Button cannot be used.
2. Link Level and Its Effects
While in Link State, various effects are enhanced step by step according to your Link Level.
*Koharu and Assist Characters each have their own individual Link Level.

*If a Link Sword Skill is included within a MOD setup, it will be treated strictly as a MOD Skill and will not gain these effects.
You can check the details of each effect by pressing the Link Skill Info button in Menu > Status > Player Equipment, then opening the Link Status tab.

・Individual Link Skill effects will activate at certain Link Levels
Each Skill Record activates its own unique effect.
For details, please refer to the description of each Skill Record.
*“LLv” in descriptions is an abbreviation for Link Level.
You can also check the detailed effects by pressing the Link Skill Info button in Menu > Status > Player Equipment, then opening the Equipped Link Skills tab.
3. How to Increase Link Level
Link Level increases through specific actions in battle, such as attacking with Link Sword Skills, performing a Switch, or using party buffs.

*Equipped Link Sword Skills must match your current weapon type.
5. Link State Duration
Base duration is 60 seconds.
Each equipped Link Ability extends the duration by +7.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 90 seconds.
*Koharu and Assisting Characters each have their own individual Link State duration.
6. Link State will end under the following conditions:
The effect duration expires
You change areas
You perform a Quick Change
You open the menu screen
Your character is defeated
7. After Link State Ends
After Link State ends, a cooldown is applied, during which you cannot use the Link Button.
This cooldown continues even while logged out, and the timer will keep progressing until Link can be used again.
About Skilll Link State
When you are in Link State, you can gain additional bonuses by entering certain states together with your Link Targets.
1. What Is a Link Target?
When you enter Link State, any party members in the same area become your Link Targets.
If those party members also enter Link State, you become their Link Target as well.
2. About Skill Link
When you are in Link State and both you and your Link Target enter specific states (such as Awakening, Accele, Full Burst, Chain, or Link) you will trigger Skill Link State.
While in this state, the power of the corresponding skills increases.
When Skill Link State activates, a ring will appear around both characters, indicating which Skill Link State is active
*Multiple states can be active at the same time. The ring color will change accordingly.
In addition, the icons above the Link Button, which indicate which Skill Link states are currently active, will light up.

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 65 has begun!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the November 12, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 19, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 65, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 65 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 65 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from November 20 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 10th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2025-11-19 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 10th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Differences from the Previous Tournament
Changes will primarily consist of the following improvements and adjustments:
Added "Battle History" to enable viewing of individual battle histories from past tournaments
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the November 19, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 28, 2025 (Fri) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Thrust Element
Holy Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 10th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 65!
EVENT
2025-11-12 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 65 has begun!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the November 12, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the November 19, 2025 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 65, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 65 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 65 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from November 20 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

All players ranked 101 and lower will receive the same amount of Arcana Gems.
Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 65 Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes its elemental weakness to Holy.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff on Extreme difficulty.

For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 65 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 65 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 65 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 65 dungeons.
"GoG Season 65 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 65 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 65 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 65 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 65 Badge".
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Wander Fatal Scythe" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 65 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 65 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 65 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the November 19 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on April 8, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 65 Badges will be deleted on November 28, 2025 (Fri) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

Ring
A Ring is a piece of equipment that is different from armor.
Unlock Ring by completing the main quest on 50F of Aincrad.
This item can be produced, and it provides a Main Effect that increases natural Element damage, as well as up to two types of Random Bonuses, such as increased attack.
By equipping a ring, you will also be able to equip an Ability Skill Record as an EX Ability.
Up to two rings can be equipped, and an EX Ability can be equipped to each.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 68th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-02-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 68th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 68 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the February 10, 2026 (Tue) maintenance and ends before the February 25, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the February 18, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 25, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 68 Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Dark Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Some attacks will remove buffs from the players.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
January 28, 2026 (Wed) update information! Login notifications, Daily Mission updates and many other useful functions have been added!
UPDATE
2026-01-28 17:00:01
（JST/GMT+9）
Thank you for playing Sword Art Online Integral Factor.
The following updates have been implemented following the maintenance on January 28, 2026 (Wed).
Settings for login notifications for Guild Members and Mutually Following
By turning on the login notification function, you will be notified when guild members and mutual followers log in.
*You can turn notifications on and off, including login notifications from you to others in the settings.
When a notification arrives, an icon and the player's name will be displayed.
You can check the notification history by pressing the notification icon and clicking You have a login notification.
Selecting a player's name in the history will display the contact menu.
If you log out and then log back in within one minute, a notification will not be made.
*If a server transfer takes time, a notification of being logged in might be sent.
▼Settings
On the settings screen, "Notifications" has been added.
Menu > System > Settings > Setting Details > Notifications
You can configure detailed settings for login notifications here.
Also, you can also access this settings screen from the login notification list screen.
Select "Receive login notifications" to receive notifications of other players.
"Notify login" is a setting that notifies other players when you log in.
Due to the increase in settings, the "Display" and "Sound" settings have been moved to the second page.
You can move to the second page by pressing ▼Next on the settings screen.
You can move back to the first page by pressing ▲Prev on the second page.
Settings for login display for Guild Members and Mutually Following
"Player information and notification recipients settings" has been added to "Notifications" on the settings screen.
You can now configure what information will be displayed to other players on the Guild Member and the Mutually Following list screens.
For example, if you want to display server and area information only on the Guild Member list screen, turn on "Guild Member" under "Server Information" and "Area Information".
Shortcut function from the Daily Mission screen
A function has been added that allows you to challenge each Daily Mission directly from the "Details" screen.
*This does not include from "Start game".
Daily Mission
Button
Content
Clear Daily Dungeon
Challenge
A list of Daily Dungeons will be displayed.
You can select a dungeon to take on from there.
*After clearing, you will be moved to the "Daily Dungeon" NPC.
Interact with Assisting Character
Interact
The Assisting Character selection screen will be displayed.
Clear Raising Dungeon
Challenge
A list of open Raising Dungeons will be displayed.
You can select a dungeon to take on from there.
*After clearing, you will be moved to the Teleport Gate Plaza.
Clear Labyrinth Dungeon or Chaos Showdown
Challenge a Labyrinth
If you have not completed the 13F Main Quest, you will be taken to the Teleport Gate Plaza, and a list of teleport destinations will appear.
If you have completed the 13F Main Quest, the Integral Series dungeon list will appear.
Challenge the Chaos Showdown
A list of ongoing Chaos Showdowns will be displayed.
You can select a dungeon to take on from there.
*After clearing, you will be moved to the "Chaos Showdown" NPC.
*This button will only appear after clearing the 10F Main Quest, which is a requirement for the Chaos Showdown.
Added a new notification, "Challenge Daily Missions", to the New Notifications list.
Additionally, "Achieved the Daily Mission" will now be displayed when you complete a Daily Mission.
Tapping either of these will open the Daily Missions list screen.
We will continue to improve features to make your adventures in Aincrad even more enjoyable.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 12th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2026-01-28 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 12th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the January 28, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 4, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Blunt Element
Dark Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 12th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

EVENT
