（JST/GMT+9）
[1/22 18:15 (JST/UTC+9) Update]
We have corrected an error in the attack types listed as Skill Break–able in the "Details" section for certain target monsters.
This was a display-only issue, and there have been no changes to the monsters' actual behavior or settings.
-------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 67 has begun!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the January 21, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 28, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 67, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 67 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 67 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from January 29 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

The "Medusa Shield (Pink Green)" and "Snakeskin Guild Cape (Pink Green)" are marked with your guild's icon.
"Snake Queen's Hair (Pink Green)" is themed on the boss monster Medusa and has hair that sways back and forth when you move.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 67 Boss Monster
Medusa

* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 67 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 67 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 67 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 67 dungeons.
"GoG Season 67 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 67 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 67 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 67 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 67 Badge".
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Medusa" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 67 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 67 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 67 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.

SAOIF x That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Collab Event: "That Time I Got Teleported to SAO" is here!
After a certain incident, the characters from That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime are transported to the world of SAOIF!
Separated from the rest of the party, Rimuru encounters Kirito, Koharu, and eventually you—
Series favorites like Rimuru, Benimaru, Shuna, Shion, Milim, and Diablo team up with SAOIF characters in this exciting adventure!
To accompany this event, we have a supersized story, transformation items: "Slime Gummy" and limited-edition Skill Records, Stamps, and a variety of premium rewards!
Also, you can get the sword Rimuru uses in SAOIF as an avatar!
Additionally, after the January 15, 2026 (Thu)  maintenance, there's five side scenario quests, stamp rewards, and other goodies to look forward to!
* More details to follow after the maintenance on January 15, 2026 (Thu).

Transformation buff effect time ends.
The player moves between areas (including entering/exiting dungeons, etc.).

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 67th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-01-15 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 67th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 67 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the January 15, 2026 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the January 28, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the January 21, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 28, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.

Fixed an issue where the Squad Jumble "Watch" feature could not be disabled until the battle ended

Adjusted Koharu's behavior as she she sits down in a chair

compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 66 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 66 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from December 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 11th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2025-12-24 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 11th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the December 24, 2025 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the January 7, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Slash Element
Wind Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 11th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
We have confirmed an issue where "Watch" feature cannot be disabled until the battle ends.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned
"Match Count Rewards", according to the number of battles participated in
Rewards exchanged at the Trader using gathered Squad Symbols
Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.
For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
Pick up period
Until August 12, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before March 26 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 70, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Wander Fatal Scythe", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Slash" and a natural elemental weakness to "Holy" and "Dark".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on April 8, 2026 (Wed).
Important
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 69 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the March 18, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 25, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 69, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 69 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 69 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from March 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 69 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Accompanying monsters have the same weapon elemental resistance and critical resistance as Viaio Cetus.
Break with Blunt Element.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Earth Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes its elemental weakness to Holy.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 69 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 69 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 69 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 69 dungeons.
"GoG Season 69 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 69 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 69 dungeon's monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 69 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 69 Badge".

You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 69!
EVENT
2026-03-18 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 69 has begun!
Take on the Viaio Cetus during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the March 18, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 25, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 69, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 69 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 69 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from March 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.
Record Acquisition

Revive Crystal×1

Limited-edition special avatars for Guild of Guilds are here!
"Cetus Shield E" and "Cetus Cape E" come with your guild icon.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 69 Boss Monster
Viaio Cetus
Details
For every accompanying monster that appears, a stack buff that increases attack will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".
Accompanying monsters have the same weapon elemental resistance and critical resistance as Viaio Cetus.
Break with Blunt Element.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Earth Element.
With each Break or Skill Break, it will be weakened by a stack debuff that increases damage dealt from players.
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes its elemental weakness to Holy.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

* Break: Filling the entire Break Gauge will temporarily immobilize the boss and remove all of its buff effects.
* Skill Break: By completely lowering the Skill Break Gauge, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all of its buff effects will be removed.
* Chaos Recollection: A powerful aura that surrounds the body and reduces damage. (Awakening is effective.)
For details on the effects of "Status Ailments", please check in-game via "Menu" > "System" > "Help" > "Buff, Debuff, and Status Ailments".
Alternatively, please refer to the
"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 69 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 69 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 69 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 69 dungeons.
"GoG Season 69 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 69 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 69 dungeon's monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 69 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.

Notices
The 69th "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-03-11 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 69th "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 69 Ticket".

For every accompanying monster that you defeat, stacks are decreased for the buff that increases attack, and a stack debuff that increases damage taken will be added to "Viaio Cetus".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 13th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2026-03-04 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 13th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Differences from the Previous Tournament
Changes will primarily consist of the following improvements and adjustments:
Increased the expansion range of the damage area over time.
Adjusted the battle so that after 600 seconds have elapsed, the entire field will be covered by the damage area.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the March 4, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the March 11, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Thrust Element
Fire Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 13th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
After 600 seconds from the start of battle, the entire field will be covered by the damage area.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks

Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Spectating Mode
Talk to the "Event Staff" NPC. "Check the Spectator Dungeon list" will be at the top of the list.
Tap "Check the Spectator Dungeon list" to view a list of battles you can spectate.
Select a battle to spectate, then choose either Watch normally or Watch with VR.
* Up to 15 players can spectate a battle. Battles that have reached this limit will no longer be displayed on the list.
* Spectating players cannot attack monsters.
* Spectators will not be displayed on the screen of the player fighting the battle.
- Watch normally
"Spectators" will appear above the spectators' heads instead of their player names.
Use the Exit to stop spectating mid-battle.
- Watch with VR
Starts VR mode. This lets you spectate the battle in virtual reality using smartphone VR goggles.
Please make sure your smartphone is held horizontally with the bottom of the phone pointing to the right.
See the notice below for more details on using VR mode.

Tap the X button in the upper left corner to exit VR mode when spectating.

* VR goggles with binocular lenses are required.
* Please exit VR mode at once if you begin to develop a headache, feel sick, or become tired.

The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.

The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before February 26 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 69, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Viaio Cetus", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Blunt" and a natural elemental weakness to "Wind" and "Earth".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on March 11, 2026 (Wed).

The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 68 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the February 18, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 25, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 68, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 68 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 68 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from February 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

The "Terrifying Helm (Purple Yellow)" is an accessory avatar visor that comes with an emote to open its big eye.
The "Terrifying Shield (Purple Yellow)" has a large moving eye.
The "Gaze Shield (Purple Yellow)" comes with a guild icon.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 68 Boss Monster
Terror Gaze
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Dark Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Some attacks will remove buffs from the players.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 68 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 68 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 68 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 68 dungeons.
"GoG Season 68 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 68 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 68 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 68 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* This tournament's item will be named "GoG Season 68 Badge".
GoG Season Badges can be exchanged for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Terror Gaze" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 68 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 68 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 68 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.

Improvements to Ingot Controls   Added Filter Search Function for Ingots On the screen displaying the Ingot list, you can now filter results in a...
news_list.full_details:
Notices
Various convenient features have been added, including improvements to Ingot controls and a new eye color customization feature!
UPDATE
2026-02-25 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Thank you for playing Sword Art Online Integral Factor.
The following updates have been implemented following the maintenance on February 25, 2026 (Wed).
Improvements to Ingot Controls
Added Filter Search Function for Ingots
On the screen displaying the Ingot list, you can now filter results in addition to sorting.
① Enter a keyword and press the "Apply" button to filter the list.
② To filter by effect category, activate the icons displayed under “Battle” or "Support" to narrow down Ingots more precisely.
*This will be implemented for the Composite screen at a later date.
Added Transition from Completed Ingot Production to the Composite Screen
After producing an Ingot, you can now press “OK” on the completion screen to proceed directly to the Composite screen
Added Lock/Unlock Function from the Composite Screen
By pressing and holding an Ingot displayed as material on the Composite screen, you can now view its effect details and use the newly added button to lock or unlock it.
Before composing, you can unlock Ingots you wish to use as materials, or lock them to prevent accidental use.
Added New Lineup to "Appraisal"
ew high-performance Ingots as well as existing Boss Ingots have been added to "Appraisal".
For details, please check "Appraisal" in the Shop.
The lineup for the "Up to 220! Free Appraisal Campaign", currently available until March 1, 2026 (Sun) at 3:59 (JST/UTC+9), will remain unchanged.
Free Eye Color Adjustment Feature
The "Face" category previously edited in the Makeup screen has been divided into "Facial Features" and "Eye Color".
Facial Features now allows selection of face shape only, while eye color can be adjusted under the new "Eye Color" category.
Under "Eye Color", preset colors are displayed in a list, similar to "Hair Color", and selecting one will change your eye color.
If you would like to set different colors for each eye, you can adjust them individually under the "Right Eye" and "Left Eye" options.
If you would like both eyes to be the same color, you can change them using the "Both Eyes" option.
If you would like to customize a unique color, select a preset close to your desired color, then press "Setting Details" to fine-tune it further.
In Advanced Settings, you can adjust the Base and Glow values separately.
You can use the sliders or manually input values for each RGB (Red, Green, Blue) component.
Pressing "Reset" will restore the color to its state before changes were made in Setting Details.
Added a Field of View Adjustment Setting During View Mode
"View Mode FOV" has been added under: Menu > System > Settings > Setting Details > Controls.
Lowering the value will narrow the visible range and reduce distortion of distant subjects.
Display the number of items listed on the Market
When choosing "Buy Item", the current number of items listed for each item will now be displayed in the list of item suggestions.
*Items you are currently selling are also counted, but your own items are not displayed in the list. The number of items listed may not always match the number in the list.
We will continue to improve features to make your adventures in Aincrad even more enjoyable.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".

Icon
Item Name
Koharu's hand-mirror
A buff item that lets you transform into Koharu for a limited time.
You will transform into one of 8 different forms at random.
* The chances for transforming into each form are different.
They are effective for 180 seconds.
Movement, the evasion button, and some items can be used while transformed. However, other actions such as attacking cannot be performed.
* Using another transformation item while transformed will transform you into a newly drawn form.
* You can use the Awakening button while transformed.
Transformation will end in the following cases:
Transformation buff effect time ends.
The player moves between areas (including entering/exiting dungeons, etc.).
Cancel Transformation button is tapped (the Attack button will turn into the Cancel Transformation button while transformed).

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 68!
EVENT
2026-02-18 18:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 68 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the February 18, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the February 25, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 68, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 68 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 68 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from February 26 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

GoG Season 68 Boss Monster

Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Blunt Element and Dark Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Some attacks will remove buffs from the players.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and Seal Item debuff on Extreme difficulty.

section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.

It's been 3,000 days since Sword Art Online Integral Factor was released in Japan!
Memoria All Out Battle: The Gleam Eyes is here!
The Memoria All Out Battle is a large-scale raid in which all players work together to defeat a raid boss with a massive amount of HP.
By successfully defeating the raid boss, The Gleam Eyes, you can get rank rewards that are based on the total damage points.
Rewards
Get
up to 1000 "Memoria Niter S"
, up to 100 "Awakening Star", and up to 20 "Medal of Combat Arts" from the entire event.
There are five types of rewards.
①Rank Rewards
Each player's Damage Points are calculated on the result screen by taking the amount of HP the boss loses from the start until the battle is cleared and dividing it by the number of players remaining in the dungeon at clear time.
Each player's damage rank will be calculated based on the total damage points accumulated by the time the raid boss, The Gleam Eyes, is defeated. You can get rank rewards based on your damage rank.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 71st "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-05-13 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 71st "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 71 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the May 13, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 20, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the May 20, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 27, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 71 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
Upon performing a certain attack, it enters a state where its HP gradually recovers for 10 minutes, and it grants itself 2 buffs.
During the wind-up animation for Skill Break attacks, it grants itself 2 buffs and removes its own status ailments.
It is resistant to status ailments, but the damage dealt by status ailments increases significantly.
It uses 3 types of Skill Break attacks (Blunt Element, 1H Club, Blunt and Earth Element).
It has Weapon Element Resistance, Natural Element Resistance, Critical Resistance, and Damage Taken Resistance.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 15th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2026-05-02 12:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 15th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
May 2, 2026 (Sat) 12:00 - Before the May 13, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Blunt Element
Water Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 15th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
After 600 seconds from the start of battle, the entire field will be covered by the damage area.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned

Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Tournaments a player didn't take part in will be indicated by "No Entry".
Scenario Quest
These are quests where you can enjoy character dialogue.
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "Squad Jumble Is On!".
After completing a quest, its selection will move to the bottom as a Story Replay.

About Daily Dungeon
"Daily Dungeons" are a special type of solo dungeon that you can only clear once per day. There are ten varieties of "Daily Dungeons" to choose from, each with different rewards such as EXP and equipment enhancement items.
Once you clear a Daily Dungeon, you can't challenge a new one until the system resets at 4:00 AM (JST/UTC+9).
Plus, during this event you can clear Daily Dungeons up to 3 times per day!
You can either clear one dungeon three times, or clear three different dungeons once each. Feel free to play in a way that suits your style!

The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.

Notices
Yuna Live is on now! Hear Yuna sing at this thrilling concert and protect the show!
EVENT
2026-04-29 21:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Protect that voice at all costs! The legendary Live Defense event is here!
Thanks for waiting!
Yuna, the pinnacle of AR idols, descends onto the stage in a special festival-themed outfit!
Relive the emotions from the movie with the iconic song "longing" in this special live performance. Experience it from the front row, right inside the game!
Drive away the unsophisticated monsters trying to ruin the show!
As Yuna's voice fills the air, the ultimate Defense Battle begins!
You want to enjoy the show above all else? No worries, we got you!
We've also prepared a "No Battle" difficulty where monsters don't appear.
Make sure to burn Yuna's heroic performance into your memory while using this difficulty!
The "
Yuna Live -Songstress Festival-
" starts now!
