During the event, you'll be able to use special emotes for a limited time.
Three limited-time emotes will be available. They will be located at the bottom of the list that appears after tapping the emote icon.
Cheer
Festival Dance
Use those emotes and make the most of the summer events!
* Emotes will not give you a buff or any other special effect.
* Limited-time emotes will be removed during the May 13, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Scenario Quest
The children in Aincrad are bored with nothing to entertain them.
Yuna gets wind of this and takes it upon herself to hold a player-run event.
See the efforts of Yuna and the other players in this four-part scenario quest!
How to Participate
First, talk to the
Festival Area Guide
NPC at the Teleport Gate Plaza to head to the Festival Area.
Then walk into the Festival Area and talk to
Mina
to start the scenario quest.
There are 4 scenario quests. Clear them all to unlock the Defense Battle
Event Period
April 29, 2026 (Wed) 21:00 - Before the May 13, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
Trader Period
April 29, 2026 (Wed) 21:00 - Before the May 20, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9)
Story Replay
After completing the scenario quest, you can replay it via the dungeon NPC for the event.
Story Replay is displayed beneath the dungeon.
"Defense Battle"
Protect the stage platforms from the onslaught of monsters in this Defense Battle event!
Stage platforms are located throughout the map. The less damage done to them, and the faster the monsters are driven back, the higher your score.
The center stage is your Main Defense Target. If its HP reaches 0, you'll fail.
This Defense Battle also has Sub Defense Targets in every direction.
Although the battle will not fail if a Sub Defense Target's HP reaches 0, you will earn a huge score boost if you still have intact Sub Defense Targets by the end of the final wave.
Protect all the stage platforms and try for a high score to get nice rewards.
Spectating Mode
After you complete this scenario quest, talk to the NPC who appears in the Festival Area. "Check the Spectator Dungeon list" will be at the top of the list.
Tap "Check the Spectator Dungeon list" to view a list of battles you can spectate.
Select a battle to spectate, then choose either Watch normally or Watch with VR.
* Up to 15 players can spectate a battle. Battles that have reached this limit will no longer be displayed on the list.
* Spectating players cannot attack monsters.
* Spectators will not be displayed on the screen of the player fighting the battle.
- Watch normally
"'Spectators" will appear above the spectators' heads instead of their player names.
Use the Exit to stop spectating mid-battle.
- Watch with VR
Starts VR mode. This lets you spectate the battle in virtual reality using smartphone VR goggles.
Please make sure your smartphone is held horizontally with the bottom of the phone pointing to the right.
See the notice below for more details on using VR mode.
How to Use VR Mode
Tap the X button in the upper left corner to exit VR mode when spectating.
Enjoy an even more realistic concert using VR Mode!
* VR goggles with binocular lenses are required.
* Please exit VR mode at once if you begin to develop a headache, feel sick, or become tired.
Trader Rewards
Exchange the "3rd Season Ticket Stub" you obtain from the event at the exclusive Trader to get items.
Trade "3rd Season Ticket Stub" for special items.

Notices

（JST/GMT+9）

Ranking Rewards have been distributed. Please collect them from the present box.
For more details about the rewards, see "Ranking Rewards" below.
Pick up period
Until September 9, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
■The Champion's Room is Unlocked
The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Champion's Room Guide" NPC in the Guild Room.
There are two ways to enter the normal Guild Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.
2. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in the Champion's Room.
The "Guild Quest" bulletin board and NPC's from the normal Guild Room will be moved to the Champion's Room.
If you were logged in from before April 23 at 14:00 (JST/UTC+9), you will be able to receive rewards and access the Champion's Room by logging in again.
In "Guild of Guilds" Season 71, there will be a High Score Ranking in which guilds compete for ranks based on their high scores.
The boss, "Masquerade Demon", will have a weapon elemental weakness to "Blunt" and a natural elemental weakness to "Earth".
The next "Guild of Guilds" Preseason is expected to begin on May 13, 2026 (Wed).
Important
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.
-----------------------------
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 70 has begun!
Take on the Wander Fatal Scythe during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the April 15, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 22, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 70, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 70 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 70 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from April 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 70 Boss Monster
Wander Fatal Scythe
Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
It gains a stack buff that reduces damage based on the number of players it has defeated.
Every time a player is attacked, it gains a stack buff that increases its attack.
Once its HP falls below a certain amount, it changes its elemental weakness to Dark.
The Awakening Gauge decreases with some attacks.
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff on Extreme difficulty.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 70 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 70 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 70 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 70 dungeons.
"GoG Season 70 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 70 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 70 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.

Underground Labyrinth B8F was released after the April 22, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Major Updates
Underground Labyrinth B8F, new quests, and achievements have been added.
The new Lux Integral Series shield Gauss has been added.
Many Skill Releasers available in Underground Labyrinth B8F have been added.
Underground Labyrinth B8F Floor Installed!
Completing Underground Labyrinth B7F's Underground Labyrinth main quest will allow you to enter Underground Labyrinth B8F.
Once you reach Underground Labyrinth B8F, the scenario for the Underground Labyrinth main quest will automatically begin.
Similar to other floors, Underground Labyrinth subquests have been added to the Underground Labyrinth B8F.
* These can be accepted by completely clearing Underground Labyrinth B8F's Underground Labyrinth main quest.
Added Achievements!
Added an achievement that awards 500 Arcana Gems when you completely clear Underground Labyrinth B8F's Underground Labyrinth main quest.
Introducing the New Lux Integral Series Shield!
You can now produce the Lux Integral Series shield "Gauss" using materials acquired in Underground Labyrinth B8F.
It can be produced using 2 "Martial Artist Protection Stone Piece" and 200 "Deepthorn Rose".
You can get "Martial Artist Protection Stone Piece" in Underground Labyrinth B8F in the following ways.
・Get an extremely rare drop from the Greta : Martial Witch boss monster when dealing damage that's over 0.1% of the Max HP
・Drops with a low probability when you damage the Greta : Martial Witch boss monster, or produce from 200 "Martial Artist Protection Stone Piece" that you can get from treasure boxes as an rare drop.
*The drop rate or number of each item increases with the amount of damage dealt on the boss monster.
*Excluding reflected damage.

About Underground Labyrinth
Aincrad the Floating Castle: The Hidden High-Difficulty Area "Underground Labyrinth"
To all players who have defeated Aincrad's floor bosses and crave the next challenge:
The gateway to an unknown abyss, hidden deep within Blackiron Palace, is now open.
Spanning the basement level of 1F is the "Underground Labyrinth", a high-difficulty area that deviates from the standard progression path.
Countless ferocious high-level monsters lurk here, making it extremely difficult for a single party to conquer alone.
"A Large-Scale Cooperative Assault" by All Players
To overcome the threats of this labyrinth, unity across all players (beyond guilds and parties) is essential.
Coordinate with everyone gathered in the area to launch wave-like attacks and clear a path.
Ultimate Rewards: Legendary Equipment and Items to Increase Skill Power
Those who dispel the darkness at the deepest depths will be granted unparalleled power.
Skill Releaser: A highly rare item that increases skill power.
Integral Series Shield: A strongest shield, such as Fermat and Gauss, unmatched by any other.
An "Encounter" That Rewrites Destiny and the Story of IF
Deep within the labyrinth, standing in the silence, is "a certain character" who should not exist in the original records.
Through this encounter, the very fabric of Aincrad is shaken, and a new, unseen IF story begins to unfold...

Talk to the "Underground Labyrinth Guide" NPC at the "Blackiron Palace" to challenge it.
In order to participate, you must clear the 100F Main Quest through the end.
See here for more details on the Underground Labyrinth.

* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 70 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from April 23 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).

"GoG Season 70 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 70 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.

Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 70 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
[Assist Party] The Assisting Characters you can form an Assist Party with have been increased to four! Additionally, Koharu will accompany you!
UPDATE
2026-04-08 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Good news for all players making use of Assist Parties!
The Assisting Characters you can form a party with have been increased to four!
Additionally, Koharu will also accompany you!
Player + Koharu + 4 Assisting Characters = 6 characters in total! Depending on your Formation and Switching and Linking strats, you'll be able to achieve the highest combat potential ever seen.
Take your favorite characters along to various areas and enjoy your new adventures together!
■Assist Party Formation: Slots increased
Depending on the Assisting Characters' Friendship Rank, additional slots will be unlocked in the formation menu.
* Slots will be unlocked based on the character with the highest Friendship Rank.
You can unlock up to a maximum of four slots.
Slot
Unlock Conditions
1
Complete the 1F Main Quest
2
Friendship Rank 15 or higher
3
Friendship Rank 20 or higher
4
Friendship Rank 25 or higher
* There are no changes to the unlock conditions up to the second slot.
■Added a Quick Selection screen
A Quick Selection button has been added to the Create Assist Party screen.
Pressing this button will open the Quick Selection screen.
▼How to form a Party
The top of the screen will show a list of available characters, and the bottom one, the selected Party Members.
If you select a character from the list of available characters, they will be added to your Party.
After selecting your Members, tap on the Confirm button to form your Party.
▼How to edit your Party
If there are still open slots in your formation, you can add more Members in the same way.
However, if your formation is full, you will need to switch a Member for another.
To do so, tap on the Party Member you want to switch out to send them back to the list.
Then, select the character you wish to add from the Available Character list.
Should you wish to start from scratch, tap on the Reset button.
■Koharu joins the fray!
Koharu will accompany the Assist Party.
However, she will not be able join you in areas she cannot enter.
We will continue to improve features to make your adventures in Aincrad even more enjoyable.
We hope you continue to enjoy "Sword Art Online Integral Factor".
Go to Notice List

"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 70 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the April 8, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 22, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Season: Starts after the April 15, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the April 22, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 14th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2026-03-31 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 14th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
Starts after the March 31, 2026 (Tue) maintenance and ends before the April 8, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Slash Element
Fire Element
Battle Map for This Tournament
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 14th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
After 600 seconds from the start of battle, the entire field will be covered by the damage area.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch"and "Return".
Choosing "Watch"will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch"mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

* Rank Points cannot fall below 0.
* Rank will not be lowered by a decrease in Rank Points.
Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned
"Match Count Rewards", according to the number of battles participated in

Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 72!
EVENT
2026-06-17 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 72 has begun!
Take on the Medusa during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the June 17, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 24, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 72, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 72 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 72 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from June 25 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

"Status Ailments"
section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 72 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 72 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 72 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 72 dungeons.
"GoG Season 72 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 72 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 72 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 72 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* The item you can earn in this tournament is the "GoG Season 72 Badge".

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!

The "Medusa" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 72 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 72 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.

Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 72 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the June 24 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 72nd "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-06-10 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 72nd "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials from each dungeon's drop items.
Production Avatars
Item Icon
Item Name
Type
Snake's Shield (Red Purple Yellow)
Shield Avatar
Guild Arm Band (Red Purple Yellow)
Accessory Avatar
Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

Type

Shield Avatar

Snakeskin Guild Cape (Red Purple Yellow)
Accessory Avatar
How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 72 Ticket".
Note that "GoG Season 72 Extreme" awards more points than "GoG Season 72 Depth".
We recommend challenging "GoG Season 72 Extreme" if you are aiming for a higher score.
In this dungeon, your strength will increase as time passes after entering.
5 minutes after entering the dungeon, your Attack and Defense will double. At 7 minutes and 30 seconds, your Attack will increase tenfold. At 10 minutes, your Attack will increase to 30 times and your Defense will increase fivefold.
* This does not qualify as a buff for Skill Records with effects such as "When Attack Buff is active", "When Defense Buff is active", or "When Buff is active".
* The enhancement effect will be removed upon exiting the dungeon, after KO transitions, upon logout, or upon disconnection.
* The enhancement effect will be reapplied upon re-entering the dungeon.
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the June 10, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 17, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the June 17, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the June 24, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 16th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2026-06-03 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 16th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
After the June 3, 2026 (Wed) maintenance - Before the June 10, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Thrust Element
Earth Element
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Party or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 16th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
After 600 seconds from the start of battle, the entire field will be covered by the damage area.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch" and "Return".
Choosing "Watch" will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch" mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

* Rank Points cannot fall below 0.
* Rank will not be lowered by a decrease in Rank Points.
Rewards will be given in the following ways.
Rank Rewards, acquired when reaching specific ranks
Total Rank Point Rewards, according to the total number of Rank Points earned
Match Count Rewards, according to the number of battles participated in
Rewards exchanged at the Trader using gathered Squad Symbols
Rank Points can be earned in the following ways.
Earned according to battle placement
Earned according to battle performance
Battle Performance
Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

Ring
A Ring is a piece of equipment that is different from armor.
Unlock Ring by completing the main quest on 50F of Aincrad.
This item can be produced, and it provides a Main Effect that increases natural Element damage, as well as up to two types of Random Bonuses, such as increased attack.
By equipping a ring, you will also be able to equip an Ability Skill Record as an EX Ability.
Up to two rings can be equipped, and an EX Ability can be equipped to each.
Koharu can also equip rings and EX Abilities. Assisting Characters cannot equip them.

About Underground Labyrinth
The Underground Labyrinth is a special location where you can fight enemies on the same field with players outside of your party and guild members.
Other players can attack monsters currently being fought.
All monsters will attack players near them.
You can obtain Skill Releasers in all floors of the Underground Labyrinth.
Skill Releasers are items that increase the damage of certain sword skills.
A very valuable shield can be produced using Protection Stones that drop from the bosses from the Underground Labyrinth B2F.

In order to unravel the mysteries of the Underground Labyrinth and obtain greater power, the Assault Team forms a scouting team.

Notices

EVENT
2026-05-20 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 71 has begun!
Take on the Masquerade Demon during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the May 20, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the May 27, 2026 (Wed) maintenance.
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 71, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 71 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 71 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from May 28 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
* Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items

Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.
GoG Season 71 Boss Monster
Masquerade Demon
Details
Performs a certain attack to enter a state where its HP gradually recovers for 10 minutes and grants itself 2 buffs.
Grants itself 2 buffs and removes its own Status Ailments during the windup of a Skill Break attack.
It is resistant to Status Ailments, but Status Ailment damage increases significantly.
Uses 3 types of Skill Break attacks ("Blunt", "1H Club", "Blunt and Earth").
It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and the Seal Items debuff on Extreme difficulty.

section of the Play Guide.
Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 71 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 71 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 71 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 71 dungeons.
"GoG Season 71 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 71 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 71 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 71 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* The item you can earn in this tournament is the "GoG Season 71 Badge".

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Seize victory in a four-team faceoff battle! The 18th Squad Jumble is here!
EVENT
2026-08-05 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
A team battle consisting of up to 4 teams!
Announcing the 18th Squad Jumble!
Defeat enemy monsters and obstruct enemy teams to achieve victory!
You can earn tiered rewards by repeatedly taking part in battles.
You'll also rank up by earning Rank Points depending on the results of your battles, allowing you to earn even better rewards!
Earn heaps of Rank Rewards, with a total of 2,000 Arcana Gems, 100 Memoria Niter S, 10 Medals of Combat Arts, 100 Awakening Stars, and more!
You can also earn special records during each tournament.
Event Period for This Tournament
After the August 5, 2026 (Wed) maintenance - Before the August 13, 2026 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Elemental Weakness for This Tournament's Monsters
Thrust Element
Wind Element
Basic Rules
Players will be split into Up to 4 teams, Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green, and fight monsters.
The team with members surviving until the end or the team that successfully defends the Winning Star will win.
The basic strategy is to defeat monsters and send monsters to opposing teams in order to devastate them.
How to Participate
You can participate through the Squad Jumble Reception NPC who appears in Teleport Gate Plaza.
A team consists of two to six people.
You can enter alone and wait to be matched with other members through Quick Team or you can participate after forming a party.
You will be taken to the battlefield after all teams have finished matchmaking.
You can tell what color team you are on based on the color of the ★ mark above your head.
Participation Procedure
Speak to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC and select "The 18th Squad Jumble".
Select "Join Solo" at the bottom of the screen if you're participating on your own. Have the leader select "Join as Party" if you're participating as a party.
Players and teams will be shown the matchmaking standby screen.
Go back to the participation screen and select "Quit" if you want to cancel your participation.
When you join alone, the party this is formed will remain active even after the battle ends.
Party members who are not the party leader cannot perform the participation procedure.
After the party leader completes the participation procedure, you will be able to see matchmaking details via "Join as Party".
* You cannot join the battle without talking to the Squad Jumble Reception NPC.
This screen will also allow you to check your own rank and Rank Points as well as confirm details such as "Total Results", "Rewards", and "Battle Rules".
Participation Requirements
Complete the 1F Main Quest
About the Battle
After a preparation time of up to 150 Seconds, a ten-second countdown will begin before the battle starts.
Enemy and ally monsters will appear on the field.
A colored marker will appear above the heads of monsters to indicate their team.
* Ally monsters are those meant for enemy teams to defeat. Your team cannot attack them.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Some monsters are also able to inflict disadvantageous effects on enemy teams.
Monsters with instant-death attacks that belong to no team will also appear.
Various events will occur as time passes.
Debuffs to all participants
The appearance of treasure boxes that provide buffs when opened
The appearance of "Damage Areas" that deal damage when inside them
The appearance of Winning Rabbits
You cannot use healing and buff items during battle, and you cannot return to the battle if you are near death.
Monster Types
Marked Monster
These are monsters that belong to each team.
You can tell what team they belong to by the color of the marker above their head.
Defeat an enemy team's monsters in order to send even stronger ally monsters back to the team corresponding to its colored marker.
Karma Monster
This is a monster that, when defeated, applies status ailments or other disadvantageous effects to an opposing team.
Killer Monster
These are monsters that belong to no team. They appear as time passes during a battle.
They perform area-of-effect attacks that cause anyone hit to enter a near-death state.
These cannot be defeated, as they can barely be damaged.
Winning Rabbits and Winning Stars
Winning Rabbits will appear after a certain amount of time passes.
Winning Rabbits attempt to flee from players.
Defeat a Winning Rabbit to make a Winning Star for your team appear.
Winning Stars are one path to victory, as you will win if you are able to defend one for a certain amount of time.
Be sure to defend well, as you'll attract aggro from all enemy monsters.
All team members actively defending a Winning Star will be given the Winning Star buff, allowing them to see how much time is left before victory through defense.
Damage Area
Once the battle has gone on for long enough, Damage Areas will appear.
You will take continuous damage if you enter these Damage Areas.
Be sure to avoid Damage Areas as you battle.
Damage Areas will also grow as time elapses.
After 600 seconds from the start of battle, the entire field will be covered by the damage area.
Damage Areas will be displayed in red, as seen below.
Understanding the Mini-Map
Icons displayed on the mini-map are as follows.
Marked Monster
Killer Monster
Winning Rabbit
Winning Star
Status Ailments
Zombie: Recovery effects deal damage.
Death Penalty: When the effect expires, the player becomes unable to fight.
Entering a Near-Death State
You cannot be revived and will not be able to return to the battle.
You will be able to choose between "Watch" and "Return".
Choosing "Watch" will allow you to watch the battle until it is over.
If you would like to exit "Watch" mid-battle, select "Menu" at the top-left of the screen.
Choosing to "Return" will allow you to return from the battle.
* You will still be able to gain Rank Points from the battle ending if you return.
Leaving Mid-Battle
If you leave during battle due to disconnection or other reasons, you will not be able to participate in the battle even if you return.
If you exit battles while they are occurring multiple times, you will be unable to participate in battles for a set amount of time.
Victory Conditions
There are two ways to win.
Be the team that has surviving members at the end
Be the team that successfully defends a Winning Star
Ranks and Rewards
You will be given Rank Points after a battle ends based on your performance.
Your rank will rise if you acquire enough held Rank Points.
Any excess points when rising in rank will be discarded.
* This will not have an effect on your total Rank Points.
Additionally, starting from "Colossus Class" and above, a certain amount of Rank Points will be consumed to join each battle.
You can check how many Rank Points were consumed on the results screen.

Rank Points are earned based on the number of First Attacks (FA) and Last Attacks (LA).
Special performances will be recognized and bonus Rank Points will be awarded. Your team's placement will determine the maximum number of earnable points.
There are various ways to be recognized, such as being the player who dealt the most damage, the player who defeated the most Karma Monsters, and so on.

The winning guild can now access the Champion's Room.
You will able to access the Champion's Room if you are a member of the winning guild, even if you joined afterwards.
There are two ways to enter the Champion's Room.
1. Talk to the "Guild Room Guide" NPC in Teleport Gate Plaza.

Notices

EVENT

（JST/GMT+9）
The high-difficulty dungeon, "Chaos Showdown", has been updated!
Get the powerful "Dark Black Series" armor!
Dungeon Duration
After July 23, 2026 (Thu) maintenance - August 5, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9)
New Boss monster
Eliminator Chaos
Details
This battle takes place in a Crystal Nullification Zone, so some items cannot be used.
When battle starts, it will use a Critical Resistance buff.
It is breakable with a Two-handed Spear. After the first Break, it becomes breakable with a Bow.
When a Break happens, the boss will be temporarily immobilized and all its buffs will be removed.
It is also skill-breakable with Thrust and Dark element skills.
With a certain attack, it gets a powerful buff to reduce damage.
It has an attack that removes player buffs.
It has an attack that lowers the player's awakening gauge.
When its HP falls beneath a certain amount, it will use the Chaos Recollection buff.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
Battle for the Top! Ranking Event "Guild of Guilds" Season 73!
EVENT
2026-07-23 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
The Ranking Event that decides the strongest guild in Aincrad is here!
"Guild of Guilds" Season 73 has begun!
Take on the Terror Gaze during the event!
Guild members will work together to defeat the enemy and rank high!
Period
Starts after the July 23, 2026 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the July 29, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
About the Ranking Event
In Guild of Guilds Season 73, players will defeat bosses in the dungeon and
compete in the rankings with the highest score their guild earns
.
There are two difficulties for the Guild of Guilds Season 73 dungeon: Depth, and the high-difficulty Extreme, where you can
get an even higher score
.
Rankings will be based on the highest score achieved at either Depth or Extreme difficulty during this event period.
* At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred before rankings are finalized.
To check your current ranking or score, go to Menu > Community > Ranking > "Guild of Guilds" Season 73 banner.
Ranking Reward
Players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems according to their ranking.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.
Ranking rewards will be distributed, and the Champion's Room will be unlocked, from July 30 (Thu) 14:00 (JST/UTC+9).
Record
Guilds participating in the rankings will receive Records limited to the tournament as rewards.
Finish in the top rankings to receive a prestigious Record with your rank on it.
※Records can be received from Achievement Rewards.

Other Items
Players can earn Medals of Unity and Awakening Stars based on their ranking.
Champion's Room
The Champion's Room is a special guild room that can only be used by the guild with the highest ranking.
It will be available for use until the end of the next season.

It uses the Chaos Recollection buff and the Seal Items debuff on Extreme difficulty.

Players will receive buffs after a certain amount of time has passed since entering the "Guild of Guilds" Season dungeon.
Five minutes after entering: your attack and defense are boosted by x2.
Seven minutes and thirty seconds after entering: your attack is boosted by x10.
Ten minutes after entering: your attack is boosted by x30, and your defense is boosted by x5.
Buff & Debuff icon
The buff and debuff icons will be displayed, but they will not activate Skill Record effects that have requirements including "during the buff effect of attack+", "during the buff effect of defense+", or "buff is in effect".
This effect will disappear if you escape the dungeon, transition out of combat when near death, return to the title screen, or disconnect.
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Attempting a ranked GoG Season 73 dungeon will consume
5 GoG Season 73 Tickets
.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Season 73 Tickets can be acquired in the various Preseason 73 dungeons.
"GoG Season 73 Ticket" are not individual player items. Tickets are kept by the guild.
The amount of "GoG Season 73 Ticket" held can be checked via the main guild screen.
Ranking Reward Conditions
Winning.
Landing at least 1 hit and clearing the GoG Season 73 dungeon's boss monster.
The conditions will not be met if you use the Exit to leave the dungeon and other players clear it.
The conditions will not be met if you are not logged in when other players clear the dungeon.
The conditions will not be met if other players clear the dungeon after you have left it in a near-death state.
The conditions will not be met for anyone who clears the dungeon after the Ranking Event ends.
If you are eligible for a reward, you will receive confirmation on the screen that displays after the dungeon is cleared.
Check if you are eligible for a reward from the "Guild of Guilds" Season 73 banner in Menu > Community > Ranking.
You will be unable to receive the rewards if you move to another world from the title screen after becoming eligible for a reward and before the reward is distributed.
GoG Season Badges
Clear a GoG Season dungeon to receive GoG Season Badges unique to that event each time from Challenge Rewards.
* The item you can earn in this tournament is the "GoG Season 73 Badge".
GoG Season Badges can be traded for various items at the GoG Season Badge Trader.

Guilds
Guilds can be created and joined through the "Guild Counter" NPC.
You can gain the benefits of Guild Skills that will help in your journeys, such as increased item drop rates and increased Weapon Proficiency acquisition by joining a guild and increasing its Guild Level.
Players who do not belong to a guild should use this opportunity to join one!
Players who belong to guilds can also use Guild Raid buffs acquirable from Guild Level 16 to help with Guild Events.
Please see below for more details on guilds.
Creating a Guild
Guild Skills
Important
Please check all Rewards in the game.
The "Terror Gaze" that appears in the "Guild of Guilds" Season Extreme difficulty dungeon is more powerful than the "Guild of Guilds" Preseason dungeon Special difficulty boss.
The dungeon has a 30 min time limit.
The score in "Guild of Guilds" Season 73 is shared between all guild members.
There are no Total Score Rewards in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 73 dungeon.
The time bonus for the Dungeon will give 1 point per second in "Depth" and 1 point per every 0.02 seconds in "Extreme".
All guilds, including those not participating in the event, will be unable to dismiss guild members or leave/disband guilds during the ranking period.
You must have either created or joined a guild to enter a Guild Room.
Please note that dungeon expiry time and Guild Skill effectiveness timers will still elapse during maintenance.
Please refrain from challenging dungeons and using Guild Skills before maintenance.
Koharu will not participate in the solo version of this event.
This Event cannot be challenged with an Assist Party.
If the event ends while you are in the "Guild of Guilds" Season 73 dungeon, the score for that attempt will not count toward the rankings.
If you join a guild during or after the July 29 (Wed) maintenance when the Ranking Event ends, you will not be able to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking placement may change based on timing of updates.
Guilds with players who cheated may be stripped of their rank and rewards.
Items with record names that can be acquired during this event will be removed on December 9, 2026 (Wed) 13:59 (JST/UTC+9).
GoG Season 73 Badges will be deleted before the August 5, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
The schedule may be subject to change without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

news_list.full_details:
Notices
The 73rd "Guild of Guilds" is on now! Which guild will prove to be the strongest in Aincrad?
EVENT
2026-07-15 17:00:00
（JST/GMT+9）
Take on this Ranking Event as a guild!
The 73rd "Guild of Guilds" starts today!
"Guild of Guilds" (GoG) is a battle event where you'll take on powerful enemies as a guild.
You'll be ranked by your results, and the higher your placement, the more spectacular the rewards.
The incredible guild that manages to climb to the top will not only receive ranking rewards, but also gets the right to use the special guild room, the Champion's Room!
Come together as a guild of up to 30 members and work as one to take the crown!
All guilds are welcome to enter.
Every guild will have its own goal, whether that's to take first place, rank within the top 100, or just improve on their placement compared to last time.
Not only are you guaranteed to receive ranking rewards by completing it even once, you can also get challenge rewards, Total Score Rewards, drop items, and more.
All participants can also receive Records limited to the tournament as ranking rewards.
(Records will differ based on ranking.)
Whether it's strengthening your bonds with your friends, having fun as a guild, or something else entirely, there are plenty of reasons to take on this event!
Event Rewards
Throughout "Guild of Guilds", you can receive special avatars based off of the tournament boss, as well as Medals of Unity!
Avatars include those you can produce using materials acquired in the GoG Preseason dungeon, as well as those acquired via ranking rewards.
Medals of Unity can be exchanged for various items at the Medal of Unity Trader.
* The Medal of Unity Trader has been split into 5 Exchange Points depending on what you'll be exchanging for.
* You can also exchange for reward avatars from past "Guild of Guilds" events.
You can also get Skill Record enhancement and transformation materials, Release Crystals, and more from each dungeon's Total Score Rewards and drop items.

Guild Shoulder Guard (Black Dark Green)

Ranking Rewards and Reward Eligibility
Place in the rankings and land at least 1 hit in while clearing any difficulty of a GoG Season dungeon to receive ranking rewards.
Ranking Rewards: At the end of the ranking period, a final check will be made to ensure that no cheating occurred. According to confirmed rankings, players will receive rewards such as limited-edition Records, Avatars, and Arcana Gems.
Only the guild that ranks first place with the highest score in the "Guild of Guilds" Season will be entitled to use the Champion's Room.

How "Guild of Guilds" Works
Gather GoG Season Tickets in order to enter the ranked GoG Season dungeon.
You'll earn a ranked score when completing a GoG Season dungeon, and guilds will compete for the highest score.
You can attempt the dungeon as many times as you like during the event period.
Event Details
One tournament consists of a preseason period and a season period.
The ranked dungeon will be the one that appears during the season period.
Preseason:
The preseason period is primarily for gathering GoG Season Tickets, which are used in order to enter the GoG Season dungeon.
The GoG Preseason dungeon that appears during this period has three levels of difficulty: Depth, DANGER, and Special. Tickets can be acquired in any of these dungeons.
Try taking on the difficulty that best suits your abilities.
* Scores earned in Depth, DANGER, and Special difficulties all count toward the Total Score Reward. Your rewards will be based on your score.
* You can also attempt the dungeon during the season period.
Season:
During the season period, you'll compete to earn the best rank.
The GoG Season dungeon will appear during this time.
All dungeons can be attempted by using
5 GoG Season Tickets
.
Your results when clearing this dungeon will be reflected in the rankings.
Note that GoG Season Tickets are exclusive to their specific tournament and will disappear after the event ends.
GoG Season Tickets are kept by the guild, not by its individual players.
You can see how many GoG Season Tickets your guild has via the main guild screen.
This tournament's tickets will be named "GoG Season 73 Ticket".
* Another announcement with season details will be made when the season begins.
Event Period for This Tournament
Preseason: Starts after the July 15, 2026 (Wed) maintenance and ends before the July 23, 2026 (Thu) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Season: Starts after the July 23, 2026 (Thu) maintenance and ends before the July 29, 2026 (Wed) maintenance (JST/UTC+9).
Participation Requirements
Must be a member of a guild.
Complete the 1F Main Quest
How to Enter
Preseason: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Preseason Guide" found in the Guild Room.
Season: Take on the challenge from the "GoG Season Guide" found in the Guild Room.
* The previous winning guild of the "Guild of Guilds" can attempt the dungeon from the NPC in the Champion's Room.
GoG Preseason 73 Boss Monster

Details
At the start of battle, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Certain attacks reduce the Awakening Gauge.
When its HP falls below a certain amount, it will change modes, and any debuffs or status ailments it's inflicted with will be removed.
Skill Breaks can be performed with skills that are both Thrust Element and Holy Element.
When preparing the Skill Breakable attack, it gains a stack buff that reduces damage.
Some attacks will remove buffs from the players.
